## Тести (RSpec)

```ruby
# spec/phone_normalizer_spec.rb
require 'rspec'
require_relative '../phone_normalizer'

RSpec.describe UkrainianPhoneNormalizer do
  describe '.normalize' do
    context 'з різними форматами вхідних даних' do
      it 'нормалізує номер у міжнародному форматі' do
        expect(described_class.normalize('+380501234567')).to eq('+380501234567')
      end
      
      it 'нормалізує номер без плюса' do
        expect(described_class.normalize('380501234567')).to eq('+380501234567')
      end
      
      it 'нормалізує номер у національному форматі' do
        expect(described_class.normalize('0501234567')).to eq('+380501234567')
      end
      
      it 'нормалізує номер з 80 на початку' do
        expect(described_class.normalize('80501234567')).to eq('+380501234567')
      end
      
      it 'нормалізує номер без коду країни' do
        expect(described_class.normalize('501234567')).to eq('+380501234567')
      end
      
      it 'видаляє пробіли та спецсимволи' do
        expect(described_class.normalize('+38 (050) 123-45-67')).to eq('+380501234567')
      end
    end
    
    context 'з невалідними номерами' do
      it 'повертає nil для закороткого номера' do
        expect(described_class.normalize('+38050123')).to be_nil
      end
      
      it 'повертає nil для задовгого номера' do
        expect(described_class.normalize('+3805012345678')).to be_nil
      end
      
      it 'повертає nil для не мобільного номера' do
        expect(described_class.normalize('+380441234567')).to be_nil
      end
      
      it 'повертає nil для nil' do
        expect(described_class.normalize(nil)).to be_nil
      end
    end
  end
  
  describe '.operator_for' do
    it 'визначає Vodafone' do
      expect(described_class.operator_for('+380501234567')).to eq('Vodafone')
    end
    
    it 'визначає Kyivstar' do
      expect(described_class.operator_for('+380671234567')).to eq('Kyivstar')
    end
    
    it 'визначає Lifecell' do
      expect(described_class.operator_for('+380631234567')).to eq('Lifecell')
    end
    
    it 'повертає nil для невалідного номера' do
      expect(described_class.operator_for('12345')).to be_nil
    end
  end
  
  describe '.mobile_number?' do
    it 'повертає true для мобільного номера' do
      expect(described_class.mobile_number?('+380501234567')).to be true
    end
    
    it 'повертає false для немобільного номера' do
      expect(described_class.mobile_number?('+380441234567')).to be false
    end
  end
end

## Особливості реалізації:

1. **Нормалізація**: Приводить різні формати номерів до єдиного стандарту `+380XXXXXXXXX`
2. **Визначення оператора**: Визначає оператора за кодом мобільного номера

# app/models/commerce_ml/exchange_session.rb
module CommerceML
  class ExchangeSession < ApplicationRecord
    self.table_name = 'commerce_ml_exchange_sessions'
    
    enum direction: { import: 0, export: 1 }
    enum status: { 
      pending: 0, 
      processing: 1, 
      completed: 2, 
      failed: 3 
    }
    
    belongs_to :store, optional: true
    
    has_many :exchange_documents, 
             class_name: 'CommerceML::ExchangeDocument',
             foreign_key: 'exchange_session_id',
             dependent: :destroy
    
    validates :session_id, presence: true, uniqueness: true
    validates :direction, :status, presence: true
    
    scope :active, -> { where(status: [:pending, :processing]) }
    scope :recent, -> { order(created_at: :desc) }
    
    def mark_as_completed!
      update!(status: :completed, completed_at: Time.current)
    end
    
    def mark_as_failed!(error_message)
      update!(
        status: :failed,
        error_message: error_message,
        completed_at: Time.current
      )
    end
  end
end

### 3. Сервіси для обміну

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml/base_service.rb
module CommerceML
  class BaseService
    include HTTParty
    
    base_uri CommerceML.configuration.base_url
    basic_auth CommerceML.configuration.username, 
               CommerceML.configuration.password
    
    headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/xml'
    timeout 300
    
    private
    
    def handle_response(response)
      case response.code
      when 200..299
        response
      when 401
        raise AuthenticationError, "Authentication failed"
      when 404
        raise ResourceNotFoundError, "Resource not found"
      when 500..599
        raise ServerError, "Server error: #{response.code}"
      else
        raise ExchangeError, "Unexpected response: #{response.code}"
      end
    end
    
    def parse_xml(xml_string)
      Nokogiri::XML(xml_string)
    end
    
    def build_xml
      builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new
      yield builder if block_given?
      builder.target!
    end
  end
  
  class ExchangeError < StandardError; end
  class AuthenticationError < ExchangeError; end
  class ResourceNotFoundError < ExchangeError; end
  class ServerError < ExchangeError; end
end

### 4. Імпорт даних з 1С

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml/import_service.rb
module CommerceML
  class ImportService < BaseService
    def initialize(store = nil)
      @store = store
      @session = create_session
    end
    
    def import_catalog
      response = self.class.get("#{CommerceML.configuration.import_path}/catalog")
      handle_response(response)
      
      parse_catalog(response.body)
      @session.mark_as_completed!
    rescue StandardError => e
      @session.mark_as_failed!(e.message)
      raise
    end
    
    def import_prices
      response = self.class.get("#{CommerceML.configuration.import_path}/prices")
      handle_response(response)
      
      parse_prices(response.body)
      @session.mark_as_completed!
    rescue StandardError => e
      @session.mark_as_failed!(e.message)
      raise
    end
    
    def import_orders
      response = self.class.get("#{CommerceML.configuration.import_path}/orders")
      handle_response(response)
      
      parse_orders(response.body)
      @session.mark_as_completed!
    rescue StandardError => e
      @session.mark_as_failed!(e.message)
      raise
    end
    
    private
    
    def create_session
      ExchangeSession.create!(
        session_id: SecureRandom.uuid,
        direction: :import,
        status: :processing,
        store: @store,
        started_at: Time.current
      )
    end
    
    def parse_catalog(xml_string)
      doc = parse_xml(xml_string)
      
      doc.xpath('//Product').each do |product_node|
        ProductSyncService.new(product_node, @store).sync!
      end
      
      doc.xpath('//Category').each do |category_node|
        CategorySyncService.new(category_node, @store).sync!
      end
    end
    
    def parse_prices(xml_string)
      doc = parse_xml(xml_string)
      
      doc.xpath('//Price').each do |price_node|
        PriceSyncService.new(price_node, @store).sync!
      end
    end
    
    def parse_orders(xml_string)
      doc = parse_xml(xml_string)
      
      doc.xpath('//Order').each do |order_node|
        OrderSyncService.new(order_node, @store).sync!
      end
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# app/services/commerce_ml/export_service.rb
module CommerceML
  class ExportService < BaseService
    def initialize(store = nil)
      @store = store
      @session = create_session
    end
    
    def export_orders(orders)
      xml = build_orders_xml(orders)
      
      response = self.class.post(
        "#{CommerceML.configuration.export_path}/orders",
        body: xml
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
      @session.mark_as_completed!
    rescue StandardError => e
      @session.mark_as_failed!(e.message)
      raise
    end
    
    def export_products(products)
      xml = build_products_xml(products)
      
      response = self.class.post(
        "#{CommerceML.configuration.export_path}/products",
        body: xml
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
      @session.mark_as_completed!
    rescue StandardError => e
      @session.mark_as_failed!(e.message)
      raise
    end
    
    private
    
    def create_session
      ExchangeSession.create!(
        session_id: SecureRandom.uuid,
        direction: :export,
        status: :processing,
        store: @store,
        started_at: Time.current
      )
    end
    
    def build_orders_xml(orders)
      build_xml do |xml|
        xml.instruct!
        xml.CommerceInfo do
          xml.Orders do
            orders.each do |order|
              xml.Order do
                xml.Id order.id
                xml.Number order.number
                xml.Date order.created_at.iso8601
                xml.Status order.status
                xml.Customer do
                  xml.Name order.customer_name
                  xml.Email order.customer_email
                  xml.Phone order.customer_phone
                end
                xml.Items do
                  order.order_items.each do |item|
                    xml.Item do
                      xml.ProductId item.product_id
                      xml.Name item.product_name
                      xml.Quantity item.quantity
                      xml.Price item.price
                      xml.Total item.total
                    end
                  end
                end
                xml.Total order.total_amount
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    def build_products_xml(products)
      build_xml do |xml|
        xml.instruct!
        xml.CommerceInfo do
          xml.Products do
            products.each do |product|
              xml.Product do
                xml.Id product.id
                xml.Name product.name
                xml.SKU product.sku
                xml.Description product.description
                xml.Price product.price
                xml.Quantity product.quantity
                xml.CategoryId product.category_id
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

# app/services/commerce_ml/product_sync_service.rb
module CommerceML
  class ProductSyncService
    def initialize(xml_node, store = nil)
      @xml_node = xml_node
      @store = store
    end
    
    def sync!
      product = find_or_initialize_product
      
      product.assign_attributes(
        name: @xml_node.at_xpath('Name')&.text,
        sku: @xml_node.at_xpath('SKU')&.text,
        description: @xml_node.at_xpath('Description')&.text,
        external_id: @xml_node.at_xpath('Id')&.text,
        store: @store
      )
      
      product.save!
      sync_properties(product)
      sync_images(product)
      
      product
    end
    
    private
    
    def find_or_initialize_product
      external_id = @xml_node.at_xpath('Id')&.text
      
      if external_id.present?
        Product.find_or_initialize_by(external_id: external_id)
      else
        Product.new
      end
    end
    
    def sync_properties(product)
      @xml_node.xpath('.//Property').each do |property_node|
        property_name = property_node.at_xpath('Name')&.text
        property_value = property_node.at_xpath('Value')&.text
        
        next if property_name.blank?
        
        product_property = product.product_properties
                                  .find_or_initialize_by(name: property_name)
        product_property.update!(value: property_value)
      end
    end
    
    def sync_images(product)
      @xml_node.xpath('.//Image').each do |image_node|
        image_url = image_node.text
        next if image_url.blank?
        
        ImageDownloadJob.perform_later(product.id, image_url)
      end
    end
  end
end

# app/services/commerce_ml/price_sync_service.rb
module CommerceML
  class PriceSyncService
    def initialize(xml_node, store = nil)
      @xml_node = xml_node
      @store = store
    end
    
    def sync!
      product_id = @xml_node.at_xpath('ProductId')&.text
      price_value = @xml_node.at_xpath('Price')&.text
      currency = @xml_node.at_xpath('Currency')&.text || 'UAH'
      
      return if product_id.blank? || price_value.blank?
      
      product = Product.find_by(external_id: product_id)
      return unless product
      
      Price.create!(
        product: product,
        value: price_value.to_f,
        currency: currency,
        store: @store,
        valid_from: Time.current
      )
    end
  end
end

# app/services/commerce_ml/order_sync_service.rb
module CommerceML
  class OrderSyncService
    def initialize(xml_node, store = nil)
      @xml_node = xml_node
      @store = store
    end
    
    def sync!
      order = find_or_initialize_order
      
      order.assign_attributes(
        external_id: @xml_node.at_xpath('Id')&.text,
        status: @xml_node.at_xpath('Status')&.text,
        total_amount: @xml_node.at_xpath('Total')&.text&.to_f,
        store: @store
      )
      
      order.save!
      sync_customer(order)
      sync_items(order)
      
      order
    end
    
    private
    
    def find_or_initialize_order
      external_id = @xml_node.at_xpath('Id')&.text
      
      if external_id.present?
        Order.find_or_initialize_by(external_id: external_id)
      else
        Order.new
      end
    end
    
    def sync_customer(order)
      customer_node = @xml_node.at_xpath('Customer')
      return unless customer_node
      
      customer = Customer.find_or_initialize_by(
        email: customer_node.at_xpath('Email')&.text
      )
      
      customer.assign_attributes(
        name: customer_node.at_xpath('Name')&.text,
        phone: customer_node.at_xpath('Phone')&.text
      )
      
      customer.save!
      order.update!(customer: customer)
    end
    
    def sync_items(order)
      order.order_items.destroy_all
      
      @xml_node.xpath('.//Item').each do |item_node|
        product_id = item_node.at_xpath('ProductId')&.text
        product = Product.find_by(external_id: product_id)
        
        next unless product
        
        order.order_items.create!(
          product: product,
          quantity: item_node.at_xpath('Quantity')&.text&.to_i || 1,
          price: item_node.at_xpath('Price')&.text&.to_f || 0,
          total: item_node.at_xpath('Total')&.text&.to_f || 0
        )
      end
    end
  end
end

### 7. Фонові задачі

```ruby
# app/jobs/commerce_ml/sync_job.rb
module CommerceML
  class SyncJob
    include Sidekiq::Job
    
    def perform(sync_type, store_id = nil)
      store = Store.find_by(id: store_id) if store_id
      
      case sync_type.to_sym
      when :import_catalog
        ImportService.new(store).import_catalog
      when :import_prices
        ImportService.new(store).import_prices
      when :import_orders
        ImportService.new(store).import_orders
      when :export_orders
        orders = Order.pending_export
        ExportService.new(store).export_orders(orders)
      when :export_products
        products = Product.updated_recently
        ExportService.new(store).export_products(products)
      end
    end
  end
end

# app/jobs/commerce_ml/image_download_job.rb
module CommerceML
  class ImageDownloadJob
    include Sidekiq::Job
    
    def perform(product_id, image_url)
      product = Product.find(product_id)
      
      require 'open-uri'
      
      begin
        image_data = URI.open(image_url, read_timeout: 30).read
        product.images.attach(
          io: StringIO.new(image_data),
          filename: File.basename(image_url),
          content_type: 'image/jpeg'
        )
      rescue StandardError => e
        Rails.logger.error("Failed to download image for product #{product_id}: #{e.message}")
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### 8. Контролери

```ruby
# app/controllers/commerce_ml/exchange_controller.rb
module CommerceML
  class ExchangeController < ApplicationController
    skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
    before_action :authenticate_request
    
    # POST /commerce_ml/import
    def import
      file = params[:file]
      
      if file.blank?
        render json: { error: 'No file provided' }, status: :bad_request
        return
      end
      
      begin
        result = process_import_file(file)
        render json: result, status: :ok
      rescue StandardError => e
        render json: { error: e.message }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      end
    end
    
    # POST /commerce_ml/export
    def export
      export_type = params[:type]
      
      case export_type
      when 'orders'
        orders = Order.pending_export
        xml = ExportService.new.build_orders_xml(orders)
      when 'products'
        products = Product.updated_recently
        xml = ExportService.new.build_products_xml(products)
      else
        render json: { error: 'Invalid export type' }, status: :bad_request
        return
      end
      
      render xml: xml
    end
    
    # GET /commerce_ml/status
    def status
      active_sessions = ExchangeSession.active
      
      render json: {
        active_sessions: active_sessions.count,
        last_sync: ExchangeSession.completed.last&.completed_at,
        errors: ExchangeSession.failed.recent.limit(10).map(&:error_message)
      }
    end
    
    private
    
    def authenticate_request
      auth_header = request.headers['Authorization']
      
      unless valid_credentials?(auth_header)
        render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: :unauthorized
        return false
      end
      
      true
    end
    
    def valid_credentials?(auth_header)
      return false if auth_header.blank?
      
      credentials = Base64.decode64(auth_header.split(' ').last)
      username, password = credentials.split(':')
      
      username == CommerceML.configuration.username &&
        password == CommerceML.configuration.password
    end
    
    def process_import_file(file)
      temp_file = Tempfile.new('commerce_ml_import')
      temp_file.binmode
      temp_file.write(file.read)
      temp_file.rewind
      
      xml_content = if File.extname(file.original_filename) == '.zip'
                      extract_xml_from_zip(temp_file)
                    else
                      File.read(temp_file)
                    end
      
      parse_and_sync(xml_content)
    ensure
      temp_file&.close
      temp_file&.unlink
    end
    
    def extract_xml_from_zip(zip_file)
      require 'zip'
      
      Zip::File.open(zip_file.path) do |zip|
        xml_entry = zip.find { |entry| entry.name.end_with?('.xml') }
        raise 'No XML file found in archive' unless xml_entry
        
        xml_entry.get_input_stream.read
      end
    end
    
    def parse_and_sync(xml_content)
      doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
      
      # Визначаємо тип документа
      if doc.at_xpath('//Product')
        ProductSyncService.new(doc, current_store).sync!
        { imported: 'products' }
      elsif doc.at_xpath('//Price')
        PriceSyncService.new(doc, current_store).sync!
        { imported: 'prices' }
      elsif doc.at_xpath('//Order')
        OrderSyncService.new(doc, current_store).sync!
        { imported: 'orders' }
      else
        raise 'Unknown document format'
      end
    end
  end
end

text:
Here's a complete Ruby implementation for accepting installment payments from PrivatBank:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21.0'
gem 'json', '~> 2.6'
gem 'openssl', '~> 3.0'

## Implementation

### main.rb

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'digest'
require 'securerandom'

class PrivatBankInstallment
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://payparts2.privatbank.ua/ipp/v2'
  TEST_BASE_URL = 'https://payparts2.privatbank.ua/ipp/v2'
  
  attr_reader :store_id, :store_password, :test_mode
  
  def initialize(store_id:, store_password:, test_mode: false)
    @store_id = store_id
    @store_password = store_password
    @test_mode = test_mode
    self.class.base_uri(test_mode ? TEST_BASE_URL : BASE_URL)
  end
  
  # Create installment payment
  def create_payment(order_id:, amount:, products:, customer:, success_url:, fail_url:, parts_count: nil, merchant_type: nil)
    payload = {
      storeId: store_id,
      orderId: order_id,
      amount: amount.to_f.round(2),
      partsCount: parts_count || 1,
      merchantType: merchant_type || 'PP',
      products: format_products(products),
      customer: format_customer(customer),
      responseUrl: success_url,
      redirectUrl: fail_url,
      signature: nil
    }
    
    # Generate signature
    payload[:signature] = generate_signature(payload)
    
    response = self.class.post('/payment', 
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  # Check payment status
  def check_payment_status(payment_id: nil, order_id: nil)
    params = {
      storeId: store_id,
      signature: nil
    }
    
    if payment_id
      params[:paymentId] = payment_id
    elsif order_id
      params[:orderId] = order_id
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Either payment_id or order_id must be provided"
    end
    
    # Generate signature for status check
    params[:signature] = generate_signature(params)
    
    response = self.class.post('/check', 
      body: params.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get payment details
  def get_payment_details(payment_id)
    params = {
      storeId: store_id,
      paymentId: payment_id,
      signature: nil
    }
    
    params[:signature] = generate_signature(params)
    
    response = self.class.post('/details', 
      body: params.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  # Handle callback from PrivatBank
  def handle_callback(callback_data)
    # Verify signature
    unless verify_signature(callback_data)
      raise SecurityError, "Invalid signature"
    end
    
    # Process callback
    case callback_data['state']
    when 'SUCCESS'
      process_successful_payment(callback_data)
    when 'FAIL'
      process_failed_payment(callback_data)
    when 'PENDING'
      process_pending_payment(callback_data)
    when 'REJECTED'
      process_rejected_payment(callback_data)
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Unknown payment state: #{callback_data['state']}"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def format_products(products)
    products.map do |product|
      {
        name: product[:name],
        price: product[:price].to_f.round(2),
        count: product[:count] || 1
      }
    end
  end
  
  def format_customer(customer)
    {
      firstName: customer[:first_name],
      lastName: customer[:last_name],
      middleName: customer[:middle_name],
      phone: customer[:phone],
      email: customer[:email],
      address: customer[:address]
    }.compact
  end
  
  def generate_signature(params)
    # Remove signature field for signature generation
    params_to_sign = params.reject { |k, _| k.to_s == 'signature' }
    
    # Sort keys alphabetically
    sorted_params = params_to_sign.sort.to_h
    
    # Create signature string
    signature_string = sorted_params.map do |key, value|
      if value.is_a?(Hash) || value.is_a?(Array)
        "#{key}=#{JSON.generate(value)}"
      else
        "#{key}=#{value}"
      end
    end.join('&')
    
    # Add store password
    signature_string += store_password
    
    # Generate SHA1 hash
    Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(signature_string)
  end
  
  def verify_signature(callback_data)
    received_signature = callback_data['signature']
    return false unless received_signature
    
    # Remove signature from data for verification
    data_to_verify = callback_data.reject { |k, _| k == 'signature' }
    
    # Generate expected signature
    expected_signature = generate_signature(data_to_verify)
    
    # Compare signatures (case-insensitive)
    received_signature.downcase == expected_signature.downcase
  end

## Implementation

### 1. Configuration Module

```ruby
# config/nova_poshta_config.rb
require 'dotenv'
require 'logger'

module NovaPoshtaConfig
  Dotenv.load
  
  API_URL = 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'
  API_KEY = ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY'] || 'your_api_key_here'
  
  def self.logger
    @logger ||= Logger.new(STDOUT).tap do |log|
      log.level = Logger::INFO
      log.formatter = proc do |severity, datetime, progname, msg|
        "#{datetime}: #{severity} - #{msg}\n"
      end
    end
  end
  
  def self.validate_config!
    raise "NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY is not set" if API_KEY.nil? || API_KEY.empty? || API_KEY == 'your_api_key_here'
  end
end
```

### 2. API Client

```ruby
# lib/nova_poshta_api.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require_relative '../config/nova_poshta_config'

class NovaPoshtaApi
  include HTTParty
  base_uri NovaPoshtaConfig::API_URL
  format :json
  
  def initialize
    NovaPoshtaConfig.validate_config!
    @api_key = NovaPoshtaConfig::API_KEY
    @logger = NovaPoshtaConfig.logger
  end
  
  def create_return_shipment(original_tracking_number, return_reason, return_reason_ref = nil)
    @logger.info("Creating return shipment for tracking number: #{original_tracking_number}")
    
    # First, get the original shipment data
    original_shipment = get_shipment_details(original_tracking_number)
    raise "Original shipment not found" unless original_shipment
    
    # Prepare return shipment data
    return_data = prepare_return_data(original_shipment, return_reason, return_reason_ref)
    
    # Create the return request
    response = make_api_call('InternetDocument', 'save', return_data)
    
    if response['success']
      @logger.info("Return shipment created successfully: #{response['data'][0]['IntDocNumber']}")
      return response['data'][0]
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to create return shipment: #{response['errors'].inspect}")
      raise "Failed to create return shipment: #{response['errors'].inspect}"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def get_shipment_details(tracking_number)
    @logger.debug("Fetching original shipment details for: #{tracking_number}")
    
    request_data = {
      'apiKey' => @api_key,
      'modelName' => 'TrackingDocument',
      'calledMethod' => 'getStatusDocuments',
      'methodProperties' => {
        'Documents' => [
          {
            'DocumentNumber' => tracking_number,
            'Phone' => ''  # Optional: can be filled if needed
          }
        ]
      }
    }
    
    response = self.class.post('', body: request_data.to_json)
    parsed_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if parsed_response['success'] && parsed_response['data'].any?
      parsed_response['data'].first
    else
      @logger.warn("No shipment found for tracking number: #{tracking_number}")
      nil
    end
  end
  
  def prepare_return_data(original_shipment, return_reason, return_reason_ref)
    {
      'PayerType' => 'Recipient',  # Recipient pays for return
      'PaymentMethod' => 'Cash',
      'CargoType' => 'Cargo',
      'ServiceType' => 'WarehouseWarehouse',
      'SeatsAmount' => '1',
      'Description' => "Повернення: #{return_reason}",
      'Cost' => original_shipment['DocumentCost'] || '0',
      'CitySender' => original_shipment['CityRecipient'],
      'Sender' => original_shipment['RecipientAddress'],
      'SenderAddress' => original_shipment['RecipientAddress'],
      'ContactSender' => original_shipment['Recipient'],
      'SendersPhone' => original_shipment['RecipientPhone'],
      'CityRecipient' => original_shipment['CitySender'],
      'Recipient' => original_shipment['SenderAddress'],
      'RecipientAddress' => original_shipment['SenderAddress'],
      'ContactRecipient' => original_shipment['Sender'],
      'RecipientsPhone' => original_shipment['SenderPhone'],
      'BackwardDeliveryData' => [
        {
          'PayerType' => 'Recipient',
          'CargoType' => 'Money',
          'RedeliveryString' => original_shipment['DocumentCost'] || '0'
        }
      ]
    }
  end
  
  def make_api_call(model_name, called_method, method_properties)
    request_data = {
      'apiKey' => @api_key,
      'modelName' => model_name,
      'calledMethod' => called_method,
      'methodProperties' => method_properties
    }
    
    @logger.debug("Making API call: #{model_name}/#{called_method}")
    @logger.debug("Request data: #{request_data.inspect}")
    
    response = self.class.post('', body: request_data.to_json)
    parsed_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    @logger.debug("API Response: #{parsed_response.inspect}")
    
    parsed_response
  end
end
```

### 3. Return Shipment Service

```ruby
# lib/return_shipment_service.rb
require_relative 'nova_poshta_api'
require_relative '../config/nova_poshta_config'

class ReturnShipmentService
  RETURN_REASONS = {
    'wrong_item' => 'Неправильний товар',
    'damaged' => 'Пошкоджений товар',
    'not_needed' => 'Товар не потрібен',
    'size_issue' => 'Проблема з розміром',
    'quality_issue' => 'Проблема з якістю',
    'other' => 'Інша причина'
  }
  
  def initialize
    @api = NovaPoshtaApi.new
    @logger = NovaPoshtaConfig.logger
  end
  
  def create_return(original_tracking_number, return_reason_key, custom_reason = nil)
    validate_return_reason!(return_reason_key)
    
    return_reason = RETURN_REASONS[return_reason_key]
    return_reason += ": #{custom_reason}" if custom_reason && return_reason_key == 'other'
    
    @logger.info("Processing return request for shipment #{original_tracking_number}")
    @logger.info("Return reason: #{return_reason}")
    
    result = @api.create_return_shipment(
      original_tracking_number,
      return_reason,
      return_reason_key
    )
    
    format_result(result)
  rescue StandardError => e
    @logger.error("Error creating return shipment: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_return_reason!(reason_key)
    unless RETURN_REASONS.key?(reason_key)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid return reason. Available reasons: #{RETURN_REASONS.keys.join(', ')}"
    end
  end
  
  def format_result(result)
    {
      success: true,
      return_tracking_number: result['IntDocNumber'],
      return_ref: result['Ref'],
      cost_on_site: result['CostOnSite'],
      estimated_delivery_date: result['EstimatedDeliveryDate'],
      message: "Повернення успішно створено. Номер ТТН: #{result['IntDocNumber']}"
    }
  end
end

### 1. Конфігурація KeyCRM

```ruby
# config/initializers/keycrm.rb
module KeyCRM
  class << self
    attr_accessor :configuration
  end

  def self.configure
    self.configuration ||= Configuration.new
    yield(configuration)
  end

  class Configuration
    attr_accessor :api_key, :api_url, :webhook_secret, :timeout, :retry_attempts

    def initialize
      @api_key = ENV['KEYCRM_API_KEY']
      @api_url = ENV['KEYCRM_API_URL'] || 'https://api.keycrm.app/v1'
      @webhook_secret = ENV['KEYCRM_WEBHOOK_SECRET']
      @timeout = 30
      @retry_attempts = 3
    end
  end
end

KeyCRM.configure do |config|
  # Налаштування вже взяті з ENV
end
```

### 2. Клієнт API KeyCRM

```ruby
# app/services/keycrm/client.rb
module KeyCRM
  class Client
    include HTTParty
    
    base_uri KeyCRM.configuration.api_url
    headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    headers 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{KeyCRM.configuration.api_key}"
    
    default_timeout KeyCRM.configuration.timeout
    
    class << self
      def get_orders(params = {})
        handle_response { get('/orders', query: params) }
      end

      def get_order(order_id)
        handle_response { get("/orders/#{order_id}") }
      end

      def create_order(order_data)
        handle_response { post('/orders', body: order_data.to_json) }
      end

      def update_order(order_id, order_data)
        handle_response { put("/orders/#{order_id}", body: order_data.to_json) }
      end

      def delete_order(order_id)
        handle_response { delete("/orders/#{order_id}") }
      end

      def get_products(params = {})
        handle_response { get('/products', query: params) }
      end

      def get_customers(params = {})
        handle_response { get('/customers', query: params) }
      end

      def create_customer(customer_data)
        handle_response { post('/customers', body: customer_data.to_json) }
      end

      def update_customer(customer_id, customer_data)
        handle_response { put("/customers/#{customer_id}", body: customer_data.to_json) }
      end

      def get_order_statuses
        handle_response { get('/order-statuses') }
      end

      def get_payment_statuses
        handle_response { get('/payment-statuses') }
      end

      def get_delivery_methods
        handle_response { get('/delivery-methods') }
      end

      def create_order_note(order_id, note_data)
        handle_response { post("/orders/#{order_id}/notes", body: note_data.to_json) }
      end

      def add_order_product(order_id, product_data)
        handle_response { post("/orders/#{order_id}/products", body: product_data.to_json) }
      end

      private

      def handle_response
        response = yield
        handle_success(response)
      rescue HTTParty::Error, Net::OpenTimeout, Net::ReadTimeout => e
        handle_error(e)
      end

      def handle_success(response)
        case response.code
        when 200..299
          JSON.parse(response.body)
        when 400
          raise KeyCRM::BadRequestError, "Bad request: #{response.body}"
        when 401
          raise KeyCRM::UnauthorizedError, "Unauthorized: Check your API key"
        when 403
          raise KeyCRM::ForbiddenError, "Forbidden: You don't have permission"
        when 404
          raise KeyCRM::NotFoundError, "Not found: #{response.body}"
        when 429
          raise KeyCRM::RateLimitError, "Rate limit exceeded"
        when 500..599
          raise KeyCRM::ServerError, "Server error: #{response.body}"
        else
          raise KeyCRM::APIError, "Unexpected response: #{response.code}"
        end
      end

      def handle_error(error)
        raise KeyCRM::ConnectionError, "Connection error: #{error.message}"
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### 4. Сервіс синхронізації

```ruby
# app/services/keycrm/sync_service.rb
module KeyCRM
  class SyncService
    def initialize
      @client = Client
      @redis = Redis.new(url: ENV['REDIS_URL'])
    end

    def sync_order_to_keycrm(order)
      customer = find_or_create_customer(order.user)
      order_data = build_order_data(order, customer)
      
      result = @client.create_order(order_data)
      update_order_metadata(order, result['id'])
      
      result
    rescue KeyCRM::APIError => e
      Rails.logger.error("KeyCRM sync error: #{e.message}")
      schedule_retry(order.id)
      raise
    end

    def update_order_in_keycrm(order)
      keycrm_order_id = order.keycrm_order_id
      return unless keycrm_order_id

      customer = find_or_create_customer(order.user)
      order_data = build_order_data(order, customer)
      
      result = @client.update_order(keycrm_order_id, order_data)
      update_order_metadata(order, result['id'])
      
      result
    rescue KeyCRM::APIError => e
      Rails.logger.error("KeyCRM update error: #{e.message}")
      schedule_retry(order.id)
      raise
    end

    def sync_order_from_keycrm(keycrm_order_id)
      response = @client.get_order(keycrm_order_id)
      order_data = response['order'] || response
      
      order = find_local_order(order_data['source_uuid'])
      return unless order

      update_local_order(order, order_data)
      order
    end

    def sync_products_to_keycrm(products)
      products.each do |product|
        product_data = build_product_data(product)
        @client.create_product(product_data)
      end
    end

    def sync_customers_to_keycrm(customers)
      customers.each do |customer|
        customer_data = build_customer_data(customer)
        @client.create_customer(customer_data)
      end
    end

    private

    def find_or_create_customer(user)
      return nil unless user

      customer_data = build_customer_data(user)
      
      begin
        customers = @client.get_customers(email: user.email)
        if customers['data']&.any?
          customers['data'].first
        else
          @client.create_customer(customer_data)
        end
      rescue KeyCRM::NotFoundError
        @client.create_customer(customer_data)
      end
    end

    def build_order_data(order, customer)
      {
        source_id: ENV['KEYCRM_SOURCE_ID'],
        source_uuid: order.id.to_s,
        status: map_order_status(order.status),
        payment_status: map_payment_status(order.payment_status),
        customer_id: customer&.dig('id'),
        total: order.total.to_f,
        currency: order.currency || 'UAH',
        products: order.order_items.map { |item| build_product_data(item) },
        notes: build_notes(order),
        delivery_method: map_delivery_method(order.delivery_method),
        payment_method: map_payment_method(order.payment_method),
        created_at: order.created_at.iso8601,
        updated_at: order.updated_at.iso8601
      }.compact
    end

    def build_product_data(product)
      {
        name: product.name,
        sku: product.sku,
        price: product.price.to_f,
        quantity: product.quantity,
        external_id: product.id.to_s,
        description: product.description
      }.compact
    end

    def build_customer_data(customer)
      {
        email: customer.email,
        phone: customer.phone,
        first_name: customer.first_name,
        last_name: customer.last_name,
        external_id: customer.id.to_s
      }.compact
    end

    def build_notes(order)
      notes = []
      notes << "Order ##{order.number}" if order.number
      notes << "Customer note: #{order.customer_note}" if order.customer_note
      notes.join("\n")
    end

    def map_order_status(status)
      status_mapping = {
        'pending' => 'new',
        'processing' => 'in_progress',
        'completed' => 'done',
        'cancelled' => 'cancelled',
        'refunded' => 'refunded'
      }
      status_mapping[status] || status
    end

    def map_payment_status(status)
      status_mapping = {
        'pending' => 'not_paid',
        'paid' => 'paid',
        'refunded' => 'refunded',
        'failed' => 'failed'
      }
      status_mapping[status] || status
    end

    def map_delivery_method(method)
      method_mapping = {
        'nova_poshta' => 'nova_poshta',
        'ukrposhta' => 'ukrposhta',
        'courier' => 'courier',
        'pickup' => 'pickup'
      }
      method_mapping[method] || method
    end

    def map_payment_method(method)
      method_mapping = {
        'card' => 'card',
        'cash' => 'cash',
        'bank_transfer' => 'bank_transfer',
        'paypal' => 'paypal'
      }
      method_mapping[method] || method
    end

    def update_order_metadata(order, keycrm_order_id)
      order.update_column(:keycrm_order_id, keycrm_order_id)
      order.update_column(:keycrm_synced_at, Time.current)
    end

    def find_local_order(source_uuid)
      return unless source_uuid
      Order.find_by(id: source_uuid)
    end

    def update_local_order(order, order_data)
      order.update(
        status: reverse_map_status(order_data['status']),
        payment_status: reverse_map_payment_status(order_data['payment_status']),
        total: order_data['total']
      )
    end

    def reverse_map_status(status)
      status_mapping = {
        'new' => 'pending',
        'in_progress' => 'processing',
        'done' => 'completed',
        'cancelled' => 'cancelled',
        'refunded' => 'refunded'
      }
      status_mapping[status] || status
    end

    def reverse_map_payment_status(status)
      status_mapping = {
        'not_paid' => 'pending',
        'paid' => 'paid',
        'refunded' => 'refunded',
        'failed' => 'failed'
      }
      status_mapping[status] || status
    end

    def schedule_retry(order_id)
      retry_count = @redis.incr("keycrm:retry:#{order_id}")
      if retry_count <= KeyCRM.configuration.retry_attempts
        delay = [2 ** retry_count, 3600].min
        SyncWorker.perform_in(delay.minutes, order_id)
      else
        @redis.del("keycrm:retry:#{order_id}")
        Rails.logger.error("KeyCRM sync failed permanently for order #{order_id}")
        # Можна додати сповіщення адміністратору
      end
    end

    def clear_retry_counter(order_id)
      @redis.del("keycrm:retry:#{order_id}")
    end
  end
end
```

### 5. Фоновий воркер для синхронізації

```ruby
# app/workers/keycrm/sync_worker.rb
module KeyCRM
  class SyncWorker
    include Sidekiq::Worker
    
    sidekiq_options queue: :keycrm_sync, retry: false

    def perform(order_id)
      order = Order.find_by(id: order_id)
      return unless order

      sync_service = SyncService.new
      
      if order.keycrm_order_id.present?
        sync_service.update_order_in_keycrm(order)
      else
        sync_service.sync_order_to_keycrm(order)
      end
    rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
      Rails.logger.warn("Order #{order_id} not found for KeyCRM sync")
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error("KeyCRM sync worker error: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end
end
```

### 6. Контролер для вебхуків

```ruby
# app/controllers/keycrm/webhooks_controller.rb
module KeyCRM
  class WebhooksController < ApplicationController
    skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
    before_action :verify_webhook_signature

    def order_updated
      payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      order_id = payload.dig('data', 'id')
      
      if order_id
        SyncFromKeyCRMWorker.perform_async(order_id)
        render json: { status: 'accepted' }, status: :ok
      else
        render json: { error: 'Invalid payload' }, status: :bad_request
      end
    end

    def order_created
      payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      order_id = payload.dig('data', 'id')
      
      if order_id
        SyncFromKeyCRMWorker.perform_async(order_id)
        render json: { status: 'accepted' }, status: :ok
      else
        render json: { error: 'Invalid payload' }, status: :bad_request
      end
    end

    def order_deleted
      payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      order_uuid = payload.dig('data', 'source_uuid')
      
      if order_uuid
        HandleDeletedOrderWorker.perform_async(order_uuid)
        render json: { status: 'accepted' }, status: :ok
      else
        render json: { error: 'Invalid payload' }, status: :bad_request
      end
    end

    private

    def verify_webhook_signature
      signature = request.headers['X-KeyCRM-Signature']
      payload = request.body.read
      request.body.rewind
      
      expected_signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(
        'SHA256',
        KeyCRM.configuration.webhook_secret,
        payload
      )
      
      unless ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(signature.to_s, expected_signature)
        render json: { error: 'Invalid signature' }, status: :unauthorized
      end
    end
  end
end

class WayForPayService
  include HTTParty
  
  base_uri 'https://api.wayforpay.com/api'
  headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  
  def initialize
    @merchant_account = ENV['WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT']
    @merchant_secret = ENV['WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_SECRET']
    @merchant_domain = ENV['WAYFORPAY_MERCHANT_DOMAIN']
    @service_url = ENV['WAYFORPAY_SERVICE_URL']
    @return_url = ENV['WAYFORPAY_RETURN_URL']
  end
  
  def create_payment(order)
    payload = build_payment_payload(order)
    signature = generate_signature(payload)
    payload[:merchantSignature] = signature
    
    response = self.class.post('/pay', body: payload.to_json)
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  def verify_payment(params)
    payload = build_verification_payload(params)
    signature = generate_signature(payload)
    payload[:merchantSignature] = signature
    
    response = self.class.post('/verify', body: payload.to_json)
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_payment_payload(order)
    {
      merchantAccount: @merchant_account,
      merchantDomainName: @merchant_domain,
      merchantTransactionSecureType: 'AUTO',
      merchantTransactionType: 'SALE',
      merchantSignature: '',
      orderReference: order.order_number,
      orderDate: Time.current.to_i,
      amount: order.amount.to_f,
      currency: order.currency,
      productName: [order.product_description || "Order #{order.order_number}"],
      productPrice: [order.amount.to_f],
      productCount: [1],
      serviceUrl: @service_url,
      returnUrl: @return_url,
      clientEmail: order.customer_email,
      clientPhone: order.customer_phone,
      clientFirstName: order.customer_name&.split(' ')&.first,
      clientLastName: order.customer_name&.split(' ')&.last
    }.compact
  end
  
  def build_verification_payload(params)
    {
      merchantAccount: @merchant_account,
      orderReference: params[:orderReference],
      amount: params[:amount],
      currency: params[:currency],
      authCode: params[:authCode],
      cardPan: params[:cardPan],
      transactionStatus: params[:transactionStatus],
      reasonCode: params[:reasonCode]
    }
  end
  
  def generate_signature(payload)
    signature_string = [
      @merchant_account,
      payload[:merchantDomainName] || @merchant_domain,
      payload[:orderReference],
      payload[:orderDate],
      payload[:amount],
      payload[:currency],
      payload[:productName]&.join(';'),
      payload[:productCount]&.join(';'),
      payload[:productPrice]&.join(';')
    ].compact.join(';')
    
    OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('MD5', @merchant_secret, signature_string)
  end
  
  def parse_response(response)
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
    else
      { error: true, message: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}" }
    end
  end
end
```

### app.rb

```ruby
require_relative 'config/environment'
require_relative 'models/order'
require_relative 'services/wayforpay_service'

class PaymentApp < Sinatra::Base
  register Sinatra::ActiveRecordExtension
  
  configure do
    set :show_exceptions, false
    set :raise_errors, false
    set :protection, except: :json_csrf
    enable :sessions
  end
  
  error do
    content_type :json
    status 500
    { error: true, message: env['sinatra.error'].message }.to_json
  end
  
  # Create payment endpoint
  post '/api/payments' do
    content_type :json
    
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
    
    order = Order.new(
      order_number: data[:order_number] || SecureRandom.hex(8),
      amount: data[:amount],
      currency: data[:currency] || 'UAH',
      product_description: data[:product_description],
      customer_email: data[:customer_email],
      customer_phone: data[:customer_phone],
      customer_name: data[:customer_name],
      status: :pending
    )
    
    unless order.save
      status 422
      return { error: true, message: order.errors.full_messages }.to_json
    end
    
    wayforpay = WayForPayService.new
    payment_response = wayforpay.create_payment(order)
    
    if payment_response[:error]
      order.mark_as_failed!(payment_response[:message])
      status 500
      return payment_response.to_json
    end
    
    # Store transaction data
    order.update!(
      merchant_transaction_id: payment_response[:merchantTransactionId],
      wayforpay_transaction_id: payment_response[:transactionId],
      raw_response: payment_response.to_json
    )
    
    {
      success: true,
      order: order.as_json,
      payment_url: payment_response[:paymentUrl]
    }.to_json
  end
  
  # Service URL - WayForPay callback endpoint
  post '/api/payments/callback' do
    content_type :json
    
    params = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
    
    # Find the order
    order = Order.find_by(order_number: params[:orderReference])
    
    unless order
      status 404
      return { error: true, message: 'Order not found' }.to_json
    end
    
    # Verify the payment with WayForPay
    wayforpay = WayForPayService.new
    verification = wayforpay.verify_payment(params)
    
    # Check transaction status
    transaction_status = params[:transactionStatus] || verification[:transactionStatus]
    
    case transaction_status
    when 'Approved'
      # Payment approved - confirm the order
      order.update!(
        wayforpay_transaction_id: params[:transactionId] || verification[:transactionId],
        raw_response: params.to_json
      )
      order.mark_as_completed!
      
      # Here you can trigger additional actions:
      # - Send confirmation email
      # - Update inventory
      # - Notify other systems
      
      logger.info "Order #{order.order_number} completed successfully"
      
      { success: true, order: order.as_json }.to_json
      
    when 'Declined', 'Expired', 'Refunded', 'Voided'
      # Payment failed
      order.mark_as_failed!(params[:reason] || params[:reasonCode])
      
      logger.warn "Order #{order.order_number} failed: #{params[:reason]}"
      
      { success: false, message: 'Payment failed', order: order.as_json }.to_json
      
    when 'InProcessing', 'Pending', 'WaitingAuthComplete'
      # Payment is still processing
      order.update!(status: :processing, raw_response: params.to_json)
      
      { success: true, message: 'Payment processing', order: order.as_json }.to_json
      
    else
      # Unknown status
      logger.error "Unknown transaction status: #{transaction_status}"
      { success: false, message: 'Unknown transaction status' }.to_json
    end
  end
  
  # Get order status
  get '/api/orders/:order_number' do
    content_type :json
    
    order = Order.find_by(order_number: params[:order_number])
    
    unless order
      status 404
      return { error: true, message: 'Order not found' }.to_json
    end
    
    order.as_json.to_json
  end
  
  # Health check
  get '/health' do
    content_type :json
    { status: 'ok', timestamp: Time.current }.to_json
  end
end

```markdown
# WayForPay Payment Integration

## Setup

1. Install dependencies:
```bash
bundle install
```

2. Create database and run migrations:
```bash
rake db:create
rake db:migrate
```

3. Configure environment variables:
```bash
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env with your WayForPay credentials
```

4. Start the server:
```bash
rackup -p 4567
```

## API Endpoints

### Create Payment
```bash
POST /api/payments
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "amount": 100.50,
  "currency": "UAH",
  "product_description": "Product Name",
  "customer_email": "customer@example.com",
  "customer_phone": "+380123456789",
  "customer_name": "John Doe"
}
```

### Payment Callback (Service URL)
WayForPay will automatically POST to this endpoint when payment status changes.

### Get Order Status
```bash
GET /api/orders/{order_number}
```

## Flow

1. Client creates payment via `/api/payments`
2. Client is redirected to WayForPay payment page
3. After payment, WayForPay calls the service URL
4. If status is "Approved", order is marked as completed
5. If status indicates failure, order is marked as failed
```

This implementation provides:

1. **Complete WayForPay integration** with proper signature generation
2. **Order management** with status tracking
3. **Payment callback handling** that confirms orders on approval
4. **Database persistence** using SQLite (easily switchable to PostgreSQL/MySQL)
5. **Security** with proper signature verification
6. **Error handling** for various payment scenarios
7. **RESTful API** for payment creation and status checking

The service URL endpoint (`/api/payments/callback`) handles the WayForPay notification and confirms orders when the transaction status is "Approved".

# ehealth_declaration.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class EHealthDeclaration
  include HTTParty
  
  # Базові налаштування API
  base_uri ENV['EHEALTH_API_URL'] || 'https://api.ehealth.gov.ua'
  
  attr_reader :logger
  
  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end
  
  # Метод для створення медичної декларації
  def create_declaration(patient_data, doctor_data, declaration_data)
    begin
      # Отримуємо токен доступу
      token = get_access_token
      
      # Формуємо запит на створення декларації
      response = self.class.post(
        '/api/v2/declarations',
        headers: auth_headers(token),
        body: build_declaration_payload(patient_data, doctor_data, declaration_data).to_json
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error("Помилка при створенні декларації: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  # Отримання токену доступу
  def get_access_token
    response = self.class.post(
      '/auth/tokens',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'API-KEY' => ENV['EHEALTH_API_KEY']
      },
      body: {
        token: {
          client_id: ENV['EHEALTH_CLIENT_ID'],
          client_secret: ENV['EHEALTH_CLIENT_SECRET']
        }
      }.to_json
    )
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['data']['token']
    else
      raise "Помилка отримання токену: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Формування заголовків для авторизації
  def auth_headers(token)
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}",
      'API-KEY' => ENV['EHEALTH_API_KEY']
    }
  end
  
  # Побудова payload для декларації
  def build_declaration_payload(patient_data, doctor_data, declaration_data)
    {
      data: {
        type: 'declarations',
        attributes: {
          start_date: declaration_data[:start_date],
          end_date: declaration_data[:end_date],
          status: 'active',
          declaration_number: declaration_data[:declaration_number],
          scope_of_services: declaration_data[:scope_of_services] || 'primary_care',
          is_active: true
        },
        relationships: {
          person: {
            data: {
              type: 'persons',
              id: patient_data[:person_id]
            }
          },
          employee: {
            data: {
              type: 'employees',
              id: doctor_data[:employee_id]
            }
          },
          division: {
            data: {
              type: 'divisions',
              id: doctor_data[:division_id]
            }
          },
          legal_entity: {
            data: {
              type: 'legal_entities',
              id: doctor_data[:legal_entity_id]
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  end
  
  # Обробка відповіді
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200, 201
      logger.info("Декларація успішно створена")
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise "Помилка авторизації: #{response.body}"
    when 422
      raise "Помилка валідації: #{response.body}"
    when 409
      raise "Конфлікт даних: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise "Невідома помилка (#{response.code}): #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Ініціалізація клієнта
  client = EHealthDeclaration.new
  
  # Дані пацієнта
  patient_data = {
    person_id: 'person-uuid-here'
  }
  
  # Дані лікаря
  doctor_data = {
    employee_id: 'employee-uuid-here',
    division_id: 'division-uuid-here',
    legal_entity_id: 'legal-entity-uuid-here'
  }
  
  # Дані декларації
  declaration_data = {

  begin

  rescue => e

```ruby
# rozetka_sync.rb
require 'faraday'
require 'faraday/net_http'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'
require 'logger'

Dotenv.load

# Client for the Rozetka marketplace seller API.
# Adjust endpoint paths and status names according to the official API docs.
class RozetkaClient
  BASE_URL = ENV.fetch('ROZETKA_API_URL', 'https://api.seller.rozetka.com.ua')
  API_TOKEN = ENV.fetch('ROZETKA_API_TOKEN')

  def initialize(token: API_TOKEN, base_url: BASE_URL, logger: Logger.new($stdout))
    @logger = logger
    @connection = Faraday.new(url: base_url) do |conn|
      conn.request :json
      conn.response :raise_error
      conn.response :json, content_type: /\bjson$/
      conn.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{token}"
      conn.headers['Accept'] = 'application/json'
      conn.adapter :net_http
    end
  end

  # Fetches one page of orders. Returns an array of order hashes.
  def fetch_orders(status: 'new', page: 1, per_page: 100)
    response = @connection.get('/orders', status: status, page: page, per_page: per_page)
    parse_orders(response.body)
  rescue Faraday::Error => e
    @logger.error("Failed to fetch orders (status=#{status}, page=#{page}): #{e.message}")
    raise
  end

  # Updates the status of a single order.
  def update_order_status(order_id, new_status)
    response = @connection.patch("/orders/#{order_id}/status") do |req|
      req.body = { status: new_status }
    end
    response.body
  rescue Faraday::Error => e
    @logger.error("Failed to update order #{order_id}: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end

  private

  # Rozetka may wrap the orders array under different keys depending on the API version.
  def parse_orders(body)
    case body
    when Hash
      body['orders'] || body['items'] || body['data'] || [] rescue []
    when Array
      body
    else
      []
    end
  end
end

# Processes new orders and moves them to the configured next status.
class OrderStatusUpdater
  DEFAULT_TARGET_STATUS = ENV.fetch('ROZETKA_NEXT_STATUS', 'accepted')

  def initialize(client, target_status: DEFAULT_TARGET_STATUS, logger: Logger.new($stdout))
    @client = client
    @target_status = target_status
    @logger = logger
  end

  def process_new_orders
    page = 1
    loop do
      orders = @client.fetch_orders(status: 'new', page: page, per_page: 100)
      break if orders.empty?

      orders.each { |order| update_order(order) }
      page += 1
    end
  end

  private

  def update_order(order)
    order_id = order['id'] || order['order_id'] || order['number']

    if order_id.nil?
      @logger.warn("Order without a recognizable id, skipping: #{order.inspect}")
      return false
    end

    @logger.info("Updating order #{order_id} to status #{@target_status}")
    result = @client.update_order_status(order_id, @target_status)
    @logger.info("Order #{order_id} updated successfully: #{result.inspect}")
    true
  rescue => e
    @logger.error("Failed to update order #{order_id}: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
    false
  end
end

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  logger = Logger.new($stdout)
  logger.level = ENV.fetch('LOG_LEVEL', Logger::INFO)

  client = RozetkaClient.new(logger: logger)
  updater = OrderStatusUpdater.new(client, logger: logger)

  logger.info('Starting Rozetka order synchronization')
  updater.process_new_orders
  logger.info('Synchronization finished')
end

      Олена Наталія Тетяна Ірина Оксана Галина Марія Анна Людмила Світлана
      Шевченко Коваленко Бондаренко Ткаченко Кравчук Поліщук Шевчук Лисенко
      Мельник Ковальчук Бойко Павленко Савченко Руденко Пономаренко Мороз
      Зеленський Порошенко Тимошенко Гройсман Яценюк Аваков Кличко Ляшко
    ].freeze

    # Ukrainian organization keywords
    ORGANIZATION_KEYWORDS = %w[
      Міністерство Комітет Агентство Служба Фонд Асоціація Спілка Партія
      Рух Блок Коаліція Адміністрація Управління Департамент Відділ
      Центр Інститут Університет Академія Банк Компанія Корпорація
    ].freeze

    # Ukrainian location keywords
    LOCATION_KEYWORDS = %w[
      Київ Львів Харків Одеса Дніпро Запоріжжя Вінниця Полтава Чернігів
      Житомир Суми Херсон Миколаїв Луцьк Рівне Тернопіль Івано-Франківськ
      Ужгород Чернівці Кропивницький Черкаси Хмельницький
    ].freeze

    def initialize
      @person_patterns = PERSON_PATTERNS
      @organization_patterns = ORGANIZATION_PATTERNS
      @location_patterns = LOCATION_PATTERNS
    end

    def extract(text)
      return { people: [], organizations: [], places: [] } if text.nil? || text.empty?

      {
        people: extract_people(text),
        organizations: extract_organizations(text),
        places: extract_places(text)
      }
    end

    def extract_from_url(url)
      response = HTTParty.get(url, timeout: 10)
      return { people: [], organizations: [], places: [] } unless response.success?

      html = Nokogiri::HTML(response.body)
      
      # Extract main content (remove scripts, styles, navigation)
      html.css('script, style, nav, header, footer, aside').remove
      
      # Try to find main article content
      main_content = html.css('article, .article, .content, main, .post').first || html
      
      text = main_content.text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip
      extract(text)
    end

    def extract_batch(texts, max_threads: 4)
      pool = Concurrent::FixedThreadPool.new(max_threads)
      results = Concurrent::Array.new

      texts.each do |text|
        pool.post do
          results << extract(text)
        end
      end

      pool.shutdown
      pool.wait_for_termination

      results
    end

    private

    def extract_people(text)
      people = []
      
      # Pattern-based extraction
      @person_patterns.each do |pattern|
        text.scan(pattern) do |match|
          name = match.is_a?(Array) ? match.first : match
          people << name.strip if valid_person_name?(name)
        end
      end

      # Dictionary-based extraction
      words = text.split(/\s+/)
      words.each_with_index do |word, index|
        if UKRAINIAN_NAMES.include?(word) && index + 1 < words.length
          next_word = words[index + 1]
          if valid_surname?(next_word)
            people << "#{word} #{next_word}"
          end
        end
      end

      people.uniq
    end

    def extract_organizations(text)
      organizations = []
      
      # Pattern-based extraction
      @organization_patterns.each do |pattern|
        text.scan(pattern) do |match|
          org = match.is_a?(Array) ? match.first : match
          organizations << org.strip if valid_organization_name?(org)
        end
      end

      # Dictionary-based extraction
      ORGANIZATION_KEYWORDS.each do |keyword|
        pattern = /\b#{Regexp.escape(keyword)}\s+([«"]?[А-ЯІЇЄҐA-Z][^»",.!?]{2,50}[»"]?)/
        text.scan(pattern) do |match|
          org_name = "#{keyword} #{match.first}".strip
          organizations << org_name
        end
      end

      organizations.uniq
    end

    def extract_places(text)
      places = []
      
      # Pattern-based extraction
      @location_patterns.each do |pattern|
        text.scan(pattern) do |match|
          place = match.is_a?(Array) ? match.first : match
          places << place.strip if valid_location_name?(place)
        end
      end

      # Dictionary-based extraction
      LOCATION_KEYWORDS.each do |location|
        places << location if text.include?(location)
      end

      places.uniq
    end

    def valid_person_name?(name)
      return false if name.nil? || name.empty?
      
      # Check for valid Ukrainian name format
      parts = name.split(/\s+/)
      return false if parts.length < 2
      
      # Check if it's not an organization or location
      !ORGANIZATION_KEYWORDS.any? { |kw| name.include?(kw) } &&
      !LOCATION_KEYWORDS.any? { |loc| name == loc }
    end

    def valid_surname?(word)
      return false unless word
      
      # Ukrainian surnames typically end with specific suffixes
      word.match?(/(енко|ук|юк|ич|ів|ов|єв|ський|цький|зький|ович|евич)$/) ||
      UKRAINIAN_NAMES.include?(word)
    end

    def valid_organization_name?(name)
      return false if name.nil? || name.empty?
      
      # Check if it contains organization keywords or common patterns
      ORGANIZATION_KEYWORDS.any? { |kw| name.include?(kw) } ||
      name.match?(/(компанія|корпорація|фірма|підприємство|організація|установа|відомство|міністерство|агентство|служба|фонд|асоціація|спілка|партія|рух|блок|коаліція)/i)
    end

    def valid_location_name?(name)
      return false if name.nil? || name.empty?
      
      # Check if it's not a person name
      !UKRAINIAN_NAMES.include?(name.split(/\s+/).first) &&
      # Check if it's not an organization
      !ORGANIZATION_KEYWORDS.any? { |kw| name.include?(kw) }
    end
  end

  class ArticleProcessor
    def initialize
      @extractor = EntityExtractor.new
    end

    def process_article(title:, body:, url: nil)
      full_text = [title, body].compact.join("\n")
      entities = @extractor.extract(full_text)
      
      {
        url: url,
        title: title,
        entities: entities,
        processed_at: Time.now
      }
    end

    def process_articles(articles)
      articles.map { |article| process_article(**article) }
    end
  end
end

```ruby
require 'optparse'
require 'json'

module UkrainianNER
  class CLI
    def self.run(args)
      options = {
        input: nil,
        output: 'stdout',
        format: 'json',
        url: nil
      }

      parser = OptionParser.new do |opts|
        opts.banner = "Usage: ukrainian_ner [options]"
        
        opts.on("-i", "--input FILE", "Input file path") do |file|
          options[:input] = file
        end
        
        opts.on("-u", "--url URL", "Process article from URL") do |url|
          options[:url] = url
        end
        
        opts.on("-o", "--output FILE", "Output file path") do |file|
          options[:output] = file
        end
        
        opts.on("-f", "--format FORMAT", "Output format (json, text)") do |format|
          options[:format] = format
        end
        
        opts.on("-h", "--help", "Show this help message") do
          puts opts
          exit
        end
      end

      parser.parse!(args)
      
      extractor = EntityExtractor.new
      
      if options[:url]
        result = extractor.extract_from_url(options[:url])
      elsif options[:input]
        text = File.read(options[:input])
        result = extractor.extract(text)
      else
        puts "Error: Please provide input file or URL"
        puts parser
        exit 1
      end
      
      output = format_result(result, options[:format])
      
      if options[:output] == 'stdout'
        puts output
      else
        File.write(options[:output], output)
      end
    end

    private

    def self.format_result(result, format)
      case format
      when 'json'
        JSON.pretty_generate(result)
      when 'text'
        format_text(result)
      else
        JSON.pretty_generate(result)
      end
    end

    def self.format_text(result)
      output = "Named Entities Found:\n\n"
      
      output += "People:\n"
      result[:people].each { |person| output += "  - #{person}\n" }
      
      output += "\nOrganizations:\n"
      result[:organizations].each { |org| output += "  - #{org}\n" }
      
      output += "\nPlaces:\n"
      result[:places].each { |place| output += "  - #{place}\n" }
      
      output
    end
  end
end

text:
```ruby
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

# Rails includes ActiveSupport and I18n, but we list it for a complete environment
gem "rails", "~> 7.1"
gem "i18n", "~> 1.14"
```

```ruby
# config/initializers/pluralization.rb

require "i18n/backend/pluralization"

# Enable pluralization support on the Simple backend (Rails default)
I18n::Backend::Simple.include(I18n::Backend::Pluralization)

# Store the Ukrainian pluralization rule
I18n.backend.store_translations(:uk, {
  i18n: {
    plural: {
      rule: lambda do |count|
        # Only integer or integer-valued Numeric counts follow the CLDR rules.
        # Fractional counts (e.g. 1.5) always use :other.
        if count.is_a?(Numeric) && count == count.to_i
          n = count.to_i
          mod10  = n % 10
          mod100 = n % 100

          if mod10 == 1 && mod100 != 11
            :one
          elsif (2..4).cover?(mod10) && !(12..14).cover?(mod100)
            :few
          elsif mod10 == 0 || (5..9).cover?(mod10) || (11..14).cover?(mod100)
            :many
          else
            :other
          end
        else
          :other
        end
      end
    }
  }
})

# Optional: ensure :uk is an available locale
I18n.available_locales = [:uk, :en]

require 'sequel'

class Tender < Sequel::Model(:tenders)
  plugin :timestamps, update_on_create: true
  
  def self.create_table
    DB.create_table? :tenders do
      primary_key :id
      String :tender_id, unique: true, null: false
      String :title
      Text :description
      String :status
      String :procurement_type
      String :procuring_entity_name
      String :procuring_entity_id
      Decimal :value_amount, size: [15, 2]
      String :value_currency
      DateTime :tender_start_date
      DateTime :tender_end_date
      DateTime :enquiry_start_date
      DateTime :enquiry_end_date
      DateTime :award_start_date
      DateTime :award_end_date
      String :date_modified
      Jsonb :items
      Jsonb :documents
      Jsonb :awards
      Jsonb :contracts
      Jsonb :additional_data
      DateTime :created_at
      DateTime :updated_at
      
      index :tender_id
      index :status
      index :procurement_type
      index :tender_start_date
      index :date_modified
    end
  end
  
  def self.from_api_response(data)
    find_or_create(tender_id: data['id']) do |tender|
      tender.update_from_api(data)
    end
  end
  
  def update_from_api(data)
    self.title = data['title']
    self.description = data['description']
    self.status = data['status']
    self.procurement_type = data['procurementMethodType']
    self.procuring_entity_name = data.dig('procuringEntity', 'name')
    self.procuring_entity_id = data.dig('procuringEntity', 'identifier', 'id')
    
    if data['value']
      self.value_amount = data.dig('value', 'amount')
      self.value_currency = data.dig('value', 'currency')
    end
    
    self.tender_start_date = parse_date(data.dig('tenderPeriod', 'startDate'))
    self.tender_end_date = parse_date(data.dig('tenderPeriod', 'endDate'))
    self.enquiry_start_date = parse_date(data.dig('enquiryPeriod', 'startDate'))
    self.enquiry_end_date = parse_date(data.dig('enquiryPeriod', 'endDate'))
    self.award_start_date = parse_date(data.dig('awardPeriod', 'startDate'))
    self.award_end_date = parse_date(data.dig('awardPeriod', 'endDate'))
    
    self.date_modified = data['dateModified']
    self.items = data['items'] || []
    self.documents = data['documents'] || []
    self.awards = data['awards'] || []
    self.contracts = data['contracts'] || []
    
    # Зберігаємо інші поля в additional_data
    known_fields = %w[id title description status procurementMethodType 
                     procuringEntity value tenderPeriod enquiryPeriod 
                     awardPeriod dateModified items documents awards contracts]
    self.additional_data = data.reject { |key, _| known_fields.include?(key) }
    
    save
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.parse_date(date_string)
    DateTime.parse(date_string) if date_string
  rescue ArgumentError
    nil
  end
end

### services/prozorro_api.rb

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

class ProzorroApi
  include HTTParty
  
  base_uri 'https://public.api.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5'
  
  attr_reader :logger
  
  def initialize(logger: Logger.new(STDOUT))
    @logger = logger
  end
  
  def fetch_tenders(options = {})
    query = build_query(options)
    
    logger.info("Fetching tenders with query: #{query}")
    
    response = self.class.get('/tenders', query: query)
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    else
      logger.error("API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}")
      raise "Prozorro API error: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
  
  def fetch_all_tenders(options = {})
    tenders = []
    page = 1
    total_pages = 1
    
    loop do
      options[:page] = page
      response = fetch_tenders(options)
      
      tenders.concat(response['data'] || [])
      
      total_pages = (response.dig('data', 'totalPages') || 1).to_i
      page += 1
      
      break if page > total_pages
      
      sleep(0.5) # Rate limiting
    end
    
    tenders
  end
  
  def fetch_tender(tender_id)
    logger.info("Fetching tender #{tender_id}")
    
    response = self.class.get("/tenders/#{tender_id}")
    
    if response.success?
      JSON.parse(response.body)['data']
    else
      logger.error("API Error for tender #{tender_id}: #{response.code}")
      nil
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_query(options = {})
    query = {
      'page' => options[:page] || 1,
      'limit' => options[:limit] || 100,
      'offset' => options[:offset]
    }.compact
    
    # Додаємо фільтри
    query['filter[status]'] = options[:status] if options[:status]
    query['filter[procurementMethodType]'] = options[:procurement_type] if options[:procurement_type]
    query['filter[dateModified]'] = options[:date_modified] if options[:date_modified]
    query['filter[tenderPeriod.startDate]'] = options[:start_date] if options[:start_date]
    query['filter[tenderPeriod.endDate]'] = options[:end_date] if options[:end_date]
    
    query
  end
end

### services/tender_service.rb

```ruby
require 'concurrent'
require 'logger'

class TenderService
  attr_reader :api, :logger
  
  def initialize(api: ProzorroApi.new, logger: Logger.new(STDOUT))
    @api = api
    @logger = logger
  end
  
  def sync_tenders(options = {})
    logger.info("Starting tender synchronization")
    
    tenders_data = api.fetch_all_tenders(options)
    logger.info("Fetched #{tenders_data.size} tenders")
    
    new_tenders = 0
    updated_tenders = 0
    errors = []
    
    tenders_data.each do |tender_data|
      begin
        tender = Tender.from_api_response(tender_data)
        
        if tender.new?
          new_tenders += 1
          logger.info("New tender created: #{tender.tender_id}")
        else
          updated_tenders += 1
          logger.info("Tender updated: #{tender.tender_id}")
        end
      rescue => e
        errors << { tender_id: tender_data['id'], error: e.message }
        logger.error("Error processing tender #{tender_data['id']}: #{e.message}")
      end
    end
    
    {
      total: tenders_data.size,
      new: new_tenders,
      updated: updated_tenders,
      errors: errors
    }
  end
  
  def sync_tenders_async(options = {})
    logger.info("Starting async tender synchronization")
    
    tenders_data = api.fetch_all_tenders(options)
    logger.info("Fetched #{tenders_data.size} tenders for async processing")
    
    pool = Concurrent::FixedThreadPool.new(5)
    results = Concurrent::Array.new
    
    tenders_data.each do |tender_data|
      pool.post do
        begin
          tender = Tender.from_api_response(tender_data)
          results << { tender_id: tender.tender_id, status: 'success' }
        rescue => e
          results << { tender_id: tender_data['id'], status: 'error', error: e.message }
          logger.error("Error in async processing tender #{tender_data['id']}: #{e.message}")
        end
      end
    end
    
    pool.shutdown
    pool.wait_for_termination
    
    {
      processed: results.size,
      successful: results.count { |r| r[:status] == 'success' },
      failed: results.count { |r| r[:status] == 'error' },
      results: results
    }
  end
  
  def sync_specific_tender(tender_id)
    logger.info("Syncing specific tender: #{tender_id}")
    
    tender_data = api.fetch_tender(tender_id)
    return nil unless tender_data
    
    tender = Tender.from_api_response(tender_data)
    logger.info("Tender #{tender_id} synced successfully")
    
    tender
  end
  
  def find_new_tenders_since(timestamp)
    logger.info("Finding tenders modified since #{timestamp}")
    
    options = {
      date_modified: timestamp.iso8601,
      limit: 100
    }
    
    sync_tenders(options)
  end
end

```ruby
# rozetka_feed_generator.rb

require 'nokogiri'
require 'builder'
require 'active_support/core_ext/hash'
require 'date'

class RozetkaFeedGenerator
  attr_reader :shop_name, :company, :url, :currency

  def initialize(options = {})
    @shop_name = options[:shop_name] || 'My Shop'
    @company = options[:company] || 'My Company'
    @url = options[:url] || 'https://example.com'
    @currency = options[:currency] || 'UAH'
    @categories = []
    @products = []
  end

  def add_category(category)
    @categories << category
  end

  def add_product(product)
    @products << product
  end

  def generate
    builder = Nokogiri::XML::Builder.new(encoding: 'UTF-8') do |xml|
      xml.yml_catalog(date: Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')) do
        xml.shop do
          xml.name @shop_name
          xml.company @company
          xml.url @url
        
          xml.currencies do
            xml.currency(id: @currency, rate: '1')
          end
        
          xml.categories do
            @categories.each do |category|
              if category[:parent_id]
                xml.category(category[:name], id: category[:id], parentId: category[:parent_id])
              else
                xml.category(category[:name], id: category[:id])
              end
            end
          end
        
          xml.offers do
            @products.each do |product|
              generate_offer(xml, product)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    builder.to_xml
  end

  def save_to_file(filepath)
    File.write(filepath, generate)
    puts "Feed generated successfully: #{filepath}"
  end

  private

  def generate_offer(xml, product)
    xml.offer(id: product[:id], available: product[:available] || true) do
      xml.url product[:url] || "#{@url}/product/#{product[:id]}"
      xml.price product[:price]
      xml.currencyId @currency
      xml.categoryId product[:category_id]
      
      # Product images
      if product[:pictures] && product[:pictures].any?
        product[:pictures].each do |picture|
          xml.picture picture
        end
      end
      
      # Product name
      xml.name product[:name]
      
      # Vendor and vendorCode
      xml.vendor product[:vendor] if product[:vendor]
      xml.vendorCode product[:vendor_code] if product[:vendor_code]
      
      # Description
      if product[:description]
        xml.description do
          xml.cdata product[:description]
        end
      end
      
      # Product parameters (characteristics)
      if product[:params] && product[:params].any?
        product[:params].each do |param|
          xml.param(param[:value], name: param[:name], unit: param[:unit])
        end
      end
      
      # Additional Rozetka-specific fields
      xml.stock_quantity product[:stock_quantity] if product[:stock_quantity]
      xml.quantity_in_stock product[:quantity_in_stock] if product[:quantity_in_stock]
      
      # Sales notes and delivery
      if product[:sales_notes]
        xml.sales_notes product[:sales_notes]
      end
      
      if product[:delivery]
        xml.delivery do
          xml.region product[:delivery][:region] if product[:delivery][:region]
          xml.price product[:delivery][:price] if product[:delivery][:price]
          xml.time product[:delivery][:time] if product[:delivery][:time]
        end
      end
      
      # Country of origin
      xml.country_of_origin product[:country_of_origin] if product[:country_of_origin]
      
      # Barcode
      xml.barcode product[:barcode] if product[:barcode]
      
      # Warranty
      xml.warranty product[:warranty] if product[:warranty]
    end
  end
end
