```ruby
# config/initializers/nova_poshta.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

module NovaPoshta
  class Error < StandardError; end
  class ApiError < Error; end
  class ValidationError < Error; end

  class Client
    include HTTParty
    
    base_uri 'https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/'
    format :json
    
    attr_reader :api_key, :logger

    def initialize(api_key: ENV['NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY'], logger: Logger.new($stdout))
      @api_key = api_key
      @logger = logger
      validate_api_key!
    end

    def create_express_waybill(order_data)
      validate_order_data!(order_data)
      
      payload = build_waybill_payload(order_data)
      
      logger.info("Creating express waybill for order: #{order_data[:order_number]}")
      
      response = self.class.post('/InternetDocument/save', 
        body: payload.to_json,
        headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
      )

      handle_response(response)
    end

    private

    def validate_api_key!
      raise ValidationError, 'API key is required' if api_key.nil? || api_key.empty?
    end

    def validate_order_data!(order_data)
      required_fields = [
        :sender, :recipient, :order_number, 
        :description, :weight, :cost, 
        :service_type, :payer_type, :payment_method
      ]
      
      missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| order_data[field].nil? }
      
      if missing_fields.any?
        raise ValidationError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
      end
      
      validate_sender!(order_data[:sender])
      validate_recipient!(order_data[:recipient])
    end

    def validate_sender!(sender)
      required_sender_fields = [:city_ref, :address_ref, :contact_person, :phone]
      missing_fields = required_sender_fields.select { |field| sender[field].nil? }
      
      if missing_fields.any?
        raise ValidationError, "Missing sender fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
      end
    end

    def validate_recipient!(recipient)
      required_recipient_fields = [:city_ref, :address_ref, :contact_person, :phone]
      missing_fields = required_recipient_fields.select { |field| recipient[field].nil? }
      
      if missing_fields.any?
        raise ValidationError, "Missing recipient fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
      end
    end

    def build_waybill_payload(order_data)
      {
        apiKey: api_key,
        modelName: 'InternetDocument',
        calledMethod: 'save',
        methodProperties: {
          Sender: order_data[:sender][:city_ref],
          SenderAddress: order_data[:sender][:address_ref],
          ContactSender: order_data[:sender][:contact_person],
          SendersPhone: order_data[:sender][:phone],
          
          Recipient: order_data[:recipient][:city_ref],
          RecipientAddress: order_data[:recipient][:address_ref],
          ContactRecipient: order_data[:recipient][:contact_person],
          RecipientsPhone: order_data[:recipient][:phone],
          
          DateTime: order_data[:delivery_date] || (Time.now + 1.day).strftime('%d.%m.%Y'),
          ServiceType: order_data[:service_type],
          PaymentMethod: order_data[:payment_method],
          PayerType: order_data[:payer_type],
          Cost: order_data[:cost],
          CargoType: order_data[:cargo_type] || 'Cargo',
          Weight: order_data[:weight],
          SeatsAmount: order_data[:seats_amount] || 1,
          Description: order_data[:description],
          
          OptionsSeat: build_options_seat(order_data),
          BackwardDeliveryData: build_backward_delivery(order_data)
        }.compact
      }
    end

    def build_options_seat(order_data)
      return nil unless order_data[:options_seat]
      
      options = []
      order_data[:options_seat].each do |seat|
        options << {
          volumetricVolume: seat[:volume],
          volumetricWidth: seat[:width],
          volumetricLength: seat[:length],
          volumetricHeight: seat[:height],
          weight: seat[:weight]
        }.compact
      end
      
      options
    end

    def build_backward_delivery(order_data)
      return nil unless order_data[:backward_delivery]
      
      {
        PayerType: order_data[:backward_delivery][:payer_type],
        CargoType: 'Money',
        RedeliveryString: order_data[:backward_delivery][:amount]
      }
    end

    def handle_response(response)
      unless response.success?
        raise ApiError, "HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      end

      result = JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
      
      if result[:success] == false
        error_message = result[:errors]&.first || result[:message] || 'Unknown API error'
        logger.error("Nova Poshta API error: #{error_message}")
        raise ApiError, error_message
      end

      logger.info("Successfully created waybill: #{result[:data]}")
      result[:data]
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      logger.error("Failed to parse API response: #{e.message}")
      raise ApiError, 'Invalid API response format'
    end
  end
end

# app/services/nova_poshta_service.rb
class NovaPoshtaService
  def initialize(client = NovaPoshta::Client.new)
    @client = client
  end

  def create_express_waybill(order)
    order_data = {
      sender: {

### 2. Core API Client

```ruby
# lib/keycrm.rb
require 'faraday'
require 'faraday/retry'
require 'json'

module KeyCRM
  class << self
    attr_accessor :configuration

    def configure
      self.configuration ||= Configuration.new
      yield(configuration)
    end
  end

  class Configuration
    attr_accessor :api_key, :api_url, :timeout, :open_timeout, :retry_count, :cache_expiry

    def initialize
      @api_key = nil
      @api_url = 'https://api.keycrm.app/v1'
      @timeout = 10
      @open_timeout = 5
      @retry_count = 3
      @cache_expiry = 5.minutes
    end
  end

  class Error < StandardError; end
  class AuthenticationError < Error; end
  class NotFoundError < Error; end
  class ValidationError < Error; end
  class RateLimitError < Error; end
  class ServerError < Error; end
  class ConnectionError < Error; end

  class Client
    def initialize
      @config = KeyCRM.configuration
      raise AuthenticationError, 'API key is not configured' unless @config&.api_key

      @connection = Faraday.new(url: @config.api_url) do |faraday|
        faraday.request :json
        faraday.response :json, content_type: /\bjson$/
        faraday.request :retry, max: @config.retry_count,
                                 interval: 0.5,
                                 interval_randomness: 0.5,
                                 backoff_factor: 2,
                                 exceptions: [Faraday::RetriableResponse, Faraday::TimeoutError, Faraday::ConnectionFailed]
        faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
        faraday.options.timeout = @config.timeout
        faraday.options.open_timeout = @config.open_timeout
      end
    end

    def get(path, params = {})
      request(:get, path, params)
    end

    def post(path, body = {})
      request(:post, path, nil, body)
    end

    def put(path, body = {})
      request(:put, path, nil, body)
    end

    def patch(path, body = {})
      request(:patch, path, nil, body)
    end

    def delete(path)
      request(:delete, path)
    end

    private

    def request(method, path, params = nil, body = nil)
      response = @connection.send(method) do |req|
        req.url path
        req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@config.api_key}"
        req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
        req.headers['Accept'] = 'application/json'
        req.params = params if params
        req.body = body.to_json if body
      end

      handle_response(response)
    rescue Faraday::ConnectionFailed => e
      raise ConnectionError, "Failed to connect to KeyCRM API: #{e.message}"
    rescue Faraday::TimeoutError => e
      raise ConnectionError, "Timeout connecting to KeyCRM API: #{e.message}"
    rescue Faraday::ClientError => e
      raise Error, "KeyCRM API client error: #{e.message}"
    end

    def handle_response(response)
      case response.status
      when 200..299
        response.body
      when 400
        raise ValidationError, "Validation error: #{extract_error_message(response)}"
      when 401
        raise AuthenticationError, 'Authentication failed. Check your API key.'
      when 403
        raise AuthenticationError, 'Access forbidden. Check your permissions.'
      when 404
        raise NotFoundError, "Resource not found: #{response.env.url}"
      when 429
        raise RateLimitError, 'Rate limit exceeded. Please retry later.'
      when 500..599
        raise ServerError, "KeyCRM server error: #{response.status}"
      else
        raise Error, "Unexpected response: #{response.status}"
      end
    end

    def extract_error_message(response)
      return 'Unknown error' unless response.body.is_a?(Hash)

      response.body['message'] || response.body['error'] || response.body.to_s
    end
  end
end
```

module KeyCRM
  class OrderService
    def initialize(client = KeyCRM::Client.new)
      @client = client
    end

    def create_order(order_data)
      validate_order_data!(order_data)
      @client.post('/orders', order_data)
    end

    def update_order(order_id, order_data)
      @client.put("/orders/#{order_id}", order_data)
    end

    def get_order(order_id)
      @client.get("/orders/#{order_id}")
    end

    def list_orders(params = {})
      @client.get('/orders', params)
    end

    def delete_order(order_id)
      @client.delete("/orders/#{order_id}")
    end

    def update_order_status(order_id, status)
      @client.patch("/orders/#{order_id}/status", { status: status })
    end

    def add_order_item(order_id, item_data)
      @client.post("/orders/#{order_id}/items", item_data)
    end

    def remove_order_item(order_id, item_id)
      @client.delete("/orders/#{order_id}/items/#{item_id}")
    end

    private

    def validate_order_data!(order_data)
      required_fields = [:customer_email, :items]
      missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| order_data[field].nil? }

      if missing_fields.any?
        raise KeyCRM::ValidationError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
      end

      if order_data[:items].empty?
        raise KeyCRM::ValidationError, 'Order must contain at least one item'
      end
    end
  end

### 6. Webhook Handler

```ruby
# app/controllers/api/webhooks/keycrm_controller.rb
module Api
  module Webhooks
    class KeycrmController < ApplicationController
      skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
      before_action :verify_webhook_signature

      def receive
        event_type = params[:event_type]
        payload = params[:payload]

        case event_type
        when 'order.created'
          handle_order_created(payload)
        when 'order.updated'
          handle_order_updated(payload)
        when 'order.status_changed'
          handle_order_status_changed(payload)
        when 'order.deleted'
          handle_order_deleted(payload)
        when 'customer.created'
          handle_customer_created(payload)
        when 'customer.updated'
          handle_customer_updated(payload)
        when 'product.updated'
          handle_product_updated(payload)
        else
          Rails.logger.warn "Unhandled KeyCRM webhook event: #{event_type}"
        end

        render json: { status: 'success' }, status: :ok
      rescue StandardError => e
        Rails.logger.error "Error processing KeyCRM webhook: #{e.message}"
        render json: { status: 'error', message: e.message }, status: :internal_server_error
      end

      private

      def verify_webhook_signature
        signature = request.headers['X-KeyCRM-Signature']
        payload = request.raw_post
        secret = ENV['KEYCRM_WEBHOOK_SECRET']

        if secret && signature
          expected_signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', secret, payload)
          unless ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(signature, expected_signature)
            render json: { status: 'error', message: 'Invalid signature' }, status: :unauthorized
          end
        end
      end

      def handle_order_created(payload)
        KeyCRM::OrderSyncJob.perform_async(payload['order_id'])
      end

      def handle_order_updated(payload)
        order = Order.find_by(keycrm_id: payload['order_id'])
        order&.update_from_keycrm(payload)
      end

      def handle_order_status_changed(payload)
        order = Order.find_by(keycrm_id: payload['order_id'])
        order&.update(status: payload['new_status'])
      end

      def handle_order_deleted(payload)
        order = Order.find_by(keycrm_id: payload['order_id'])
        order&.update(deleted_at: Time.current)
      end

      def handle_customer_created(payload)
        customer = Customer.find_or_initialize_by(email: payload['email'])
        customer.update_from_keycrm(payload)
      end

      def handle_customer_updated(payload)
        customer = Customer.find_by(keycrm_id: payload['customer_id'])
        customer&.update_from_keycrm(payload)
      end

      def handle_product_updated(payload)
        product = Product.find_by(sku: payload['sku'])
        product&.update_stock_from_keycrm(payload)
      end
    end
  end
end

### 7. Background Jobs

```ruby
# app/jobs/keycrm/order_sync_job.rb
module KeyCRM
  class OrderSyncJob
    include Sidekiq::Job

    def perform(order_id)
      order = Order.find(order_id)
      service = KeyCRM::OrderService.new

      keycrm_order = service.get_order(order.keycrm_id)

      order.update(
        status: keycrm_order['status'],
        keycrm_updated_at: keycrm_order['updated_at'],
        total: keycrm_order['total']
      )

      sync_items(order, keycrm_order['items'])
    rescue KeyCRM::NotFoundError
      Rails.logger.warn "Order #{order_id} not found in KeyCRM"
      order.update(deleted_at: Time.current)
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error "Failed to sync order #{order_id}: #{e.message}"
      raise
    end

    private

    def sync_items(order, keycrm_items)
      keycrm_items.each do |item_data|
        item = order.order_items.find_or_initialize_by(keycrm_id: item_data['id'])
        item.update(
          product_sku: item_data['sku'],
          quantity: item_data['quantity'],
          price: item_data['price'],
          total: item_data['total']
        )
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### 8. Model Integration

```ruby
# app/models/order.rb
class Order < ApplicationRecord
  has_many :order_items, dependent: :destroy
  belongs_to :customer

  after_create :sync_to_keycrm
  after_update :update_keycrm, if: :should_sync_to_keycrm?

  def sync_to_keycrm
    KeyCRM::OrderCreateJob.perform_async(id)
  end

  def update_from_keycrm(data)
    update(
      status: data['status'],
      total: data['total'],
      keycrm_updated_at: data['updated_at']
    )
  end

  def to_keycrm_payload
    {
      external_id: id,
      customer_email: customer.email,
      customer_name: customer.name,
      customer_phone: customer.phone,
      shipping_address: shipping_address,
      billing_address: billing_address,
      items: order_items.map(&:to_keycrm_payload),
      total: total,
      currency: currency,
      status: status,
      notes: notes
    }
  end

  private

  def should_sync_to_keycrm?
    saved_change_to_status? || saved_change_to_total? || saved_change_to_shipping_address?
  end

```ruby
# checkbox_service.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'
require 'active_support/all'
require 'logger'

class CheckboxService
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = ENV.fetch('CHECKBOX_BASE_URL', 'https://api.checkbox.ua/api/v1')
  
  attr_reader :logger

  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    @access_token = nil
    @token_expires_at = nil
  end

  # Авторизація в системі Checkbox
  def authenticate
    logger.info("Authenticating with Checkbox API...")
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/cashier/signin",
      headers: default_headers,
      body: {
        login: ENV['CHECKBOX_LOGIN'],
        password: ENV['CHECKBOX_PASSWORD']
      }.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      auth_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      @access_token = auth_data['access_token']
      @token_expires_at = Time.now + auth_data['expires_in'].to_i.seconds
      logger.info("Successfully authenticated")
      true
    else
      logger.error("Authentication failed: #{response.body}")
      raise "Authentication failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  # Перевірка та оновлення токену при необхідності
  def ensure_authenticated
    if @access_token.nil? || @token_expires_at.nil? || Time.now >= @token_expires_at
      authenticate
    end
  end

  # Створення фіскального чеку
  def create_fiscal_receipt(payment_data)
    ensure_authenticated
    
    logger.info("Creating fiscal receipt for payment: #{payment_data[:payment_id]}")
    
    receipt_data = build_receipt_data(payment_data)
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/receipts/sell",
      headers: auth_headers,
      body: receipt_data.to_json
    )

    if response.success?
      receipt = JSON.parse(response.body)
      logger.info("Receipt created successfully: #{receipt['id']}")
      receipt
    else
      logger.error("Failed to create receipt: #{response.body}")
      raise "Failed to create receipt: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  # Отримання статусу чеку
  def get_receipt_status(receipt_id)
    ensure_authenticated
    
    logger.info("Getting receipt status: #{receipt_id}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/receipts/#{receipt_id}",
      headers: auth_headers
    )

    if response.success?
      receipt = JSON.parse(response.body)
      logger.info("Receipt status: #{receipt['status']}")
      receipt
    else
      logger.error("Failed to get receipt status: #{response.body}")
      raise "Failed to get receipt status: #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  # Очікування завершення фіскалізації чеку
  def wait_for_receipt_completion(receipt_id, timeout = 30)
    start_time = Time.now
    
    loop do
      receipt = get_receipt_status(receipt_id)
      
      case receipt['status']
      when 'DONE'
        logger.info("Receipt #{receipt_id} fiscalized successfully")
        return receipt
      when 'FAILED', 'ERROR'
        logger.error("Receipt #{receipt_id} failed: #{receipt['error_message']}")
        raise "Receipt fiscalization failed: #{receipt['error_message']}"
      end
      
      if Time.now - start_time > timeout
        raise "Timeout waiting for receipt fiscalization"
      end
      
      sleep 2
    end
  end

  private

  def default_headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  def auth_headers
    default_headers.merge(
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}"
    )
  end

  def build_receipt_data(payment_data)
    {
      cashier_name: ENV.fetch('CHECKBOX_CASHIER_NAME', 'Онлайн касир'),
      department: ENV.fetch('CHECKBOX_DEPARTMENT', 'Інтернет-магазин'),
      goods: build_goods_list(payment_data[:items]),
      payments: build_payments_list(payment_data),
      delivery: build_delivery_info(payment_data[:delivery])
    }.compact
  end

  def build_goods_list(items)
    items.map do |item|
      {
        good: {
          code: item[:sku],
          name: item[:name],
          price: item[:price].to_f
        },
        quantity: item[:quantity].to_i * 1000, # Checkbox використовує тисячні частки
        is_return: false
      }
    end
  end

  def build_payments_list(payment_data)
    payment_method = case payment_data[:payment_method]
                     when 'card' then 'CARD'
                     when 'cash' then 'CASH'
                     when 'online' then 'CASHLESS'
                     else 'CASHLESS'
                     end

    [{
      type: payment_method,
      value: payment_data[:total_amount].to_f
    }]
  end

  def build_delivery_info(delivery_data)
    return nil unless delivery_data

    {
      email: delivery_data[:email],
      phone: delivery_data[:phone],
      address: delivery_data[:address]
    }.compact
  end
end

# payment_processor.rb

  # Обробка онлайн-оплати та видача чеку
  def process_online_payment(payment_data)
    # Тут має бути логіка обробки онлайн-оплати
    # Наприклад, через LiqPay, Portmone, WayForPay тощо
    
    puts "Processing online payment..."

        # Очікуємо завершення фіскалізації

  end

module OrderStatusable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern
  
  included do
    after_update :track_status_change, if: :saved_change_to_status?
  end
  
  def update_status(new_status, metadata = {})
    old_status = status
    update!(status: new_status)
    
    StatusChange.create!(
      order: self,
      from_status: old_status,
      to_status: new_status,
      metadata: metadata,
      changed_at: Time.current
    )
    
    SalesDrive::StatusSyncWorker.perform_async(id, new_status)
  end
  
  private
  
  def track_status_change
    StatusChange.create!(
      order: self,
      from_status: status_before_last_save,
      to_status: status,
      changed_at: Time.current
    )
  end
  
  def enqueue_salesdrive_sync
    SalesDrive::OrderSyncWorker.perform_async(id)
  end
  
  def sync_status_to_salesdrive
    if salesdrive_integration&.salesdrive_order_id.present?
      SalesDrive::StatusSyncWorker.perform_async(id, status)
    end
  end
end

### 5. Сервіс для роботи з SalesDrive API

```ruby
# app/services/salesdrive/api_client.rb
module SalesDrive
  class ApiClient
    include Singleton
    
    def initialize
      @connection = Faraday.new(url: SalesDrive.configuration.api_url) do |faraday|
        faraday.request :json
        faraday.response :json, content_type: /\bjson$/
        faraday.response :raise_error
        faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
        faraday.options.timeout = SalesDrive.configuration.timeout
        faraday.options.open_timeout = 10
        faraday.request :retry, 
          max: SalesDrive.configuration.retry_attempts,
          interval: 0.5,
          interval_randomness: 0.5,
          backoff_factor: 2,
          exceptions: [Faraday::ConnectionFailed, Faraday::TimeoutError]
      end
    end
    
    def create_order(order_data)
      response = @connection.post('/orders') do |req|
        req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{SalesDrive.configuration.api_key}"
        req.body = order_data
      end
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    def update_order(salesdrive_order_id, order_data)
      response = @connection.put("/orders/#{salesdrive_order_id}") do |req|
        req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{SalesDrive.configuration.api_key}"
        req.body = order_data
      end
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    def get_order(salesdrive_order_id)
      response = @connection.get("/orders/#{salesdrive_order_id}") do |req|
        req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{SalesDrive.configuration.api_key}"
      end
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    def update_order_status(salesdrive_order_id, status)
      response = @connection.patch("/orders/#{salesdrive_order_id}/status") do |req|
        req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{SalesDrive.configuration.api_key}"
        req.body = { status: status }
      end
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    private
    
    def handle_response(response)
      case response.status
      when 200..299
        JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
      when 401
        raise SalesDrive::AuthenticationError, 'Invalid API key'
      when 404
        raise SalesDrive::NotFoundError, 'Resource not found'
      when 422
        raise SalesDrive::ValidationError, response.body
      when 429
        raise SalesDrive::RateLimitError, 'Rate limit exceeded'
      else
        raise SalesDrive::ApiError, "API error: #{response.status}"
      end
    end
  end
end
```

# app/services/salesdrive/order_sync_service.rb
module SalesDrive
  class OrderSyncService
    def initialize(order)
      @order = order
      @api_client = ApiClient.instance
    end
    
    def sync!
      result = if @order.salesdrive_integration&.salesdrive_order_id.present?
        update_existing_order
      else
        create_new_order
      end
      
      update_integration_record(result)
      result
    end
    
    def self.sync_all_pending!
      Order.needs_sync.find_each do |order|
        OrderSyncWorker.perform_async(order.id)
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def create_new_order
      order_data = build_order_payload
      response = @api_client.create_order(order_data)
      
      {
        salesdrive_order_id: response[:id],
        status: response[:status],
        synced_at: Time.current,
        active: true
      }
    end
    
    def update_existing_order
      order_data = build_order_payload
      salesdrive_order_id = @order.salesdrive_integration.salesdrive_order_id
      
      response = @api_client.update_order(salesdrive_order_id, order_data)
      
      {
        status: response[:status],
        synced_at: Time.current,
        active: true
      }
    end
    
    def build_order_payload
      {
        external_id: @order.id,
        order_number: @order.order_number,
        status: @order.status,
        total_amount: @order.total_amount.to_f,
        currency: @order.currency,
        customer: {
          name: @order.customer.name,
          email: @order.customer.email,
          phone: @order.customer.phone,
          address: @order.customer.address
        },
        items: @order.order_items.map do |item|
          {
            sku: item.sku,
            name: item.name,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            price: item.price.to_f,
            total: item.total_price.to_f
          }
        end,
        created_at: @order.created_at.iso8601,
        updated_at: @order.updated_at.iso8601
      }
    end
    
    def update_integration_record(result)
      integration = @order.salesdrive_integration || 
                    @order.build_salesdrive_integration
      
      integration.assign_attributes(result)
      integration.save!
    end
  end
end
```

### 7. Background Workers

```ruby
# app/workers/salesdrive/order_sync_worker.rb
module SalesDrive
  class OrderSyncWorker
    include Sidekiq::Worker
    sidekiq_options queue: :salesdrive, retry: 5, backtrace: true
    
    def perform(order_id)
      order = Order.find_by(id: order_id)
      return unless order
      
      service = SalesDrive::OrderSyncService.new(order)
      result = service.sync!
      
      Rails.logger.info("SalesDrive sync completed for order #{order.id}: #{result.inspect}")
      
      result
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error("SalesDrive sync failed for order #{order_id}: #{e.message}")
      raise e
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/workers/salesdrive/status_sync_worker.rb
module SalesDrive
  class StatusSyncWorker
    include Sidekiq::Worker
    sidekiq_options queue: :salesdrive, retry: 3, backtrace: true
    
    def perform(order_id, new_status)
      order = Order.find_by(id: order_id)
      return unless order
      
      integration = order.salesdrive_integration
      return unless integration&.salesdrive_order_id.present?
      
      api_client = SalesDrive::ApiClient.instance
      result = api_client.update_order_status(
        integration.salesdrive_order_id,
        new_status
      )
      
      integration.update!(
        status: result[:status],
        synced_at: Time.current
      )
      
      Rails.logger.info("Status sync completed for order #{order.id}: #{new_status}")
      
      result
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error("Status sync failed for order #{order_id}: #{e.message}")
      raise e
    end
  end
end
```

# app/controllers/api/salesdrive_webhooks_controller.rb
module Api
  class SalesdriveWebhooksController < ApplicationController
    skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
    before_action :verify_webhook_signature
    
    def status_update
      webhook_data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      
      order = find_order(webhook_data)
      return head :not_found unless order
      
      new_status = webhook_data['status']
      
      if valid_status?(new_status)
        order.update_status(new_status, {
          source: 'salesdrive_webhook',
          webhook_id: webhook_data['id'],
          received_at: Time.current
        })
        
        render json: { success: true }, status: :ok
      else
        render json: { error: 'Invalid status' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      render json: { error: 'Invalid JSON' }, status: :bad_request
    rescue StandardError => e
      Rails.logger.error("Webhook processing error: #{e.message}")
      render json: { error: 'Internal error' }, status: :internal_server_error
    end
    
    private
    
    def find_order(webhook_data)
      salesdrive_order_id = webhook_data['salesdrive_order_id']
      external_id = webhook_data['external_id']
      
      if salesdrive_order_id.present?
        integration = SalesdriveIntegration.find_by(salesdrive_order_id: salesdrive_order_id)
        integration&.order
      elsif external_id.present?
        Order.find_by(id: external_id)
      end
    end
    
    def valid_status?(status)
      Order.statuses.keys.include?(status)
    end
    
    def verify_webhook_signature
      signature = request.headers['X-SalesDrive-Signature']
      payload = request.body.read
      request.body.rewind
      
      expected_signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(
        'SHA256',
        SalesDrive.configuration.webhook_secret,
        payload
      )
      
      unless ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(signature.to_s, expected_signature)
        render json: { error: 'Invalid signature' }, status: :unauthorized
      end
    end
  end
end

Here's a complete Ruby implementation for sending SMS through the Ukrainian provider SMS-fly:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21.0'
gem 'dotenv', '~> 2.8.0'  # For managing environment variables
gem 'json', '~> 2.6.0'    # JSON parsing (usually bundled with Ruby)
```

## Implementation

### sms_fly_client.rb

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'uri'

class SMSFlyClient
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://sms-fly.ua/api/v2'
  
  attr_reader :login, :password
  
  def initialize(login: nil, password: nil)
    @login = login || ENV['SMS_FLY_LOGIN']
    @password = password || ENV['SMS_FLY_PASSWORD']
    
    raise ArgumentError, "Login and password are required" if @login.nil? || @password.nil?
  end
  
  # Send SMS message
  # @param recipient [String] Phone number in international format (e.g., "380501234567")
  # @param message [String] SMS text
  # @param options [Hash] Additional options (source, ttl, etc.)
  # @return [Hash] Response from SMS-fly API
  def send_sms(recipient, message, options = {})
    validate_phone_number!(recipient)
    validate_message!(message)
    
    payload = {
      'login' => login,
      'password' => password,
      'to' => recipient,
      'text' => message
    }
    
    # Add optional parameters
    payload['source'] = options[:source] if options[:source]
    payload['ttl'] = options[:ttl] if options[:ttl]
    payload['description'] = options[:description] if options[:description]
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/message/send",
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }
    )
    
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  # Check SMS delivery status
  # @param message_id [String] Message ID from send_sms response
  # @return [Hash] Status information
  def check_status(message_id)
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/message/status",
      query: {
        'login' => login,
        'password' => password,
        'message_id' => message_id
      }
    )
    
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  # Get account balance
  # @return [Hash] Balance information
  def get_balance
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}/balance",
      query: {
        'login' => login,
        'password' => password
      }
    )
    
    parse_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_phone_number!(phone)
    unless phone.match?(/^\d{10,15}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid phone number format. Use international format without '+' (e.g., 380501234567)"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_message!(message)
    if message.nil? || message.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Message cannot be empty"
    end
    
    if message.length > 160
      raise ArgumentError, "Message exceeds 160 characters (SMS limit)"
    end
  end
  
  def parse_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise "Authentication failed: Check your SMS-fly credentials"
    when 400
      error_data = JSON.parse(response.body) rescue {}
      raise "Bad request: #{error_data['error'] || 'Unknown error'}"
    when 500
      raise "SMS-fly server error"
    else
      raise "Unexpected response code: #{response.code}"
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    raise "Failed to parse SMS-fly response: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative 'sms_fly_client'
require 'dotenv'

# Load environment variables from .env file
Dotenv.load

# Example 1: Basic usage with environment variables
begin
  client = SMSFlyClient.new
  
  # Send SMS
  response = client.send_sms(
    '380501234567',
    'Hello from Ruby! This is a test message.'
  )
  
  puts "SMS sent successfully!"
  puts "Message ID: #{response['message_id']}"
  puts "Status: #{response['status']}"

rescue => e

end

# Example 2: With explicit credentials and options

rescue => e

# Example 3: Check balance

### README.md

```markdown
# SMS-fly Ruby Client

A Ruby client for sending SMS messages through the Ukrainian SMS-fly provider.

## Installation

1. Install required gems:
```bash
bundle install
```

2. Set up environment variables:
```bash
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env with your SMS-fly credentials
```

## Usage

```ruby
require_relative 'sms_fly_client'

client = SMSFlyClient.new

# Send SMS
response = client.send_sms('380501234567', 'Your message here')
puts response['message_id']

# Check status
status = client.check_status(response['message_id'])

# Get balance
balance = client.get_balance
```

## Features

- Send SMS messages
- Check delivery status
- Get account balance
- Environment variable support
- Error handling
- Phone number validation
- Message length validation

## API Documentation

The client wraps the SMS-fly API v2 endpoints:
- POST /message/send - Send SMS
- GET /message/status - Check message status
- GET /balance - Get account balance
```

6. **Examples** showing different usage scenarios

The code is production-ready and follows Ruby best practices. Remember to replace the placeholder credentials with your actual SMS-fly account details.

### Implementation: `nova_poshta_tracker.rb`

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "faraday"
require "json"
require "dotenv/load"

class NovaPoshtaTracker
  BASE_URL = "https://api.novaposhta.ua/v2.0/json/"

  # Fallback status names for common Nova Poshta status codes.
  # The API usually returns a human-readable status in Ukrainian,
  # so this map is used only when the "Status" field is empty.
  STATUS_CODES = {
    "1" => "Очікує надходження",
    "2" => "Видалено",
    "3" => "Номер не знайдено",
    "4" => "Одержано",
    "5" => "Відправлено",
    "6" => "Прибуло у відділення",
    "7" => "Прибуло у вантажний термінал",
    "8" => "Брак",
    "9" => "Відправлено (зворотня доставка)",
    "10" => "Отримано (зворотня доставка)",
    "11" => "Зберігається",
    "12" => "Грошовий переказ",
    "14" => "Видано отримувачу",
    "15" => "Відмова",
    "16" => "Відправлено з відділення",
    "17" => "Прибуло на термінал",
    "18" => "Прибуло у термінал одержувача",
    "19" => "Відправлено з терміналу",
    "20" => "Отримано у терміналі одержувача",
    "21" => "Здано на зберігання",
    "22" => "Повернено",
    "102" => "Відмовлено від отримання (відправник)",
    "103" => "Відмовлено від отримання (одержувач)",
    "104" => "Змінено адресу",
    "105" => "Припинено зберігання",
    "106" => "Одержано і створено заявку на повернення",
    "111" => "Відправлено за зміненою адресою",
    "112" => "Повернено за зміненою адресою"
  }.freeze

  attr_reader :api_key

  def initialize(api_key = ENV["NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY"])
    @api_key = api_key
    raise ArgumentError, "Nova Poshta API key is missing" if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
  end

  def track(invoice_number)
    response = Faraday.post(
      BASE_URL,
      request_body(invoice_number).to_json,
      "Content-Type" => "application/json"
    )

    handle_response(response)
  rescue Faraday::Error => e
    { success: false, error: "HTTP error: #{e.message}" }
  end

  private

  def request_body(invoice_number)
    {
      apiKey: api_key,
      modelName: "TrackingDocument",
      calledMethod: "getStatusDocuments",
      methodProperties: {
        Documents: [
          { DocumentNumber: invoice_number }
        ]
      }
    }
  end

  def handle_response(response)
    return { success: false, error: "HTTP #{response.status}" } unless response.status == 200

    json = JSON.parse(response.body)
    return { success: false, error: json["errors"].to_s } unless json["success"]

    data = json["data"]
    if data && (item = data.first)
      status_code = item["StatusCode"]
      status_text = item["Status"]

      {
        success: true,
        status_code: status_code,
        status: status_text.nil? || status_text.empty? ? STATUS_CODES.fetch(status_code, "Unknown status") : status_text,
        raw_status: status_text,
        city_sender: item["CitySender"],
        city_recipient: item["CityRecipient"],
        warehouse_recipient: item["WarehouseRecipient"],
        date_created: item["DateCreated"],
        scheduled_delivery_date: item["ScheduledDeliveryDate"],
        recipient_full_name: item["RecipientFullName"]
      }
    else
      { success: false, error: "Tracking number not found." }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    { success: false, error: "Invalid JSON response: #{e.message}" }
  end
end

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  tracking_number = ARGV[0]

  unless tracking_number
    puts "Usage: ruby nova_poshta_tracker.rb TRACKING_NUMBER"
    exit 1
  end

  tracker = NovaPoshtaTracker.new
  result = tracker.track(tracking_number)

  if result[:success]
    puts "Parcel #{tracking_number}:"
    puts "Status: #{result[:status]}"
    puts "Route: #{result[:city_sender]} → #{result[:city_recipient]}"
    puts "Recipient warehouse: #{result[:warehouse_recipient]}" unless result[:warehouse_recipient].to_s.empty?
    puts "Scheduled delivery: #{result[:scheduled_delivery_date]}" unless result[:scheduled_delivery_date].to_s.empty?
  else
    puts "Could not track parcel: #{result[:error]}"
    exit 1
  end
end
```

### Usage

1. Create a `.env` file with your Nova Poshta API key:

   ```
   NOVA_POSHTA_API_KEY=your_api_key_here
   ```

2. Install dependencies:

   ```bash
   bundle install
   ```

3. Run the tracker:

   ```bash
   ruby nova_poshta_tracker.rb 20450948764165
   ```

The script will call Nova Poshta's `TrackingDocument` API and print the current status of the parcel.

Ось реалізація входу користувачів через BankID НБУ на Ruby: ## Gemfile ```ruby source 'https://rubygems.org' gem 'rails', '~> 7.0.0' gem 'faraday', '~> 2.7' gem 'jwt', '~> 2.7' gem 'openssl', '~> 3.0' gem 'dotenv-rails', '~> 2.8' gem 'redis', '~> 5.0' gem 'sidekiq', '~> 7.0' gem 'puma', '~> 6.0' gem 'pg', '~> 1.4' gem 'bcrypt', '~> 3.1' gem 'rack-cors', '~> 2.0' gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21.0' gem 'json', '~> 2.6' gem 'base64', '~> 0.1.1' gem 'securerandom', '~> 0.2.2' gem 'timeout', '~> 0.3.1' gem 'uri', '~> 0.11.0' gem 'net-http', '~> 0.3.0' gem 'logger', '~> 1.5' gem 'concurrent-ruby', '~> 1.2' gem 'activesupport', '~> 7.0.0' gem 'actionpack', '~> 7.0.0' gem 'actionview', '~> 7.0.0' gem 'activemodel', '~> 7.0.0' gem 'activerecord', '~> 7.0.0' gem 'railties', '~> 7.0.0' group :development, :test do gem 'rspec-rails', '~> 6.0' gem 'factory_bot_rails', '~> 6.2' gem 'faker', '~> 3.2' gem 'pry-rails', '~> 0.3.9' gem 'webmock', '~> 3.18' gem 'vcr', '~> 6.1' end group :development do gem 'listen', '~> 3.8' gem 'spring', '~> 4.1' gem 'rubocop', '~> 1.50' end group :production do gem 'newrelic_rpm', '~> 9.0' gem 'sentry-rails', '~> 5.9' gem 'sentry-ruby', '~> 5.9' end ``` ## Реалізація BankID Integration ### 1. Конфігурація (config/initializers/bankid.rb) ```ruby # config/initializers/bankid.rb require 'openssl' require 'base64' require 'json' require 'faraday' module BankID class Configuration attr_accessor :api_url, :client_id, :client_secret, :cert_path, :key_path, :ca_cert_path attr_accessor :redirect_uri, :environment, :timeout, :open_timeout def initialize @api_url = ENV['BANKID_API_URL'] || 'https://id.bank.gov.ua' @client_id = ENV['BANKID_CLIENT_ID'] @client_secret = ENV['BANKID_CLIENT_SECRET'] @cert_path = ENV['BANKID_CERT_PATH'] @key_path = ENV['BANKID_KEY_PATH'] @ca_cert_path = ENV['BANKID_CA_CERT_PATH'] @redirect_uri = ENV['BANKID_REDIRECT_URI'] @environment = ENV['BANKID_ENVIRONMENT'] || 'production' @timeout = 30 @open_timeout = 10 end def valid? @client_id.present? && @client_secret.present? && @cert_path.present? && @key_path.present? end end class << self attr_writer :configuration def configuration @configuration ||= Configuration.new end def configure yield(configuration) end def reset @configuration = Configuration.new end end end BankID.configure do |config| config.api_url = ENV['BANKID_API_URL'] || 'https://id.bank.gov.ua' config.client_id = ENV['BANKID_CLIENT_ID'] config.client_secret = ENV['BANKID_CLIENT_SECRET'] config.cert_path = ENV['BANKID_CERT_PATH'] config.key_path = ENV['BANKID_KEY_PATH'] config.ca_cert_path = ENV['BANKID_CA_CERT_PATH'] config.redirect_uri = ENV['BANKID_REDIRECT_URI'] end ``` ### 2. Модель BankID Session (app/models/bank_id_session.rb) ```ruby # app/models/bank_id_session.rb class BankIdSession < ApplicationRecord validates :state, presence: true, uniqueness: true validates :request_id, presence: true, allow_nil: true validates :status, presence: true enum status: { created: 'created', pending: 'pending', authenticated: 'authenticated', failed: 'failed', expired: 'expired', cancelled: 'cancelled' } scope :active, -> { where(status: [:created, :pending]) } scope :expired_sessions, -> { where('created_at < ?', 15.minutes.ago) } def expired? created_at < 15.minutes.ago end def mark_as_expired! update(status: :expired) end def complete_authentication!(user_data) transaction do update( status: :authenticated, user_data: user_data, authenticated_at: Time.current ) end end def fail_authentication!(error_message = nil) update( status: :failed, error_message: error_message, failed_at: Time.current ) end def cancel! update( status: :cancelled, cancelled_at: Time.current ) end end ``` ### 3. BankID Service (app/services/bank_id_service.rb) ```ruby # app/services/bank_id_service.rb require 'net/http' require 'uri' require 'json' require 'openssl' require 'base64' require 'jwt' require 'securerandom' class BankIdService class BankIdError < StandardError; end class AuthenticationError < BankIdError; end class CertificateError < BankIdError; end class NetworkError < BankIdError; end class InvalidResponseError < BankIdError; end BANKID_ENDPOINTS = { authorization: '/api/v1/bankid/authorization', token: '/api/v1/bankid/token', user_info: '/api/v1/bankid/user-info', certificate: '/api/v1/bankid/certificate' }.freeze attr_reader :config, :http_client def initialize(config = BankID.configuration) @config = config @http_client = create_http_client end # Створює запит на авторизацію через BankID def create_authorization_request(redirect_uri = nil) validate_configuration! state = SecureRandom.hex(16) nonce = SecureRandom.hex(16) request_payload = { client_id: config.client_id, redirect_uri: redirect_uri || config.redirect_uri, response_type: 'code', scope: 'openid profile email phone address', state: state, nonce: nonce, acr_values: 'bankid:bankid:2' } # Створюємо сесію в базі даних session = BankIdSession.create!( state: state, nonce: nonce, status: :created, request_data: request_payload ) # Формуємо URL для перенаправлення користувача authorization_url = build_authorization_url(request_payload) { session: session, authorization_url: authorization_url, state: state } rescue StandardError => e Rails.logger.error("BankID authorization request failed: #{e.message}") raise AuthenticationError, "Failed to create authorization request: #{e.message}" end # Обробляє callback від BankID def handle_callback(code, state) validate_callback_params!(code, state) session = BankIdSession.find_by(state: state) raise AuthenticationError, "Invalid state" unless session raise AuthenticationError, "Session expired" if session.expired? # Оновлюємо статус сесії session.update(status: :pending, authorization_code: code) # Обмінюємо код на токен token_response = exchange_code_for_token(code) session.update(token_data: token_response) # Отримуємо дані користувача user_info = fetch_user_info(token_response['access_token']) session.update(user_data: user_info) # Завершуємо авторизацію session.complete_authentication!(user_info) { session: session, user_info: user_info, token: token_response } rescue StandardError => e Rails.logger.error("BankID callback handling failed: #{e.message}") session&.fail_authentication!(e.message) raise AuthenticationError, "Failed to handle BankID callback: #{e.message}" end # Отримує сертифікат BankID def fetch_certificate response = http_client.get(BANKID_ENDPOINTS[:certificate]) if response.success? JSON.parse(response.body) else raise CertificateError, "Failed to fetch certificate: #{response.status} - #{response.body}" end rescue Faraday::Error => e raise NetworkError, "Network error while fetching certificate: #{e.message}" end # Перевіряє підпис від BankID def verify_signature(data, signature, certificate) cert = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(certificate) public_key = cert.public_key digest = OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new public_key.verify(digest, Base64.decode64(signature), data) rescue OpenSSL::OpenSSLError => e raise CertificateError, "Signature verification failed: #{e.message}" end private def create_http_client Faraday.new(url: config.api_url) do |faraday| faraday.request :json faraday.response :logger, Rails.logger, bodies: true if Rails.env.development? faraday.response :raise_error faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter faraday.options.timeout = config.timeout faraday.options.open_timeout = config.open_timeout # Додаємо SSL сертифікати if config.ca_cert_path.present? faraday.ssl.ca_file = config.ca_cert_path end if config.cert_path.present? && config.key_path.present? faraday.ssl.client_cert = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(File.read(config.cert_path)) faraday.ssl.client_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(config.key_path)) end end end def build_authorization_url(params) uri = URI.parse("#{config.api_url}#{BANKID_ENDPOINTS[:authorization]}") uri.query = URI.encode_www_form(params) uri.to_s end def exchange_code_for_token(code) token_payload = { grant_type: 'authorization_code', code: code, redirect_uri: config.redirect_uri, client_id: config.client_id, client_secret: config.client_secret } response = http_client.post(BANKID_ENDPOINTS[:token], token_payload) if response.success? JSON.parse(response.body) else raise AuthenticationError, "Token exchange failed: #{response.status} - #{response.body}" end rescue Faraday::Error => e raise NetworkError, "Network error during token exchange: #{e.message}" end def fetch_user_info(access_token) response = http_client.get(BANKID_ENDPOINTS[:user_info]) do |req| req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{access_token}" end if response.success? user_info = JSON.parse(response.body) validate_user_info!(user_info) user_info else raise AuthenticationError, "Failed to fetch user info: #{response.status} - #{response.body}" end rescue Faraday::Error => e raise NetworkError, "Network error while fetching user info: #{e.message}" end def validate_configuration! unless config.valid? raise AuthenticationError, "BankID configuration is incomplete" end end def validate_callback_params!(code, state) raise AuthenticationError, "Missing authorization code" if code.blank? raise AuthenticationError, "Missing state parameter" if state.blank? end def validate_user_info!(user_info) required_fields = %w[sub name] missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| user_info[field].blank? } if missing_fields.any? raise InvalidResponseError, "Missing required fields in user info: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}" end end end ``` ### 4. Контролер BankID (app/controllers/bank_id_controller.rb) ```ruby # app/controllers/bank_id_controller.rb class BankIdController < ApplicationController skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token, only: [:callback] before_action :validate_bankid_enabled, except: [:status] # Ініціює процес авторизації через BankID def authorize begin result = bankid_service.create_authorization_request # Зберігаємо state в сесії для подальшої перевірки session[:bankid_state] = result[:state] # Перенаправляємо користувача на BankID redirect_to result[:authorization_url], allow_other_host: true rescue BankIdService::AuthenticationError => e Rails.logger.error("BankID authorization failed: #{e.message}") flash[:error] = "BankID авторизація недоступна. Спробуйте пізніше." redirect_to root_path end end # Обробляє callback від BankID def callback code = params[:code] state = params[:state] # Перевіряємо state для запобігання CSRF атак if state != session[:bankid_state] Rails.logger.error("BankID state mismatch") flash[:error] = "Невірний запит авторизації." redirect_to new_session_path return end begin result = bankid_service.handle_callback(code, state) # Знаходимо або створюємо користувача user = find_or_create_user(result[:user_info]) # Входимо в систему sign_in(user) # Очищаємо state session.delete(:bankid_state) flash[:success] = "Успішний вхід через BankID!" redirect_to dashboard_path rescue BankIdService::AuthenticationError => e Rails.logger.error("BankID callback failed: #{e.message}") flash[:error] = "Помилка авторизації через BankID. Спробуйте ще раз." redirect_to new_session_path end end # Перевіряє статус авторизації def status state = params[:state] || session[:bankid_state] if state.present? bankid_session = BankIdSession.find_by(state: state) if bankid_session render json: { status: bankid_session.status, authenticated: bankid_session.authenticated?, created_at: bankid_session.created_at } else render json: { status: 'not_found' }, status: :not_found end else render json: { status: 'missing_state' }, status: :bad_request end end # Скасовує авторизацію def cancel state = params[:state] || session[:bankid_state] if state.present? bankid_session = BankIdSession.find_by(state: state) bankid_session&.cancel! session.delete(:bankid_state) flash[:info] = "Авторизацію скасовано." redirect_to new_session_path else redirect_to root_path end end private def bankid_service @bankid_service ||= BankIdService.new end def find_or_create_user(user_info) # Знаходимо користувача за BankID ID user = User.find_by(bankid_sub: user_info['sub']) unless user # Створюємо нового користувача user = User.create!( email: user_info['email'], bankid_sub: user_info['sub'], first_name: user_info.dig('name', 'given_name'), last_name: user_info.dig('name', 'family_name'), phone: user_info['phone_number'], bankid_data: user_info ) end user rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e Rails.logger.error("Failed to create user from BankID: #{e.message}") raise BankIdService::AuthenticationError, "Failed to create user" end def sign_in(user) # Реалізація входу в систему (залежить від вашого механізму аутентифікації) session[:user_id] = user.id @current_user = user end def validate_bankid_enabled unless BankID.configuration.valid? flash[:error] = "BankID авторизація не налаштована." redirect_to root_path end end end ``` ### 5. Модель User (app/models/user.rb) ```ruby # app/models/user.rb class User < ApplicationRecord has_secure_password validates :email, presence: true, uniqueness: true, format: { with: URI::MailTo::EMAIL_REGEXP } validates :bankid_sub, uniqueness: true, allow_nil: true scope :bankid_users, -> { where.not(bankid_sub: nil) } def bankid_authenticated? bankid_sub.present? end def full_name [first_name, last_name].compact.join(' ') end def update_bankid_data(user_info) update( bankid_sub: user_info['sub'], first_name: user_info.dig('name', 'given_name'), last_name: user_info.dig('name', 'family_name'), phone: user_info['phone_number'], bankid_data: user_info, last_bankid_login_at: Time.current ) end end ``` ### 6. Here's a complete Ruby implementation for calling a customer with a voice message through the Binotel telephony API:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21.0'
gem 'json', '~> 2.6'
gem 'dotenv', '~> 2.8'
```

## Implementation

### binotel_service.rb

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'

class BinotelService
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.binotel.com/api'
  
  def initialize(api_key, api_secret)
    @api_key = api_key
    @api_secret = api_secret
  end
  
  def call_with_voice_message(phone_number, message_text)
    validate_phone_number!(phone_number)
    validate_message!(message_text)
    
    payload = build_payload(phone_number, message_text)
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "#{BASE_URL}/4.0/calls/click-to-call.json",
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  rescue BinotelError => e
    raise e
  rescue StandardError => e
    raise BinotelError, "Unexpected error: #{e.message}"
  end
  
  private
  
  def headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  def build_payload(phone_number, message_text)
    {
      key: @api_key,
      secret: @api_secret,
      generalCallID: generate_call_id,
      internalNumber: nil, # Optional: specify internal number if needed
      externalNumber: normalize_phone_number(phone_number),
      voiceFileID: nil, # Optional: use pre-recorded voice file ID
      textMessage: message_text, # Text to be converted to speech
      ttsVoice: 'female', # Options: 'female', 'male', 'default'
      ttsLanguage: 'uk-UA', # Language for text-to-speech
      callbackURL: nil, # Optional: webhook URL for call status updates
      params: {
        # Additional parameters if needed
        callType: 'voice_message'
      }
    }
  end
  
  def generate_call_id
    "call_#{Time.now.to_i}_#{SecureRandom.hex(6)}"
  end
  
  def normalize_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Ensure phone number is in international format
    phone_number.gsub(/[^\d+]/, '')
  end
  
  def validate_phone_number!(phone_number)
    unless phone_number.match?(/^\+?[\d\s\-()]{10,15}$/)
      raise BinotelError, "Invalid phone number format: #{phone_number}"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_message!(message_text)
    if message_text.nil? || message_text.strip.empty?
      raise BinotelError, "Message text cannot be empty"
    end
    
    if message_text.length > 1000
      raise BinotelError, "Message text too long (max 1000 characters)"
    end
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      parse_success_response(response)
    when 401
      raise BinotelError, "Authentication failed: Invalid API key or secret"
    when 403
      raise BinotelError, "Access forbidden: Check your Binotel account permissions"
    when 429
      raise BinotelError, "Rate limit exceeded: Too many requests"
    when 500
      raise BinotelError, "Binotel server error: #{response.body}"
    else
      raise BinotelError, "Unexpected response code: #{response.code}, body: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def parse_success_response(response)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if data['status'] == 'success'
      {
        success: true,
        call_id: data['generalCallID'],
        status: data['status'],
        message: data['message'] || 'Call initiated successfully'
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: data['error'] || 'Unknown error',
        message: data['message'] || 'Failed to initiate call'
      }
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    raise BinotelError, "Failed to parse response: #{e.message}"
  end
end

class BinotelError < StandardError; end
```

### voice_message_caller.rb

```ruby
require_relative 'binotel_service'
require 'dotenv'
require 'logger'

class VoiceMessageCaller
  def initialize(logger: Logger.new(STDOUT))
    Dotenv.load
    @logger = logger
    @binotel_service = BinotelService.new(
      ENV['BINOTEL_API_KEY'],
      ENV['BINOTEL_API_SECRET']
    )
  end
  
  def call_customer(customer_name, phone_number, custom_message = nil)
    @logger.info("Initiating voice message call to #{customer_name} at #{phone_number}")
    
    message = custom_message || build_default_message(customer_name)
    
    result = @binotel_service.call_with_voice_message(phone_number, message)
    
    if result[:success]
      @logger.info("Successfully initiated call to #{customer_name}. Call ID: #{result[:call_id]}")
      log_call_to_file(customer_name, phone_number, result)
    else
      @logger.error("Failed to call #{customer_name}: #{result[:error]}")
    end
    
    result
  rescue BinotelError => e
    @logger.error("Binotel API error for #{customer_name}: #{e.message}")
    { success: false, error: e.message }
  rescue StandardError => e
    @logger.error("Unexpected error for #{customer_name}: #{e.message}")
    { success: false, error: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}" }
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_default_message(customer_name)
    "Доброго дня, #{customer_name}! Це повідомлення від нашої компанії. " \
    "Будь ласка, зв'яжіться з нами за зручним для вас номером. Дякуємо за увагу!"
  end
  
  def log_call_to_file(customer_name, phone_number, result)
    log_entry = {
      timestamp: Time.now.iso8601,
      customer_name: customer_name,
      phone_number: phone_number,
      call_id: result[:call_id],
      status: result[:status]
    }
    
    File.open('call_log.json', 'a') do |file|
      file.puts(log_entry.to_json)
    end
  end
end
```

### main.rb

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby

require_relative 'voice_message_caller'
require 'optparse'

options = {
  customer_name: nil,
  phone_number: nil,
  message: nil
}

parser = OptionParser.new do |opts|
  opts.banner = "Usage: main.rb [options]"
  
  opts.on("-n", "--name NAME", "Customer name") do |name|
    options[:customer_name] = name
  end
  
  opts.on("-p", "--phone PHONE", "Phone number (e.g., +380991234567)") do |phone|
    options[:phone_number] = phone
  end
  
  opts.on("-m", "--message MESSAGE", "Custom message (optional)") do |message|
    options[:message] = message
  end
  
  opts.on("-h", "--help", "Show this help message") do
    puts opts
    exit
  end
end

parser.parse!

# Validate required arguments
if options[:customer_name].nil? || options[:phone_number].nil?
  puts "Error: Customer name and phone number are required"
  puts parser
  exit 1
end

# Execute the call
caller = VoiceMessageCaller.new
result = caller.call_customer(
  options[:customer_name],
  options[:phone_number],
  options[:message]
)

# Exit with appropriate code
exit(result[:success] ? 0 : 1)

### README.md

```markdown
# Binotel Voice Message Caller

This Ruby application calls customers with voice messages using the Binotel telephony API.

## Setup

1. Install dependencies:
   ```bash
   bundle install
   ```

2. Configure environment variables:
   ```bash
   cp .env.example .env
   # Edit .env with your Binotel API credentials
   ```

3. Run the application:
   ```bash
   ruby main.rb -n "John Doe" -p "+380991234567"
   ```

## Usage

### Command Line

```bash
# Basic usage
ruby main.rb -n "John Doe" -p "+380991234567"

# With custom message
ruby main.rb -n "John Doe" -p "+380991234567" -m "Hello John, this is a test message"
```

### As a Library

```ruby
require_relative 'voice_message_caller'

caller = VoiceMessageCaller.new
result = caller.call_customer("John Doe", "+380991234567")

if result[:success]
  puts "Call initiated successfully"
else
  puts "Failed to initiate call: #{result[:error]}"
end
```

## Features

- Text-to-speech voice messages
- Automatic phone number normalization
- Call logging to JSON file
- Comprehensive error handling
- Support for custom messages
- Configurable TTS voice and language

## Error Handling

The application handles various error scenarios:
- Invalid phone numbers
- Empty messages
- Authentication failures
- Rate limiting
- Server errors

All errors are logged and returned as structured results.
```

This implementation provides:

1. **BinotelService**: Handles direct API communication with Binotel
2. **VoiceMessageCaller**: Higher-level service that manages the calling logic
3. **Command-line interface**: Easy to use from terminal
4. **Error handling**: Comprehensive error handling for various scenarios
5. **Logging**: Logs calls to both console and JSON file
6. **Configuration**: Uses environment variables for API credentials
7. **Text-to-speech**: Converts text messages to voice for the call

The code is production-ready with proper validation, error handling, and logging.

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'date'
require 'optparse'

class NBUCurencyRate
  BASE_URL = 'https://bank.gov.ua/NBUStatService/v1/statdirectory/exchange'

  def initialize(date = Date.today)
    @date = date
  end

  def fetch_rates
    formatted_date = @date.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    url = "#{BASE_URL}?date=#{formatted_date}&json"

    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(url, timeout: 10)
      
      if response.success?
        parse_response(response.body)
      else
        puts "Помилка запиту: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
        []
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Виникла помилка: #{e.message}"
      []
    end
  end

  def display_rates
    rates = fetch_rates
    
    if rates.empty?
      puts "Курси валют на #{@date.strftime('%d.%m.%Y')} не знайдено"
      return
    end

    puts "=" * 60
    puts "Офіційні курси гривні на #{@date.strftime('%d.%m.%Y')}"
    puts "=" * 60
    puts sprintf("%-5s %-8s %-30s %-15s %-15s", "№", "Код", "Назва валюти", "Курс (грн)", "Код валюти")
    puts "-" * 60

    rates.each_with_index do |rate, index|
      puts sprintf(
        "%-5d %-8s %-30s %-15.4f %-15s",
        index + 1,
        rate['r030'],
        rate['txt'],
        rate['rate'],
        rate['cc']
      )
    end
    
    puts "=" * 60
    puts "Всього валют: #{rates.length}"
  end

  def find_currency(currency_code)
    rates = fetch_rates
    currency = rates.find { |rate| rate['cc'] == currency_code.upcase }
    
    if currency
      puts "Курс #{currency['txt']} (#{currency['cc']}):"
      puts "1 #{currency['cc']} = #{currency['rate']} грн"
      puts "1 грн = #{(1.0 / currency['rate']).round(6)} #{currency['cc']}"
      currency
    else
      puts "Валюта з кодом #{currency_code} не знайдена"
      nil
    end
  end

  def convert_to_uah(amount, currency_code)
    rates = fetch_rates
    currency = rates.find { |rate| rate['cc'] == currency_code.upcase }
    
    if currency
      result = amount * currency['rate']
      puts "#{amount} #{currency['cc']} = #{result.round(2)} грн"
      result
    else
      puts "Валюта з кодом #{currency_code} не знайдена"
      nil
    end
  end

  def convert_from_uah(amount, currency_code)
    rates = fetch_rates
    currency = rates.find { |rate| rate['cc'] == currency_code.upcase }
    
    if currency
      result = amount / currency['rate']
      puts "#{amount} грн = #{result.round(4)} #{currency['cc']}"
      result
    else
      puts "Валюта з кодом #{currency_code} не знайдена"
      nil
    end
  end

  private

  def parse_response(body)
    JSON.parse(body)
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    puts "Помилка парсингу JSON: #{e.message}"
    []
  end
end

# CLI інтерфейс
class NBUCli
  def self.run
    options = {}
    parser = OptionParser.new do |opts|
      opts.banner = "Використання: ruby nbu_currency.rb [опції]"

      opts.on("-d", "--date DATE", "Дата у форматі YYYY-MM-DD (за замовчуванням - сьогодні)") do |date|
        options[:date] = Date.parse(date)
      end

      opts.on("-c", "--currency CODE", "Показати курс конкретної валюти (наприклад: USD, EUR)") do |code|
        options[:currency] = code
      end

      opts.on("-a", "--amount AMOUNT", "Сума для конвертації") do |amount|
        options[:amount] = amount.to_f
      end

      opts.on("-t", "--to-uah", "Конвертувати в гривні") do
        options[:to_uah] = true
      end

      opts.on("-f", "--from-uah", "Конвертувати з гривень") do
        options[:from_uah] = true
      end

      opts.on("-h", "--help", "Показати допомогу") do
        puts opts
        exit
      end
    end

    parser.parse!

    date = options[:date] || Date.today
    nbu = NBUCurencyRate.new(date)

    if options[:amount] && options[:currency]
      if options[:to_uah]
        nbu.convert_to_uah(options[:amount], options[:currency])
      elsif options[:from_uah]
        nbu.convert_from_uah(options[:amount], options[:currency])
      else
        puts "Вкажіть напрямок конвертації: -t (в гривні) або -f (з гривень)"
      end
    elsif options[:currency]
      nbu.find_currency(options[:currency])
    else
      nbu.display_rates
    end
  rescue OptionParser::InvalidOption, OptionParser::MissingArgument => e
    puts "Помилка: #{e.message}"
    puts "Використайте -h для довідки"
  rescue Date::Error => e
    puts "Помилка: некоректний формат дати. Використовуйте YYYY-MM-DD"
  end
end

# Запуск
if __FILE__ == $0
  NBUCli.run
end

Task: Validate the number of a Ukrainian ID-card passport and a foreign passport in a registration form.
text:
## Gemfile

```ruby
source "https://rubygems.org"

# No external gems are required; the validator uses only the Ruby standard library.
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

class UkrainianPassportValidator
  # Ukrainian uppercase Cyrillic letters used in old-style foreign passport series.
  UKRAINIAN_CYRILLIC_UPPER = "[А-ЯІЇЄҐ]"

  DOCUMENT_TYPES = {
    # Ukrainian ID-card passport: exactly 9 digits.
    id_card: /\A\d{9}\z/,

    # Ukrainian foreign/international passport:
    # - new biometric passports: exactly 9 digits
    # - old-style passports: 2 Ukrainian Cyrillic letters + 6 digits
    foreign_passport: /\A(?:\d{9}|#{UKRAINIAN_CYRILLIC_UPPER}{2}\d{6})\z/
  }.freeze

  attr_reader :document_type, :normalized_number

  def self.valid?(document_type, number)
    new(document_type, number).valid?
  end

  def initialize(document_type, number)
    @document_type = normalize_document_type(document_type)
    @normalized_number = normalize_number(number)
  end

  def valid?
    DOCUMENT_TYPES.key?(@document_type) &&
      !@normalized_number.empty? &&
      DOCUMENT_TYPES[@document_type].match?(@normalized_number)
  end

  def error
    return :unsupported_document_type unless DOCUMENT_TYPES.key?(@document_type)
    return :blank_number if @normalized_number.empty?
    return :invalid_format unless DOCUMENT_TYPES[@document_type].match?(@normalized_number)

    nil
  end

  private

  def normalize_document_type(document_type)
    document_type.to_s.strip.downcase.gsub(/[\s-]+/, "_").to_sym
  end

  def normalize_number(number)
    number.to_s.strip.upcase.gsub(/[\s-]/, "")
  end
end
```

### Usage

```ruby
UkrainianPassportValidator.valid?(:id_card, "123456789")
# => true

UkrainianPassportValidator.valid?("ID Card", "123-456-789")
# => true

UkrainianPassportValidator.valid?(:foreign_passport, "АВ 123456")
# => true

UkrainianPassportValidator.valid?(:foreign_passport, "123456789")
# => true

UkrainianPassportValidator.valid?(:foreign_passport, "AB123456")
# => false

validator = UkrainianPassportValidator.new(:id_card, "12345")
validator.valid? # => false
validator.error  # => :invalid_format
```

Ось рішення для налаштування українських правил множини в Rails I18n:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'rails', '~> 7.0'
gem 'i18n', '~> 1.12'
```

## Реалізація

### 1. Створіть файл ініціалізатора `config/initializers/pluralization.rb`

```ruby
# config/initializers/pluralization.rb

# Додаємо українські правила множини для I18n
{
  uk: {
    i18n: {
      plural: {
        keys: [:one, :few, :many, :other],
        rule: lambda do |n|
          # Зберігаємо абсолютне значення числа
          n = n.to_i.abs
          
          # Отримуємо останню цифру та дві останні цифри
          last_digit = n % 10
          last_two_digits = n % 100
          
          # Правила української мови
          if last_digit == 1 && last_two_digits != 11
            :one
          elsif (2..4).include?(last_digit) && !(12..14).include?(last_two_digits)
            :few
          elsif last_digit == 0 || (5..9).include?(last_digit) || (11..14).include?(last_two_digits)
            :many
          else
            :other
          end
        end
      }
    }
  }
}.each do |locale, data|
  I18n.backend.store_translations(locale, data)
end
```

### 2. Створіть файл локалізації `config/locales/uk.yml`

```yaml
# config/locales/uk.yml
uk:
  products:
    one: "%{count} товар"
    few: "%{count} товари"
    many: "%{count} товарів"
    other: "%{count} товару"
  
  users:
    one: "%{count} користувач"
    few: "%{count} користувачі"
    many: "%{count} користувачів"
    other: "%{count} користувача"
  
  days:
    one: "%{count} день"
    few: "%{count} дні"
    many: "%{count} днів"
    other: "%{count} дня"
```

### 3. Приклад використання

```ruby
# app/controllers/products_controller.rb
class ProductsController < ApplicationController
  def index
    @products = Product.all
    @product_count = @products.count
    
    # Використання перекладу з множиною
    @message = I18n.t('products', count: @product_count)
  end
end
```

### 4. Додатковий приклад для тестування

```ruby
# test/pluralization_test.rb або rails console

# Тестові приклади
test_cases = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 11, 12, 13, 14, 21, 22, 25, 100, 101, 102, 105]

test_cases.each do |n|
  puts "#{n} -> #{I18n.t('products', count: n)}"
end

# Очікуваний результат:
# 1 -> 1 товар
# 2 -> 2 товари
# 3 -> 3 товари
# 4 -> 4 товари
# 5 -> 5 товарів
# 11 -> 11 товарів
# 12 -> 12 товарів
# 13 -> 13 товарів
# 14 -> 14 товарів
# 21 -> 21 товар
# 22 -> 22 товари
# 25 -> 25 товарів
# 100 -> 100 товарів
# 101 -> 101 товар
# 102 -> 102 товари
# 105 -> 105 товарів
```

### 5. Додаткове налаштування для Rails

```ruby
# config/application.rb
module YourApp
  class Application < Rails::Application
    # Встановлюємо українську локаль за замовчуванням
    config.i18n.default_locale = :uk
    
    # Додаємо українську до доступних локалей
    config.i18n.available_locales = [:uk, :en]
  end

```

Ця реалізація забезпечує правильне використання українських правил множини відповідно до стандартів CLDR (Common Locale Data Repository) і коректно обробляє всі випадки української мови.

Ось рішення для отримання даних компанії за кодом ЄДРПОУ через API Опендатабот:

## Gemfile

source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21.0'

## Реалізація

```ruby
# open_data_bot_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'
require 'colorize'

Dotenv.load

class OpenDataBotClient
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.opendatabot.ua'
  
  def initialize(api_key = nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['OPENDATABOT_API_KEY']
    raise ArgumentError, 'API key is required. Set OPENDATABOT_API_KEY environment variable or pass it as argument' if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
    
    self.class.base_uri BASE_URL
    self.class.headers 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}"
    self.class.headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
  end
  
  def get_company_by_edrpou(edrpou_code)
    validate_edrpou!(edrpou_code)
    
    begin
      response = self.class.get("/companies/#{edrpou_code}")
      
      case response.code
      when 200
        parse_response(response)
      when 401
        raise 'Неавторизований запит. Перевірте API ключ'
      when 404
        raise "Компанію з кодом ЄДРПОУ #{edrpou_code} не знайдено"
      when 429
        raise 'Перевищено ліміт запитів. Спробуйте пізніше'
      else
        raise "Помилка API: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
      end
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Помилка: #{e.message}".red
      nil
    end
  end
  
  def get_company_details(edrpou_code)
    company_data = get_company_by_edrpou(edrpou_code)
    return nil unless company_data
    
    format_company_info(company_data)
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_edrpou!(edrpou_code)
    unless edrpou_code.to_s.match?(/^\d{8}$|^\d{10}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, 'Код ЄДРПОУ повинен містити 8 або 10 цифр'
    end
  end
  
  def parse_response(response)
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    puts "Помилка парсингу JSON: #{e.message}".red
    nil
  end
  
  def format_company_info(data)
    {
      name: data.dig('data', 'name') || data['name'],
      short_name: data.dig('data', 'short_name') || data['short_name'],
      edrpou: data.dig('data', 'edrpou') || data['edrpou'],
      address: data.dig('data', 'address') || data['address'],
      status: data.dig('data', 'status') || data['status'],
      registration_date: data.dig('data', 'registration_date') || data['registration_date'],
      director: data.dig('data', 'director') || data['director'],
      activity: data.dig('data', 'activity') || data['activity'],
      authorized_capital: data.dig('data', 'authorized_capital') || data['authorized_capital']
    }.compact
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  client = OpenDataBotClient.new
  
  puts "=" * 60
  puts "Пошук компанії за кодом ЄДРПОУ".yellow

# vat_checker.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'json'
require 'date'

class VatChecker
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://data.gov.ua/api/3/action/'
  VAT_RESOURCE_ID = 'c5b4c7f4-6e9c-4f3a-8a1d-2c2f9e4b4a1d' # Замініть на актуальний ID ресурсу
  
  class VatCheckError < StandardError; end
  class InvalidInnError < VatCheckError; end
  class ApiError < VatCheckError; end
  
  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['DATA_GOV_UA_API_KEY']
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
    @headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@api_key}" if @api_key
  end
  
  def check_vat_status(inn)
    validate_inn!(inn)
    
    begin
      response = fetch_vat_data(inn)
      parse_vat_response(response, inn)
    rescue VatCheckError
      raise
    rescue StandardError => e
      raise ApiError, "Помилка при перевірці ПДВ: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def check_vat_status_batch(inns)
    results = {}
    inns.each do |inn|
      results[inn] = check_vat_status(inn)
    rescue VatCheckError => e
      results[inn] = { error: e.message }
    end
    results
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_inn!(inn)
    inn_str = inn.to_s.strip
    
    if inn_str.empty?
      raise InvalidInnError, "ІПН не може бути порожнім"
    end
    
    unless inn_str.match?(/^\d{8,12}$/)
      raise InvalidInnError, "Невірний формат ІПН: #{inn_str}. Очікується 8-12 цифр"
    end
    
    unless valid_checksum?(inn_str)
      raise InvalidInnError, "Невірна контрольна сума ІПН: #{inn_str}"
    end
    
    true
  end
  
  def valid_checksum?(inn)
    # Спрощена перевірка контрольної суми для українських ІПН
    # Для повної реалізації потрібен алгоритм ДПС
    
    if inn.length == 10
      # Перевірка для 10-значних ІПН (фізичні особи)
      weights = [-1, 5, 7, 9, 4, 6, 10, 5, 7]
      sum = 0
      weights.each_with_index do |weight, index|
        sum += weight * inn[index].to_i
      end
      control = (sum % 11) % 10
      return control == inn[9].to_i
    elsif inn.length == 12
      # Перевірка для 12-значних ІПН (юридичні особи)
      weights = [3, 7, 2, 4, 10, 3, 5, 9, 4, 6, 8]
      sum = 0
      weights.each_with_index do |weight, index|
        sum += weight * inn[index].to_i
      end
      control = (sum % 11) % 10
      return control == inn[11].to_i
    end
    
    true # Для ІПН іншої довжини пропускаємо перевірку
  end
  
  def fetch_vat_data(inn)
    # Використання API data.gov.ua для отримання даних про реєстрацію ПДВ
    params = {
      'resource_id' => VAT_RESOURCE_ID,
      'q' => inn,
      'limit' => 1
    }
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "#{BASE_URL}datastore_search",
      query: params,
      headers: @headers,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    unless response.success?
      raise ApiError, "Помилка API: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
    
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end
  
  def parse_vat_response(response, inn)
    result = response.dig('result', 'records')&.first
    
    if result.nil?
      return {
        inn: inn,
        is_registered: false,
        status: 'not_found',
        message: 'Платник ПДВ не знайдений в реєстрі',
        checked_at: Time.now.iso8601
      }
    end
    
    # Адаптуйте поля відповідно до структури даних API
    {
      inn: inn,
      is_registered: true,
      status: 'registered',
      company_name: result['name'] || result['company_name'],
      vat_number: result['vat_number'] || result['individual_tax_number'],
      registration_date: result['registration_date'],
      address: result['address'],
      activity: result['activity'],
      checked_at: Time.now.iso8601,
      raw_data: result
    }
  end
  
  # Альтернативний метод з використанням офіційного сайту ДПС
  def check_via_dps_website(inn)
    # Цей метод використовує офіційний сайт ДПС України
    # Потребує додаткової обробки CSRF токенів та cookie
    
    session = HTTParty::CookieJar.new
    response = self.class.get(
      'https://cabinet.tax.gov.ua/registers/vat',
      headers: @headers,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    # Витягнення CSRF токену
    doc = Nokogiri::HTML(response.body)
    csrf_token = doc.at_css('meta[name="csrf-token"]')&.[]('content')
    
    if csrf_token
      @headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = csrf_token
      
      # Відправка запиту на перевірку
      check_response = self.class.post(
        'https://cabinet.tax.gov.ua/registers/vat/check',
        body: { inn: inn }.to_json,
        headers: @headers.merge('Referer' => 'https://cabinet.tax.gov.ua/registers/vat'),
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      JSON.parse(check_response.body)
    end
  end
end
