  # Приклад перевірки одного ІПН
  puts "Перевірка ІПН: 1234567890"
  result = checker.check_vat_status('1234567890')
  
  if result[:is_registered]
    puts "✅ Платник ПДВ зареєстрований"
    puts "Назва: #{result[:company_name]}"
    puts "Дата реєстрації: #{result[:registration_date]}"
  else
    puts "❌ Платник ПДВ не зареєстрований"
    puts "Повідомлення: #{result[:message]}"
  end
  
  # Приклад масової перевірки
  puts "\nМасова перевірка:"
  inns = ['1234567890', '0987654321', '1111111111']
  results = checker.check_vat_status_batch(inns)
  
  results.each do |inn, result|
    if result[:error]
      puts "#{inn}: ❌ Помилка - #{result[:error]}"
    elsif result[:is_registered]
      puts "#{inn}: ✅ Зареєстрований - #{result[:company_name]}"
    else
      puts "#{inn}: ❌ Не зареєстрований"
    end
  end
end

require 'nokogiri'
require 'builder'
require 'active_support/all'
require 'faraday'
require 'json'

class RozetkaFeedGenerator
  ROZETKA_API_URL = 'https://api.rozetka.com.ua'
  
  attr_reader :categories, :products

  def initialize(api_key: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ROZETKA_API_KEY']
    @categories = []
    @products = []
    @http_client = Faraday.new(url: ROZETKA_API_URL) do |faraday|
      faraday.request :url_encoded
      faraday.response :logger
      faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
    end
  end

  def load_categories
    response = @http_client.get('/categories') do |req|
      req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@api_key}"
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    end
    
    if response.success?
      @categories = JSON.parse(response.body)['categories']
    else
      raise "Failed to load categories: #{response.status}"
    end
  end

  def load_products(category_id = nil)
    endpoint = category_id ? "/categories/#{category_id}/products" : '/products'
    response = @http_client.get(endpoint) do |req|
      req.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@api_key}"
      req.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    end
    
    if response.success?
      @products = JSON.parse(response.body)['products']
    else
      raise "Failed to load products: #{response.status}"
    end
  end

  def generate_feed
    builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    
    builder.instruct! :xml, version: "1.0", encoding: "UTF-8"
    
    builder.feed(xmlns: "http://rozetka.com.ua/schemas/feed/1.0") do |feed|
      feed.title("Rozetka Product Feed")
      feed.link("https://rozetka.com.ua")
      feed.description("Product feed for Rozetka marketplace")
      feed.updated(Time.now.iso8601)
      
      # Categories section
      feed.categories do |categories_xml|
        @categories.each do |category|
          categories_xml.category(id: category['id']) do |cat|
            cat.name(category['name'])
            cat.description(category['description']) if category['description']
            cat.parent_id(category['parent_id']) if category['parent_id']
            
            if category['parameters']
              cat.parameters do |params|
                category['parameters'].each do |param|
                  params.parameter(
                    name: param['name'],
                    type: param['type'],
                    required: param['required'] || false
                  ) do |p|
                    p.values(param['values']) if param['values']
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      
      # Products section
      feed.products do |products_xml|
        @products.each do |product|
          products_xml.product(id: product['id']) do |prod|
            prod.title(product['title'])
            prod.description(product['description'])
            prod.price(product['price'], currency: product['currency'] || 'UAH')
            prod.old_price(product['old_price']) if product['old_price']
            prod.category_id(product['category_id'])
            prod.vendor(product['vendor'])
            prod.vendor_code(product['vendor_code'])
            prod.quantity(product['quantity'] || 0)
            prod.url(product['url'])
            
            # Images
            if product['images']
              prod.images do |images|
                product['images'].each_with_index do |image, index|
                  images.image(url: image, main: index == 0)
                end
              end
            end
            
            # Parameters
            if product['parameters']
              prod.parameters do |params|
                product['parameters'].each do |param_name, param_value|
                  params.parameter(name: param_name) do |p|
                    p.value(param_value)
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            
            # Characteristics
            if product['characteristics']
              prod.characteristics do |chars|
                product['characteristics'].each do |char|
                  chars.characteristic(name: char['name']) do |c|
                    c.value(char['value'])
                    c.unit(char['unit']) if char['unit']
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    builder.target!
  end

  def save_feed(filename = 'rozetka_feed.xml')
    xml_content = generate_feed
    File.write(filename, xml_content)
    puts "Feed saved to #{filename}"
    xml_content
  end

  def validate_feed(xml_content)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(xml_content)
    errors = []
    
    # Basic validation
    errors << "Missing feed root element" unless doc.at_xpath('//feed')
    errors << "Missing categories" if doc.xpath('//categories/category').empty?
    errors << "Missing products" if doc.xpath('//products/product').empty?
    
    # Validate required fields for each product
    doc.xpath('//products/product').each do |product|
      errors << "Product #{product['id']}: missing title" if product.at_xpath('title').nil?
      errors << "Product #{product['id']}: missing price" if product.at_xpath('price').nil?
      errors << "Product #{product['id']}: missing category_id" if product.at_xpath('category_id').nil?
    end
    
    errors
  end
end

```ruby
require 'dotenv'
Dotenv.load

module DeliveryAuto
  class Configuration
    attr_accessor :api_key, :base_url, :timeout
    
    def initialize
      @api_key = ENV['DELIVERY_AUTO_API_KEY']
      @base_url = ENV['DELIVERY_AUTO_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.delivery-auto.com.ua/api/v1'
      @timeout = 30
    end
    
    def validate!
      raise ArgumentError, 'API key is required' if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
    end
  end
end
```

### `lib/delivery_auto/client.rb`

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

module DeliveryAuto
  class Client
    include HTTParty
    
    attr_reader :config, :logger
    
    def initialize(config = nil)
      @config = config || Configuration.new
      @config.validate!
      @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
      @logger.level = Logger::INFO
      
      self.class.base_uri @config.base_url
      self.class.default_timeout @config.timeout
      self.class.headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
      self.class.headers 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@config.api_key}"
    end
    
    def get_shipment_status(tracking_number)
      raise ArgumentError, 'Tracking number is required' if tracking_number.nil? || tracking_number.empty?
      
      logger.info("Fetching status for shipment: #{tracking_number}")
      
      begin
        response = self.class.get("/shipments/#{tracking_number}/status")
        
        case response.code
        when 200
          parse_success_response(response)
        when 401
          raise AuthenticationError, 'Invalid API key'
        when 404
          raise ShipmentNotFoundError, "Shipment #{tracking_number} not found"
        when 429
          raise RateLimitError, 'Rate limit exceeded'
        else
          raise ApiError, "API error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
        end
      rescue Timeout::Error, Net::ReadTimeout
        raise ApiError, 'Request timeout'
      rescue Errno::ECONNREFUSED
        raise ApiError, 'Connection refused'
      end
    end
    
    def get_multiple_shipment_statuses(tracking_numbers)
      raise ArgumentError, 'Tracking numbers array is required' if tracking_numbers.nil? || tracking_numbers.empty?
      
      logger.info("Fetching statuses for #{tracking_numbers.length} shipments")
      
      begin
        response = self.class.post('/shipments/statuses/bulk', 
          body: { tracking_numbers: tracking_numbers }.to_json)
        
        case response.code
        when 200
          parse_bulk_response(response)
        when 401
          raise AuthenticationError, 'Invalid API key'
        when 429
          raise RateLimitError, 'Rate limit exceeded'
        else
          raise ApiError, "API error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
        end
      rescue Timeout::Error, Net::ReadTimeout
        raise ApiError, 'Request timeout'
      rescue Errno::ECONNREFUSED
        raise ApiError, 'Connection refused'
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def parse_success_response(response)
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      ShipmentStatus.new(
        tracking_number: data['tracking_number'],
        status: data['status'],
        status_code: data['status_code'],
        description: data['description'],
        updated_at: data['updated_at'],
        estimated_delivery: data['estimated_delivery'],
        current_location: data['current_location'],
        history: data['history'] || []
      )
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      raise ApiError, "Invalid JSON response: #{e.message}"
    end
    
    def parse_bulk_response(response)
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      data['shipments'].map do |shipment_data|
        ShipmentStatus.new(
          tracking_number: shipment_data['tracking_number'],
          status: shipment_data['status'],
          status_code: shipment_data['status_code'],
          description: shipment_data['description'],
          updated_at: shipment_data['updated_at'],
          estimated_delivery: shipment_data['estimated_delivery'],
          current_location: shipment_data['current_location'],
          history: shipment_data['history'] || []
        )
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      raise ApiError, "Invalid JSON response: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
end
```

### `lib/delivery_auto/models/shipment_status.rb`

```ruby
module DeliveryAuto
  class ShipmentStatus
    attr_reader :tracking_number, :status, :status_code, :description,
                :updated_at, :estimated_delivery, :current_location, :history
    
    def initialize(tracking_number:, status:, status_code:, description:, 
                   updated_at:, estimated_delivery: nil, current_location: nil, history: [])
      @tracking_number = tracking_number
      @status = status
      @status_code = status_code
      @description = description
      @updated_at = updated_at
      @estimated_delivery = estimated_delivery
      @current_location = current_location
      @history = history
    end
    
    def delivered?
      @status_code == 'delivered' || @status.downcase == 'delivered'
    end
    
    def in_transit?
      @status_code == 'in_transit' || @status.downcase.include?('transit')
    end
    
    def to_h
      {
        tracking_number: @tracking_number,
        status: @status,
        status_code: @status_code,
        description: @description,
        updated_at: @updated_at,
        estimated_delivery: @estimated_delivery,
        current_location: @current_location,
        history: @history
      }
    end
    
    def to_json(*args)
      to_h.to_json(*args)
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

class EdrFopService
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.edin.gov.ua/api/v1/'
  
  def initialize
    @headers = {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end

  def get_fop_info(tax_number)
    validate_tax_number!(tax_number)
    
    begin
      response = self.class.get(
        "#{BASE_URL}legal-entities/fop/#{tax_number}",
        headers: @headers,
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      if response.success?
        parse_response(response)
      else
        handle_error(response)
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Помилка запиту: #{e.message}"
      }
    end
  end

  def search_fop(query, limit = 10)
    params = {
      q: query,
      limit: limit
    }
    
    begin
      response = self.class.get(
        "#{BASE_URL}legal-entities/fop/search",
        headers: @headers,
        query: params,
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      if response.success?
        parse_search_response(response)
      else
        handle_error(response)
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Помилка пошуку: #{e.message}"
      }
    end
  end

  def get_fop_activities(tax_number)
    validate_tax_number!(tax_number)
    
    begin
      response = self.class.get(
        "#{BASE_URL}legal-entities/fop/#{tax_number}/activities",
        headers: @headers,
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      if response.success?
        parse_activities_response(response)
      else
        handle_error(response)
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      {
        success: false,
        error: "Помилка отримання видів діяльності: #{e.message}"
      }
    end
  end

  private

  def validate_tax_number!(tax_number)
    unless tax_number.match?(/^\d{10}$|^\d{12}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, 'Некоректний податковий номер. Очікується 10 або 12 цифр'
    end
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if data['items'] && data['items'].any?
      fop = data['items'].first
      {
        success: true,
        data: {
          full_name: fop['full_name'],
          short_name: fop['short_name'],
          tax_number: fop['tax_number'],
          status: fop['status'],
          registration_date: fop['registration_date'],
          address: fop['address'],
          activities: fop['activities'] || [],
          contacts: fop['contacts'] || [],
          registry_info: {
            record_number: fop['record_number'],
            record_date: fop['record_date']
          }
        }
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'ФОП з таким податковим номером не знайдено'
      }
    end
  end

  def parse_search_response(response)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if data['items'] && data['items'].any?
      {
        success: true,
        data: data['items'].map do |fop|
          {
            full_name: fop['full_name'],
            tax_number: fop['tax_number'],
            status: fop['status'],
            address: fop['address']
          }
        end,
        total: data['total'] || data['items'].length
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'Нічого не знайдено за вашим запитом'
      }
    end
  end

  def parse_activities_response(response)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if data['items'] && data['items'].any?
      {
        success: true,
        data: data['items'].map do |activity|
          {
            kved_code: activity['kved_code'],
            activity_name: activity['activity_name'],
            is_primary: activity['is_primary'] || false
          }
        end
      }
    else
      {
        success: false,
        error: 'Види діяльності не знайдено'
      }
    end
  end

  def handle_error(response)
    error_message = begin
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      data['message'] || data['error'] || 'Невідома помилка'
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      "HTTP #{response.code}: #{response.message}"
    end
    
    {
      success: false,
      error: error_message,
      status_code: response.code
    }
  end
end

require 'logger'

class EdrFopServiceWithLogging < EdrFopService
  def initialize
    super
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  def get_fop_info(tax_number)
    @logger.info("Запит інформації про ФОП з податковим номером: #{tax_number}")
    
    result = super
    
    if result[:success]
      @logger.info("Успішно отримано інформацію про ФОП: #{result[:data][:full_name]}")
    else
      @logger.error("Помилка отримання інформації: #{result[:error]}")
    end
    
    result
  rescue StandardError => e
    @logger.error("Критична помилка: #{e.message}")
    @logger.debug(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
    
    {
      success: false,
      error: "Внутрішня помилка сервісу: #{e.message}"
    }
  end
end

## Пояснення:

1. **Gemfile** містить необхідні геми:
   - `httparty` - для HTTP запитів
   - `nokogiri` - для парсингу XML/HTML (може знадобитися для альтернативних джерел)
   - `json` - для роботи з JSON
   - `openssl` та `base64` - для шифрування та кодування

2. **Основні методи**:
   - `get_fop_info` - отримання повної інформації про ФОП
   - `search_fop` - пошук ФОП за назвою
   - `get_fop_activities` - отримання видів діяльності

3. **Обробка помилок** включає:
   - Валідацію податкового номера

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "json"
require "net/http"
require "uri"

module MonobankAcquiring
  class Error < StandardError; end

  class ApiError < Error
    attr_reader :status, :body

    def initialize(status, body)
      @status = status
      @body = body
      super("Monobank API error #{status}: #{body}")
    end
  end

  class Client
    DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.monobank.ua"
    CREATE_INVOICE_PATH = "/api/merchant/invoice/create"
    UAH = 980

    def initialize(token:, base_url: DEFAULT_BASE_URL)
      @token = token
      @base_url = base_url
    end

    # amount is in minor units (kopecks/cents)
    def create_invoice(amount:, redirect_url:, webhook_url: nil, reference: nil,
                       destination: nil, ccy: UAH, comment: nil, ttl: nil)
      amount = Integer(amount)
      ccy = Integer(ccy)

      raise Error, "amount must be a positive integer" unless amount.positive?
      raise Error, "redirect_url is required" if redirect_url.nil? || redirect_url.empty?

      merchant_paym_info = compact(
        reference: reference,
        destination: destination,
        comment: comment,
        ttl: ttl
      )

      payload = {
        amount: amount,
        ccy: ccy,
        redirectUrl: redirect_url
      }

      payload[:webHookUrl] = webhook_url if webhook_url && !webhook_url.empty?
      payload[:merchantPaymInfo] = merchant_paym_info unless merchant_paym_info.empty?

      response = post(CREATE_INVOICE_PATH, payload)
      parse_body(response)
    end

    private

    attr_reader :token, :base_url

    def post(path, payload)
      uri = URI.join(base_url, path)
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      http.use_ssl = uri.scheme == "https"
      http.open_timeout = 10
      http.read_timeout = 30

      request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri.request_uri)
      request["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
      request["X-Token"] = token
      request.body = JSON.generate(payload)

      response = http.start { |h| h.request(request) }

      return response if response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)

      raise ApiError.new(response.code.to_i, response.body)
    end

    def parse_body(response)
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      raise Error, "Invalid JSON from Monobank API: #{e.message}"
    end

    def compact(hash)
      hash.reject { |_, value| value.nil? }
    end
  end
end
```

## webhook.rb

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "sinatra/base"
require "json"
require "logger"
require "openssl"
require "rack"
require "rack/utils"

class MonobankWebhook < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :bind, "0.0.0.0"
    set :port, ENV.fetch("PORT", 4567)
    set :logger, Logger.new(STDOUT)
    set :webhook_secret, ENV["MONOBANK_WEBHOOK_SECRET"]
    set :show_exceptions, false
    set :raise_errors, false
  end

  post "/monobank/webhook" do
    request.body.rewind
    body = request.body.read

    if settings.webhook_secret && !valid_signature?(body)
      settings.logger.warn("Invalid webhook signature")
      content_type :json
      halt 401, JSON.generate(error: "Invalid signature")
    end

    payload = JSON.parse(body)
    result = WebhookHandler.new(payload, logger: settings.logger).call

    content_type :json
    status 200
    JSON.generate(result)
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    settings.logger.error("Invalid JSON in webhook: #{e.message}")
    content_type :json
    halt 400, JSON.generate(error: "Invalid JSON")
  end

  private

  def valid_signature?(body)
    signature = request.env["HTTP_X_SIGNATURE"] || request.env["HTTP_X_MONOBANK_SIGNATURE"]
    return false if signature.nil? || signature.empty?

    expected = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest("SHA256", settings.webhook_secret, body)
    actual = signature.sub(/\Asha256=/i, "").downcase

    Rack::Utils.secure_compare(expected, actual)
  end
end

class WebhookHandler
  def initialize(payload, logger:)
    @payload = payload
    @logger = logger
  end

  def call
    invoice_id = payload["invoiceId"]
    status = payload["status"]

    logger.info("Monobank webhook invoice_id=#{invoice_id} status=#{status} payload=#{payload.inspect}")

    case status
    when "success"
      handle_success
    when "failure"
      handle_failure
    when "expired"
      handle_expired
    when "created", "processing", "hold"
      # Non-final statuses; no action required.
    else
      logger.warn("Unknown Monobank invoice status=#{status.inspect}")
    end

    { received: true }
  end

  private

  attr_reader :payload, :logger

  def invoice_id
    payload["invoiceId"]
  end

  def handle_success
    # TODO: Update your database, e.g.:
    # invoice = Invoice.find_by(invoice_id: invoice_id)
    # invoice.mark_paid! if invoice && amount_valid?(invoice)
    logger.info("Invoice #{invoice_id} marked as paid")
  end

  def handle_failure
    # TODO: Update your database.
    logger.info("Invoice #{invoice_id} failed")
  end

  def handle_expired
    # TODO: Update your database.
    logger.info("Invoice #{invoice_id} expired")
  end

  def amount_valid?(_invoice)
    # Compare payload["amount"] and payload["ccy"] with expected invoice amount/currency.

  end
end

Task: Stem or lemmatise Ukrainian words before full-text search.
text:
Here’s a Ruby solution using the `ukrainian_stemmer` gem, which is a port of the Snowball Ukrainian stemming algorithm.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

source "https://rubygems.org"

gem "ukrainian_stemmer", "~> 0.1"
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# lib/ukrainian_search.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "ukrainian_stemmer"

module UkrainianSearch
  module Normalizer
    module_function

    # Matches Unicode letters (including Ukrainian Cyrillic letters like і, ї, є, ґ)
    WORD_PATTERN = /[\p{L}\p{M}]+/u

    # Stems Ukrainian words before full-text search.
    #
    # @param text [String, nil] raw text or search query
    # @return [String] space-separated stemmed words
    def normalize(text)
      return "" if text.nil? || text.empty?

      text.downcase
          .scan(WORD_PATTERN)
          .map { |word| UkrainianStemmer.stem(word) }
          .join(" ")
    end
  end
end
```

### Usage

```ruby
require_relative "lib/ukrainian_search"

UkrainianSearch::Normalizer.normalize("Українські слова для пошуку")
# => returns stemmed string, e.g. "україн слов для пошук"
```

The code downcases the text, extracts only alphabetic tokens, stems each token with the Ukrainian Snowball stemmer, and rejoins them with spaces. This normalized form can be stored in a dedicated search column or used to build a full-text search query.

## Implementation

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "base64"
require "json"
require "timeout"
require "httparty"
require "dotenv/load"

# Example usage:
#
#   client = KyivstarSMSClient.new
#   client.send_sms(to: "380671234567", text: "Hello", sender: "ACME")
#
# Required environment variables:
#   KYIVSTAR_CLIENT_ID
#   KYIVSTAR_CLIENT_SECRET
#
# Optional environment variables:
#   KYIVSTAR_API_BASE_URL   (default: https://api.kyivstar.ua)
#   KYIVSTAR_ACCESS_TOKEN   (if you already have a valid access token)
#
# Adjust KYIVSTAR_SMS_PATH and KYIVSTAR_TOKEN_PATH to match your Kyivstar
# API contract if needed.
class KyivstarSMSClient
  include HTTParty

  DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.kyivstar.ua"
  DEFAULT_TOKEN_PATH = "/oauth2/token"
  DEFAULT_SMS_PATH = "/v1/messages"

  class Error < StandardError; end
  class AuthenticationError < Error; end
  class DeliveryError < Error; end

  def initialize(
    base_url: ENV.fetch("KYIVSTAR_API_BASE_URL", DEFAULT_BASE_URL),
    token_path: ENV.fetch("KYIVSTAR_TOKEN_PATH", DEFAULT_TOKEN_PATH),
    sms_path: ENV.fetch("KYIVSTAR_SMS_PATH", DEFAULT_SMS_PATH),
    client_id: ENV["KYIVSTAR_CLIENT_ID"],
    client_secret: ENV["KYIVSTAR_CLIENT_SECRET"],
    access_token: ENV["KYIVSTAR_ACCESS_TOKEN"]
  )
    @base_url = base_url.chomp("/")
    @token_path = token_path
    @sms_path = sms_path
    @client_id = client_id
    @client_secret = client_secret
    @access_token = access_token
  end

  def send_sms(to:, text:, sender:)
    payload = {
      to: to,
      text: text,
      from: sender
    }

    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{@sms_path}",
      headers: {
        "Authorization" => "Bearer #{access_token}",
        "Content-Type" => "application/json",
        "Accept" => "application/json"
      },
      body: JSON.generate(payload),
      timeout: 30
    )

    parse_response(response)
  rescue HTTParty::Error, Timeout::Error => e
    raise DeliveryError, "SMS request failed: #{e.message}"
  end

  private

  def access_token
    @access_token ||= fetch_access_token
  end

  def fetch_access_token
    if @client_id.nil? || @client_secret.nil?
      raise AuthenticationError,
            "KYIVSTAR_CLIENT_ID and KYIVSTAR_CLIENT_SECRET are required when no access token is provided"
    end

    basic_auth = Base64.strict_encode64("#{@client_id}:#{@client_secret}")

    response = self.class.post(
      "#{@base_url}#{@token_path}",
      headers: {
        "Authorization" => "Basic #{basic_auth}",
        "Content-Type" => "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
        "Accept" => "application/json"
      },
      body: "grant_type=client_credentials",
      timeout: 30
    )

    unless response.success?
      raise AuthenticationError,
            "Token request failed: #{response.code} #{response.body}"
    end

    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    token = data["access_token"]

    if token.nil? || token.empty?
      raise AuthenticationError,
            "Token response did not include access_token: #{response.body}"
    end

    token
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    raise AuthenticationError, "Invalid JSON in token response: #{e.message}"
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    unless response.success?
      raise DeliveryError,
            "SMS delivery failed: #{response.code} #{response.body}"
    end

    JSON.parse(response.body)
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    raise DeliveryError, "Invalid JSON in SMS response: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

This client uses the OAuth 2.0 `client_credentials` flow to obtain an access token and then sends an SMS via a JSON REST endpoint. The default endpoint and payload fields are based on a typical Kyivstar Business Messaging API contract; adjust the paths and field names through environment variables or method arguments if your specific API version differs.

Task: Check the spelling of Ukrainian text and suggest corrections.
text:
```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'hunspell-ffi', '~> 0.1.0'
gem 'unicode_utils', '~> 1.4'
```

```ruby
# ukrainian_spell_checker.rb
require 'hunspell-ffi'
require 'unicode_utils'

class UkrainianSpellChecker
  UKRAINIAN_DICTIONARY_PATH = '/usr/share/hunspell/uk_UA'
  
  def initialize(dictionary_path = UKRAINIAN_DICTIONARY_PATH)
    @dictionary_path = dictionary_path
    @spell_checker = Hunspell.new(
      "#{dictionary_path}.aff",
      "#{dictionary_path}.dic"
    )
    @cache = {}
  end
  
  # Check spelling of a single word
  # Returns true if word is correct, false otherwise
  def check_word(word)
    return true if word.nil? || word.empty?
    return @cache[word] if @cache.key?(word)
    
    normalized_word = normalize_word(word)
    result = @spell_checker.spell(normalized_word)
    @cache[word] = result
    result
  end
  
  # Get spelling suggestions for an incorrect word
  # Returns array of suggested corrections
  def suggest_corrections(word)
    return [] if word.nil? || word.empty?
    return [] if check_word(word)
    
    normalized_word = normalize_word(word)
    suggestions = @spell_checker.suggest(normalized_word)
    
    # Filter and rank suggestions
    filter_suggestions(suggestions, word)
  end
  
  # Check spelling of entire text
  # Returns hash with incorrect words and their suggestions
  def check_text(text)
    return {} if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    results = {}
    words = extract_words(text)
    
    words.each do |word|
      # Skip single letters and punctuation-only tokens
      next if word.length <= 1 && !letter?(word)
      
      unless check_word(word)
        results[word] = suggest_corrections(word)
      end
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  # Check text and return formatted report
  def check_text_with_context(text)
    return "" if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    report = []
    lines = text.split("\n")
    
    lines.each_with_index do |line, line_index|
      words = extract_words_with_positions(line)
      
      words.each do |word_info|
        word = word_info[:word]
        next if word.length <= 1 && !letter?(word)
        
        unless check_word(word)
          suggestions = suggest_corrections(word)
          report << format_error(line_index + 1, word_info[:position], word, suggestions)
        end
      end
    end
    
    report.join("\n")
  end
  
  # Get dictionary information
  def dictionary_info
    {
      path: @dictionary_path,
      encoding: 'UTF-8',
      language: 'Ukrainian'
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def normalize_word(word)
    # Convert to lowercase for checking (Hunspell handles case)
    UnicodeUtils.downcase(word.strip)
  end
  
  def extract_words(text)
    # Extract words, keeping Ukrainian letters and apostrophes
    text.scan(/[А-Яа-яЄєІіЇїҐґ'']+/)
  end
  
  def extract_words_with_positions(line)
    words = []
    position = 0
    
    while position < line.length
      if ukrainian_letter?(line[position])
        start_pos = position
        word = ""
        
        while position < line.length && (ukrainian_letter?(line[position]) || line[position] == "'" || line[position] == "’")
          word += line[position]
          position += 1
        end
        
        words << { word: word, position: start_pos }
      else
        position += 1
      end
    end
    
    words
  end
  
  def ukrainian_letter?(char)
    return false if char.nil?
    char.match?(/[А-Яа-яЄєІіЇїҐґ]/)
  end
  
  def letter?(word)
    word.match?(/[А-Яа-яЄєІіЇїҐґ]/)
  end
  
  def filter_suggestions(suggestions, original_word)
    # Filter out suggestions that are too different
    filtered = suggestions.select do |suggestion|
      levenshtein_distance(suggestion, original_word) <= 3
    end
    
    # Sort by similarity (closest first)
    filtered.sort_by do |suggestion|
      levenshtein_distance(suggestion, original_word)
    end
  end
  
  def levenshtein_distance(str1, str2)
    return str2.length if str1.empty?
    return str1.length if str2.empty?
    
    matrix = Array.new(str1.length + 1) { Array.new(str2.length + 1) }
    
    (0..str1.length).each { |i| matrix[i][0] = i }
    (0..str2.length).each { |j| matrix[0][j] = j }
    
    (1..str1.length).each do |i|
      (1..str2.length).each do |j|
        cost = str1[i-1] == str2[j-1] ? 0 : 1
        matrix[i][j] = [
          matrix[i-1][j] + 1,      # deletion
          matrix[i][j-1] + 1,      # insertion
          matrix[i-1][j-1] + cost  # substitution
        ].min
      end
    end
    
    matrix[str1.length][str2.length]
  end
  
  def format_error(line_number, position, word, suggestions)
    suggestion_text = if suggestions.empty?
      "немає пропозицій"
    else
      "пропозиції: #{suggestions.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    "Рядок #{line_number}, позиція #{position + 1}: '#{word}' - #{suggestion_text}"
  end
end

# Usage example
if __FILE__ == $0
  checker = UkrainianSpellChecker.new
  
  # Check single word
  puts "Перевірка слова 'привіт': #{checker.check_word('привіт')}"
  puts "Перевірка слова 'прівіт': #{checker.check_word('прівіт')}"
  
  # Get suggestions
  puts "Пропозиції для 'прівіт': #{checker.suggest_corrections('прівіт').join(', ')}"
  
  # Check text
  text = "Це тестовий текст з деякими помилками. Прівіт, як справи? Я люблю Україну."
  
  puts "\nПеревірка тексту:"
  puts text
  puts "\nРезультати перевірки:"
  
  errors = checker.check_text(text)
  errors.each do |word, suggestions|
    puts "Слово '#{word}' - можливі виправлення: #{suggestions.join(', ')}"
  end
  
  puts "\nДетальний звіт:"
  puts checker.check_text_with_context(text)
end
```

This Ruby code provides a complete Ukrainian spell checker with the following features:

1. **Gemfile**: Lists required gems (`hunspell-ffi` for spell checking and `unicode_utils` for proper Unicode handling)

2. **UkrainianSpellChecker class** with methods:
   - `check_word(word)` - checks if a single word is spelled correctly
   - `suggest_corrections(word)` - returns spelling suggestions for incorrect words
   - `check_text(text)` - checks entire text and returns hash of errors with suggestions
   - `check_text_with_context(text)` - returns formatted report with line numbers and positions
   - `dictionary_info` - returns information about the dictionary

3. **Key features**:
   - Proper handling of Ukrainian alphabet (including special characters like Є, І, Ї, Ґ)
   - Case-insensitive checking
   - Levenshtein distance algorithm for filtering and ranking suggestions
   - Caching for performance
   - Context-aware error reporting with line numbers and positions
   - Support for apostrophes in Ukrainian words

4. **Usage**: The code includes a usage example that demonstrates all main features

To use this code, you'll need to have the Ukrainian Hunspell dictionary installed on your system (usually at `/usr/share/hunspell/uk_UA.aff` and `/usr/share/hunspell/uk_UA.dic`). On Ubuntu/Debian, you can install it with:
```bash
sudo apt-get install hunspell-uk
```

Here's a complete Ruby implementation for fetching official hryvnia exchange rates from the National Bank of Ukraine API:

## Gemfile

```

## Implementation

```ruby
# nbu_exchange_rates.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'date'

class NBUExchangeRates
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://bank.gov.ua/NBUStatService/v1/statdirectory/exchange'
  
  attr_reader :date, :rates
  
  def initialize(date = Date.today)
    @date = parse_date(date)
    @rates = []
  end
  
  def fetch_rates
    response = self.class.get(BASE_URL, query: request_params)
    
    if response.success?
      @rates = JSON.parse(response.body)
      return true
    else
      raise "API request failed with status #{response.code}: #{response.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def get_rate(currency_code)
    rate = @rates.find { |r| r['cc'] == currency_code.upcase }
    rate ? rate['rate'] : nil
  end
  
  def get_currency_info(currency_code)
    @rates.find { |r| r['cc'] == currency_code.upcase }
  end
  
  def available_currencies
    @rates.map { |r| r['cc'] }.sort
  end
  
  def display_rates(limit = nil)
    display_rates = limit ? @rates.first(limit) : @rates
    
    puts "Exchange rates for #{@date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
    puts "=" * 60
    puts "Currency | Code | Rate (UAH)"
    puts "-" * 60
    
    display_rates.each do |rate|
      puts "#{rate['txt'].ljust(20)} | #{rate['cc'].ljust(4)} | #{rate['rate'].to_f.round(4)}"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_date(date_input)
    case date_input
    when Date
      date_input
    when String
      Date.parse(date_input)
    when Time
      date_input.to_date
    else
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid date format. Please provide Date, Time, or String (YYYY-MM-DD)"
    end
  rescue Date::Error
    raise ArgumentError, "Invalid date string. Please use format YYYY-MM-DD"
  end
  
  def request_params
    {
      valcode: nil,
      date: @date.strftime('%Y%m%d'),
      json: nil
    }
  end
end

# Usage example
if __FILE__ == $0
  begin
    # Fetch rates for today
    puts "Fetching exchange rates for today..."
    rates_today = NBUExchangeRates.new
    rates_today.fetch_rates
    rates_today.display_rates(10)
    
    puts "\n" + "=" * 60
    
    # Fetch rates for specific date

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class MonobankAPI
  include HTTParty
  
  base_uri 'https://api.monobank.ua'
  
  def initialize
    @token = ENV['MONOBANK_TOKEN']
    raise "MONOBANK_TOKEN не знайдено в .env файлі" if @token.nil? || @token.empty?
    
    @headers = {
      'X-Token' => @token,
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  # Отримання інформації про клієнта та рахунки
  def client_info
    response = self.class.get('/personal/client-info', headers: @headers)
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Отримання виписки з рахунку
  def account_statement(account_id, from_time = nil, to_time = nil)
    query = {}
    
    # Конвертація часу в Unix timestamp (секунди)
    query[:from] = from_time.to_i if from_time
    query[:to] = to_time.to_i if to_time
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/personal/statement/#{account_id}",
      headers: @headers,
      query: query
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  # Отримання всіх рахунків
  def accounts
    client_info['accounts']
  end
  
  # Отримання виписки для всіх рахунків
  def all_accounts_statements(from_time = nil, to_time = nil)
    statements = {}
    
    accounts.each do |account|
      account_id = account['id']
      statements[account_id] = {
        account_info: account,
        transactions: account_statement(account_id, from_time, to_time)
      }
    end
    
    statements
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 401
      raise "Помилка авторизації: перевірте MONOBANK_TOKEN"
    when 403
      raise "Доступ заборонено: недостатньо прав"
    when 429
      raise "Занадто багато запитів: перевищено ліміт API"
    when 500
      raise "Помилка сервера monobank"
    else
      raise "Невідома помилка API: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

### Файл: `lib/transaction_manager.rb`

```ruby
require 'sequel'
require 'time'

class TransactionManager
  def initialize(db)
    @db = db
    @transactions = @db[:transactions]
  end
  
  # Збереження нових транзакцій
  def save_new_transactions(transactions_list, account_info)
    saved_count = 0
    skipped_count = 0
    
    transactions_list.each do |transaction|
      transaction_id = transaction['id']
      
      # Перевірка чи транзакція вже існує
      existing = @transactions.where(transaction_id: transaction_id).first
      
      if existing
        skipped_count += 1
        puts "Транзакція #{transaction_id} вже існує - пропускаємо".colorize(:yellow)
        next
      end
      
      # Збереження нової транзакції
      begin
        @transactions.insert(
          transaction_id: transaction_id,
          account: account_info['id'],
          time: Time.at(transaction['time']),
          description: transaction['description'],
          amount: transaction['amount'],
          balance: transaction['balance'],
          currency_code: transaction['currencyCode'],
          mcc: transaction['mcc'],
          comment: transaction['comment'],
          created_at: Time.now
        )
        
        saved_count += 1
        puts "Збережено транзакцію #{transaction_id}: #{transaction['description']} (#{format_amount(transaction['amount'])} #{transaction['currencyCode']})".colorize(:green)
        
      rescue Sequel::UniqueConstraintViolation
        skipped_count += 1
        puts "Транзакція #{transaction_id} вже існує (race condition) - пропускаємо".colorize(:yellow)
      rescue => e
        puts "Помилка збереження транзакції #{transaction_id}: #{e.message}".colorize(:red)
      end
    end
    
    {
      saved: saved_count,
      skipped: skipped_count,
      total: transactions_list.length
    }
  end
  
  # Отримання останньої транзакції для рахунку
  def last_transaction_time(account_id)
    last_transaction = @transactions
      .where(account: account_id)
      .order(Sequel.desc(:time))
      .first
    
    last_transaction ? last_transaction[:time] : nil
  end
  
  # Отримання всіх збережених транзакцій
  def all_transactions
    @transactions.order(Sequel.desc(:time)).all
  end
  
  # Отримання транзакцій за період
  def transactions_between(start_time, end_time)
    @transactions
      .where(time: start_time..end_time)
      .order(Sequel.desc(:time))
      .all
  end
  
  # Отримання статистики
  def statistics
    {
      total_transactions: @transactions.count,
      total_amount: @transactions.sum(:amount),
      accounts: @transactions.distinct(:account).count,
      last_sync: @transactions.max(:created_at)
    }
  end
  
  private
  
  def format_amount(amount)
    # Конвертація копійок в гривні
    formatted = amount / 100.0
    formatted.round(2).to_s
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative 'monobank_api'
require_relative 'transaction_manager'
require 'dotenv'
require 'colorize'

Dotenv.load

class MonobankSync
  def initialize
    @api = MonobankAPI.new
    @db = Sequel.connect(
      adapter: 'sqlite',
      database: ENV.fetch('DATABASE_PATH', 'monobank_transactions.db')
    )
    @manager = TransactionManager.new(@db)
  end
  
  # Основний метод синхронізації
  def sync
    puts "=== Початок синхронізації з monobank ===".colorize(:cyan)
    puts "Час: #{Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}"
    puts
    
    begin
      # Отримання інформації про рахунки
      accounts = @api.accounts
      puts "Знайдено рахунків: #{accounts.length}"
      puts
      
      total_saved = 0
      total_skipped = 0
      
      accounts.each do |account|
        puts "--- Обробка рахунку: #{account['type']} (#{account['currencyCode']}) ---"
        puts "Баланс: #{format_balance(account['balance'])} #{account['currencyCode']}"
        
        # Визначення часу останньої синхронізації
        last_sync_time = @manager.last_transaction_time(account['id'])
        
        if last_sync_time
          puts "Остання синхронізація: #{last_sync_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}"
          from_time = last_sync_time + 1 # +1 секунда щоб уникнути дублікатів
        else
          puts "Перша синхронізація для цього рахунку"
          # Для першої синхронізації отримуємо дані за останні 30 днів
          from_time = Time.now - (30 * 24 * 60 * 60)
        end
        
        # Отримання транзакцій з API
        puts "Отримання транзакцій..."
        transactions = @api.account_statement(account['id'], from_time, Time.now)
        
        puts "Отримано транзакцій: #{transactions.length}"
        
        # Збереження нових транзакцій
        result = @manager.save_new_transactions(transactions, account)
        
        total_saved += result[:saved]
        total_skipped += result[:skipped]
        
        puts "Збережено нових: #{result[:saved]}, пропущено: #{result[:skipped]}"
        puts
      end
      
      puts "=== Синхронізація завершена ===".colorize(:cyan)
      puts "Всього збережено: #{total_saved}".colorize(:green)
      puts "Всього пропущено: #{total_skipped}".colorize(:yellow)
      
      # Виведення статистики
      stats = @manager.statistics
      puts
      puts "Статистика бази даних:"
      puts "  Всього транзакцій: #{stats[:total_transactions]}"
      puts "  Рахунків: #{stats[:accounts]}"
      puts "  Остання синхронізація: #{stats[:last_sync]}"
      
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка синхронізації: #{e.message}".colorize(:red)
      puts e.backtrace if ENV['DEBUG']
      exit 1
    ensure
      @db.disconnect
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def format_balance(balance)
    (balance / 100.0).round(2).to_s
  end
end
```

Here's a complete Ruby solution for validating Ukrainian IBANs and extracting the MFO code:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

ruby '>= 2.7.0'

# No external gems required - using Ruby standard library only
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# iban_validator.rb
require 'bigdecimal'

class UkrainianIbanValidator
  IBAN_LENGTH = 29
  COUNTRY_CODE = 'UA'
  MFO_START_INDEX = 6
  MFO_LENGTH = 6
  
  class << self
    def validate(iban)
      new(iban).validate
    end
    
    def extract_mfo(iban)
      new(iban).extract_mfo
    end
    
    def valid?(iban)
      new(iban).valid?
    end
  end
  
  def initialize(iban)
    @iban = iban.to_s.strip.upcase
    @errors = []
  end
  
  def valid?
    validate
    @errors.empty?
  end
  
  def validate
    @errors.clear
    
    return false unless check_length
    return false unless check_country_code
    return false unless check_format
    return false unless check_checksum
    
    true
  end
  
  def extract_mfo
    return nil unless valid?
    
    @iban[MFO_START_INDEX, MFO_LENGTH]
  end
  
  def errors
    validate if @errors.empty? && !@validated
    @errors
  end
  
  private
  
  def check_length
    if @iban.length != IBAN_LENGTH
      @errors << "IBAN must be exactly #{IBAN_LENGTH} characters long, got #{@iban.length}"
      return false
    end
    true
  end
  
  def check_country_code
    if @iban[0, 2] != COUNTRY_CODE
      @errors << "IBAN must start with country code '#{COUNTRY_CODE}'"
      return false
    end
    true
  end
  
  def check_format
    # Ukrainian IBAN format: UA + 2 check digits + 6 digits (MFO) + 19 alphanumeric characters
    pattern = /\AUA\d{27}\z/
    
    unless @iban.match?(pattern)
      @errors << "IBAN must contain only digits after 'UA' prefix"
      return false
    end
    
    true
  end
  
  def check_checksum
    # Move first 4 characters to the end
    rearranged = @iban[4..-1] + @iban[0, 4]
    
    # Convert letters to numbers (A=10, B=11, ..., Z=35)
    numeric_string = rearranged.chars.map do |char|
      if char.match?(/[A-Z]/)
        (char.ord - 'A'.ord + 10).to_s
      else
        char
      end
    end.join
    
    # Calculate mod 97
    remainder = calculate_mod_97(numeric_string)
    
    if remainder != 1
      @errors << "Invalid IBAN checksum"
      return false
    end
    
    true
  end
  
  def calculate_mod_97(number_string)
    # Process in chunks to handle large numbers
    current = 0
    
    number_string.chars.each do |digit|
      current = (current * 10 + digit.to_i) % 97
    end
    
    current
  end
end

# Example usage and test cases
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  # Valid Ukrainian IBAN examples (these are examples, not real accounts)
  test_ibans = [
    "UA213223130000026007233566001",  # Example format
    "UA903052992990004149123456789",  # Example format
    "UA123456789012345678901234567",  # Invalid checksum
    "RU123456789012345678901234567",  # Wrong country code
    "UA123",                          # Too short
    "UA12345678901234567890123456A",  # Contains letter
  ]
  
  test_ibans.each_with_index do |iban, index|
    validator = UkrainianIbanValidator.new(iban)
    
    puts "Test #{index + 1}: #{iban}"
    puts "  Valid: #{validator.valid?}"
    
    if validator.valid?
      puts "  MFO Code: #{validator.extract_mfo}"
    else
      puts "  Errors: #{validator.errors.join(', ')}"
    end
    puts
  end
  
  # Generate a valid test IBAN (for demonstration)
  puts "Generating valid IBAN example..."
  mfo = "305299"
  account = "2990004149123456789"
  
  # Create IBAN without checksum
  iban_without_checksum = "UA00#{mfo}#{account}"
  
  # Calculate checksum
  rearranged = iban_without_checksum[4..-1] + iban_without_checksum[0, 4]
  numeric_string = rearranded.chars.map do |char|
    if char.match?(/[A-Z]/)
      (char.ord - 'A'.ord + 10).to_s
    else
      char
    end
  end.join
  
  checksum = 98 - (UkrainianIbanValidator.new("").send(:calculate_mod_97, numeric_string) % 97)
  checksum = checksum.to_s.rjust(2, '0')
  
  valid_iban = "UA#{checksum}#{mfo}#{account}"
  puts "Generated valid IBAN: #{valid_iban}"
  
  validator = UkrainianIbanValidator.new(valid_iban)
  puts "Validation result: #{validator.valid?}"
  puts "Extracted MFO: #{validator.extract_mfo}" if validator.valid?
end
```

## Usage Example

```ruby
# usage_example.rb
require_relative 'iban_validator'

# Create a validator instance
validator = UkrainianIbanValidator.new("UA213223130000026007233566001")

# Check if IBAN is valid
if validator.valid?
  puts "IBAN is valid!"
  puts "MFO code: #{validator.extract_mfo}"
else
  puts "IBAN is invalid:"
  validator.errors.each { |error| puts "  - #{error}" }
end

# Class methods for convenience
iban = "UA213223130000026007233566001"
puts "Is valid: #{UkrainianIbanValidator.valid?(iban)}"
puts "MFO: #{UkrainianIbanValidator.extract_mfo(iban)}"
```

## Key Features

1. **Validation**:
   - Checks length (must be 29 characters)
   - Verifies country code (must be "UA")
   - Validates format (digits only after "UA")
   - Verifies IBAN checksum using mod-97 algorithm

2. **MFO Extraction**:
   - Extracts the 6-digit bank code (MFO) from positions 6-11
   - Only extracts from valid IBANs

3. **Error Reporting**:
   - Provides detailed error messages for each validation failure
   - Collects all errors at once

4. **No External Dependencies**:
   - Uses only Ruby standard library
   - Handles large number calculations efficiently

The code follows Ukrainian IBAN standards where the format is:
- Positions 1-2: Country code (UA)
- Positions 3-4: Check digits
- Positions 5-10: Bank code (MFO)
- Positions 11-29: Account number (19 digits)

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'logger'

module Vchasno
  class Client
    include HTTParty
    
    BASE_URL = 'https://api.vchasno.ua/v1'
    
    attr_reader :api_key, :private_key, :logger
    
    def initialize(api_key:, private_key_path:, private_key_password: nil, logger: nil)
      @api_key = api_key
      @private_key = load_private_key(private_key_path, private_key_password)
      @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
      
      self.class.base_uri BASE_URL
      self.class.headers default_headers
    end
    
    # Upload a document for signing
    def upload_document(file_path:, counterparty_edrpou:, document_name:)
      logger.info("Uploading document: #{document_name}")
      
      payload = {
        document: {
          name: document_name,
          counterparty_edrpou: counterparty_edrpou,
          file: Base64.strict_encode64(File.read(file_path))
        }
      }
      
      response = self.class.post('/documents/upload', 
        body: payload.to_json,
        headers: auth_headers
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    # Send document for signing
    def send_for_signing(document_id:, signer_email:, signer_phone:)
      logger.info("Sending document #{document_id} for signing")
      
      payload = {
        document_id: document_id,
        signer: {
          email: signer_email,
          phone: signer_phone
        }
      }
      
      response = self.class.post('/documents/send',
        body: payload.to_json,
        headers: auth_headers
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    # Sign document
    def sign_document(document_id:, signature_position: { page: 1, x: 100, y: 100 })
      logger.info("Signing document: #{document_id}")
      
      signature = create_signature(document_id)
      
      payload = {
        document_id: document_id,
        signature: {
          data: signature,
          position: signature_position
        }
      }
      
      response = self.class.post('/documents/sign',
        body: payload.to_json,
        headers: auth_headers
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    # Get document status
    def get_document_status(document_id:)
      logger.info("Getting status for document: #{document_id}")
      
      response = self.class.get("/documents/#{document_id}/status",
        headers: auth_headers
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    # Download signed document
    def download_signed_document(document_id:, output_path:)
      logger.info("Downloading signed document: #{document_id}")
      
      response = self.class.get("/documents/#{document_id}/download",
        headers: auth_headers
      )
      
      if response.success?
        File.binwrite(output_path, response.body)
        logger.info("Document saved to: #{output_path}")
        { success: true, path: output_path }
      else
        handle_response(response)
      end
    end
    
    # Get list of documents
    def get_documents(status: nil, date_from: nil, date_to: nil)
      logger.info("Getting documents list")
      
      query = {}
      query[:status] = status if status
      query[:date_from] = date_from if date_from
      query[:date_to] = date_to if date_to
      
      response = self.class.get('/documents',
        query: query,
        headers: auth_headers
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    # Check counterparty status
    def check_counterparty(edrpou:)
      logger.info("Checking counterparty: #{edrpou}")
      
      response = self.class.get("/counterparties/check/#{edrpou}",
        headers: auth_headers
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    private
    
    def load_private_key(path, password)
      key_content = File.read(path)
      OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(key_content, password)
    rescue => e
      logger.error("Failed to load private key: #{e.message}")
      raise
    end
    
    def default_headers
      {
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'User-Agent' => 'Vchasno-Ruby-Client/1.0'
      }
    end
    
    def auth_headers
      timestamp = Time.now.to_i.to_s
      signature = generate_signature(timestamp)
      
      {
        'X-API-Key' => api_key,
        'X-Timestamp' => timestamp,
        'X-Signature' => signature
      }
    end
    
    def generate_signature(timestamp)
      data = "#{api_key}#{timestamp}"
      Base64.strict_encode64(private_key.sign(OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new, data))
    end
    
    def create_signature(document_id)
      # Create document signature using private key
      data = "document:#{document_id}:#{Time.now.to_i}"
      Base64.strict_encode64(private_key.sign(OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new, data))
    end
    
    def handle_response(response)
      case response.code
      when 200..299
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      when 400
        logger.error("Bad request: #{response.body}")
        raise "Bad request: #{response.body}"
      when 401
        logger.error("Unauthorized: #{response.body}")
        raise "Unauthorized access"
      when 403
        logger.error("Forbidden: #{response.body}")
        raise "Access forbidden"
      when 404
        logger.error("Not found: #{response.body}")
        raise "Resource not found"
      when 422
        logger.error("Validation error: #{response.body}")
        raise "Validation error: #{response.body}"
      when 500..599
        logger.error("Server error: #{response.body}")
        raise "Vchasno API server error"
      else
        logger.error("Unexpected response code: #{response.code}")
        raise "Unexpected response: #{response.code}"
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      logger.error("Invalid JSON response: #{e.message}")
      raise "Invalid response format"
    end
  end
end

module Vchasno
  class DocumentManager
    attr_reader :client, :logger
    
    def initialize(client:, logger: nil)
      @client = client
      @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
    end
    
    # Complete workflow: upload, send, sign, and download document
    def exchange_document(file_path:, counterparty_edrpou:, signer_email:, signer_phone:, document_name: nil)
      logger.info("Starting document exchange workflow")
      
      # Step 1: Upload document
      upload_result = client.upload_document(
        file_path: file_path,
        counterparty_edrpou: counterparty_edrpou,
        document_name: document_name || File.basename(file_path)
      )
      document_id = upload_result['document_id']
      logger.info("Document uploaded with ID: #{document_id}")
      
      # Step 2: Send for signing
      send_result = client.send_for_signing(
        document_id: document_id,
        signer_email: signer_email,
        signer_phone: signer_phone
      )
      logger.info("Document sent for signing")
      
      # Step 3: Sign document
      sign_result = client.sign_document(document_id: document_id)
      logger.info("Document signed")
      
      # Step 4: Check status (polling)
      status = poll_for_status(document_id)
      
      # Step 5: Download signed document if completed
      if status == 'signed' || status == 'completed'
        output_path = "signed_#{File.basename(file_path)}"
        download_result = client.download_signed_document(
          document_id: document_id,
          output_path: output_path
        )
        
        {
          success: true,
          document_id: document_id,
          status: status,
          signed_document_path: output_path,
          workflow: {
            upload: upload_result,
            send: send_result,
            sign: sign_result,
            download: download_result
          }
        }
      else
        {
          success: false,
          document_id: document_id,
          status: status,
          message: "Document exchange incomplete. Status: #{status}"
        }
      end
    rescue => e
      logger.error("Document exchange failed: #{e.message}")
      {
        success: false,
        error: e.message
      }
    end
    
    # Send multiple documents
    def exchange_multiple_documents(documents:)
      results = []
      
      documents.each_with_index do |doc, index|
        logger.info("Processing document #{index + 1} of #{documents.length}")
        
        result = exchange_document(
          file_path: doc[:file_path],
          counterparty_edrpou: doc[:counterparty_edrpou],
          signer_email: doc[:signer_email],
          signer_phone: doc[:signer_phone],
          document_name: doc[:document_name]
        )
        
        results << result
      end
      
      results
    end
    
    private
    
    def poll_for_status(document_id, timeout: 300, interval: 10)
      start_time = Time.now
      
      loop do
        status_result = client.get_document_status(document_id: document_id)
        status = status_result['status']
        
        logger.info("Document #{document_id} status: #{status}")
        
        return status if ['signed', 'completed', 'rejected', 'failed'].include?(status)
        
        if Time.now - start_time > timeout
          logger.warn("Timeout waiting for document #{document_id}")
          return status
        end
        
        sleep(interval)
      end
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# vat_check.rb
require 'mechanize'

class VatCheckError < StandardError; end

class VatPayerChecker
  TAX_SERVICE_URL = 'https://www.tax.gov.ua/businesspartner/Control'

  VAT_REGISTERED_MARKERS = [
    /перебуває в реєстрі платників податку на додану вартість/i,
    /є платником податку на додану вартість/i,
    /свідоцтво платника пдв/i,
    /платник пдв/i
  ].freeze

  VAT_NOT_REGISTERED_MARKERS = [
    /не є платником податку на додану вартість/i,
    /не зареєстрований платником пдв/i,
    /відсутній в реєстрі платників пдв/i,
    /не знайдено/i
  ].freeze

  def initialize(agent: Mechanize.new)
    @agent = agent
    @agent.user_agent = 'VatPayerChecker/1.0 (Ruby)'
  end

  def check(ipn)
    ipn = normalize(ipn)
    validate!(ipn)

    page = @agent.get(TAX_SERVICE_URL)
    form = find_search_form(page)
    fill_search_code(form, ipn)

    result_page = @agent.submit(form)
    parse_result(result_page, ipn)
  rescue Mechanize::ResponseCodeError => e
    raise VatCheckError, "tax service returned HTTP error: #{e.message}"
  rescue Mechanize::Error => e
    raise VatCheckError, "failed to access tax service: #{e.message}"
  end

  private

  def normalize(value)
    value.to_s.gsub(/[\s\-()]/, '')
  end

  def validate!(ipn)
    unless ipn.match?(/\A\d{8,12}\z/)
      raise ArgumentError, 'ІПН має бути числовим кодом (8–12 цифр)'
    end
  end

  def find_search_form(page)
    page.forms.find { |form| search_field(form) } ||
      raise(VatCheckError, 'search form not found')
  end

  def search_field(form)
    form.fields.find { |field| field.name.match?(/\A(ipn|edrpou|code|tin|taxnum)\z/i) }
  end

  def fill_search_code(form, ipn)
    field = search_field(form)
    raise VatCheckError, 'search input not found' unless field

    form[field.name] = ipn
  end

  def parse_result(page, ipn)
    text = page.parser.text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip

    registered = if VAT_REGISTERED_MARKERS.any? { |marker| text.match?(marker) }
                   true
                 elsif VAT_NOT_REGISTERED_MARKERS.any? { |marker| text.match?(marker) }
                   false
                 end

    {
      ipn: ipn,
      vat_registered: registered,
      source: TAX_SERVICE_URL,
      raw_text: text
    }
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  ipn = ARGV[0]
  abort 'Usage: ruby vat_check.rb <ІПН>' unless ipn

  begin
    result = VatPayerChecker.new.check(ipn)
    puts "ІПН: #{result[:ipn]}"
    status = case result[:vat_registered]
             when true then 'зареєстрований платником ПДВ'
             when false then 'не зареєстрований платником ПДВ'
             else 'не вдалося визначити статус'
             end
    puts "Статус: #{status}"
    puts "Деталі: #{result[:raw_text]}" if result[:vat_registered].nil?
  rescue StandardError => e
    abort "Помилка: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

The code uses the public business-partner search form of the Ukrainian State Tax Service. If the site changes its markup, field names or result markers, the constants may need to be updated.

# alpha_sms_sender.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'
require 'logger'

Dotenv.load

class AlphaSMSSender
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://alphasms.ua/api/json.php'
  
  attr_reader :api_key, :logger
  
  def initialize(api_key: nil, logger: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['ALPHASMS_API_KEY']
    @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT)
    
    raise ArgumentError, 'API key is required' if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
  end
  
  def send_sms(phone:, message:, sender_name:)
    validate_phone!(phone)
    validate_message!(message)
    validate_sender_name!(sender_name)
    
    payload = build_payload(phone, message, sender_name)
    
    logger.info("Sending SMS to #{phone} from #{sender_name}")
    
    response = self.class.post(
      BASE_URL,
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' },
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.error("Failed to send SMS: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
  
  def send_bulk_sms(recipients:, message:, sender_name:)
    validate_message!(message)
    validate_sender_name!(sender_name)
    
    results = []
    
    recipients.each do |phone|
      begin
        result = send_sms(phone: phone, message: message, sender_name: sender_name)
        results << { phone: phone, success: true, result: result }
      rescue => e
        results << { phone: phone, success: false, error: e.message }
      end
    end
    
    results
  end
  
  private
  
  def build_payload(phone, message, sender_name)
    {
      version: '1.0',
      key: api_key,
      action: 'sendSMS',
      sender: sender_name,
      message: message,
      phone: phone,
      type: 'json'
    }
  end
  
  def validate_phone!(phone)
    unless phone.match?(/^\+?\d{10,15}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid phone number format: #{phone}"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_message!(message)
    if message.nil? || message.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, 'Message cannot be empty'
    end
    
    if message.length > 160
      raise ArgumentError, 'Message exceeds 160 characters limit'
    end
  end
  
  def validate_sender_name!(sender_name)
    if sender_name.nil? || sender_name.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, 'Sender name cannot be empty'
    end
    
    if sender_name.length > 11
      raise ArgumentError, 'Sender name exceeds 11 characters limit'
    end
    
    unless sender_name.match?(/^[A-Za-z0-9]+$/)
      raise ArgumentError, 'Sender name can only contain letters and numbers'
    end
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    if response.success?
      parsed_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      if parsed_response['error']
        logger.error("API Error: #{parsed_response['error']}")
        raise "AlphaSMS API Error: #{parsed_response['error']}"
      end
      
      logger.info("SMS sent successfully. ID: #{parsed_response['id']}")
      parsed_response
    else
      logger.error("HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}")
      raise "HTTP Error: #{response.code} - #{response.message}"
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    logger.error("Failed to parse API response: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Налаштування
  sender = AlphaSMSSender.new
  
  # Відправка одного SMS
  begin
    result = sender.send_sms(
      phone: '+380501234567',
      message: 'Тестове повідомлення від Ruby',
      sender_name: 'MyCompany'
    )
    puts "SMS sent successfully: #{result.inspect}"
  rescue => e
    puts "Failed to send SMS: #{e.message}"
  end
  
  # Відправка кількох SMS
  recipients = ['+380501234567', '+380671234567', '+380931234567']
  
  results = sender.send_bulk_sms(
    recipients: recipients,
    message: 'Масове повідомлення',
    sender_name: 'MyCompany'
  )
  
  results.each do |result|
    if result[:success]
      puts "✓ SMS sent to #{result[:phone]}"
    else
      puts "✗ Failed to send to #{result[:phone]}: #{result[:error]}"
    end
  end
end

```ruby
# lib/olx_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require_relative '../config/olx_config'

class OLXClient
  include HTTParty
  
  base_uri OLXConfig::BASE_URL
  
  attr_reader :logger
  
  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    @access_token = OLXConfig.access_token
    @refresh_token = OLXConfig.refresh_token
  end
  
  # Отримання нового access token за допомогою refresh token
  def refresh_access_token
    logger.info("Refreshing access token...")
    
    response = self.class.post(
      '/oauth/token',
      body: {
        grant_type: 'refresh_token',
        client_id: OLXConfig.client_id,
        client_secret: OLXConfig.client_secret,
        refresh_token: @refresh_token
      },
      headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      token_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      @access_token = token_data['access_token']
      @refresh_token = token_data['refresh_token']
      
      # Оновлення токенів у змінних середовища
      update_env_tokens(@access_token, @refresh_token)
      
      logger.info("Access token refreshed successfully")
      return true
    else
      logger.error("Failed to refresh token: #{response.body}")
      return false
    end
  end
  
  # Публікація нового оголошення
  def create_advertisement(ad_data)
    logger.info("Creating new advertisement...")
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "/#{OLXConfig::API_VERSION}/offers",
      body: ad_data.to_json,
      headers: auth_headers.merge('Content-Type' => 'application/json')
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Advertisement created successfully")
  end
  
  # Оновлення існуючого оголошення
  def update_advertisement(ad_id, ad_data)
    logger.info("Updating advertisement #{ad_id}...")
    
    response = self.class.put(
      "/#{OLXConfig::API_VERSION}/offers/#{ad_id}",
      body: ad_data.to_json,
      headers: auth_headers.merge('Content-Type' => 'application/json')
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Advertisement #{ad_id} updated successfully")
  end
  
  # Отримання інформації про оголошення
  def get_advertisement(ad_id)
    logger.info("Getting advertisement #{ad_id}...")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/#{OLXConfig::API_VERSION}/offers/#{ad_id}",
      headers: auth_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Advertisement #{ad_id} retrieved successfully")
  end
  
  # Видалення оголошення
  def delete_advertisement(ad_id)
    logger.info("Deleting advertisement #{ad_id}...")
    
    response = self.class.delete(
      "/#{OLXConfig::API_VERSION}/offers/#{ad_id}",
      headers: auth_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Advertisement #{ad_id} deleted successfully")
  end
  
  # Отримання списку всіх оголошень
  def list_advertisements(params = {})
    logger.info("Listing advertisements...")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/#{OLXConfig::API_VERSION}/offers",
      query: params,
      headers: auth_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Advertisements listed successfully")
  end
  
  # Активація оголошення
  def activate_advertisement(ad_id)
    logger.info("Activating advertisement #{ad_id}...")
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "/#{OLXConfig::API_VERSION}/offers/#{ad_id}/commands",
      body: { command: 'activate' }.to_json,
      headers: auth_headers.merge('Content-Type' => 'application/json')
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Advertisement #{ad_id} activated successfully")
  end
  
  # Деактивація оголошення
  def deactivate_advertisement(ad_id)
    logger.info("Deactivating advertisement #{ad_id}...")
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "/#{OLXConfig::API_VERSION}/offers/#{ad_id}/commands",
      body: { command: 'deactivate' }.to_json,
      headers: auth_headers.merge('Content-Type' => 'application/json')
    )
    
    handle_response(response, "Advertisement #{ad_id} deactivated successfully")
  end
  
  private
  
  def auth_headers
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}",
      'Accept' => 'application/json'
    }
  end
  
  def handle_response(response, success_message)
    if response.success?
      logger.info(success_message)
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    elsif response.code == 401
      logger.warn("Token expired, refreshing...")
      if refresh_access_token
        # Повторна спроба з новим токеном
        retry
      else
        raise "Authentication failed"
      end
    else
      logger.error("API Error #{response.code}: #{response.body}")
      raise "OLX API Error: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  def update_env_tokens(access_token, refresh_token)
    # Оновлення .env файлу з новими токенами
    env_file = File.join(Dir.pwd, '.env')
    
    if File.exist?(env_file)
      content = File.read(env_file)
      content = content.gsub(/^OLX_ACCESS_TOKEN=.*$/, "OLX_ACCESS_TOKEN=#{access_token}")
      content = content.gsub(/^OLX_REFRESH_TOKEN=.*$/, "OLX_REFRESH_TOKEN=#{refresh_token}")
      File.write(env_file, content)
    end
  end
end

Основний клас для роботи з SendPulse API ```ruby # sendpulse_client.rb require 'httparty' require 'json' require 'logger' class SendPulseClient include HTTParty API_URL = 'https://api.sendpulse.com' TOKEN_URL = 'https://api.sendpulse.com/oauth/access_token' attr_reader :client_id, :client_secret, :access_token, :logger def initialize(client_id:, client_secret:, logger: nil) @client_id = client_id @client_secret = client_secret @logger = logger || Logger.new($stdout) @access_token = nil @token_expires_at = nil authenticate! end # Аутентифікація та отримання токену def authenticate! response = self.class.post( TOKEN_URL, body: { grant_type: 'client_credentials', client_id: client_id, client_secret: client_secret }, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' } ) if response.success? data = JSON.parse(response.body) @access_token = data['access_token'] @token_expires_at = Time.now + data['expires_in'].to_i logger.info('Successfully authenticated with SendPulse API') true else logger.error("Authentication failed: #{response.body}") raise "Authentication failed: #{response.body}" end end # Перевірка та оновлення токену при необхідності def ensure_valid_token authenticate! if token_expired? end def token_expired? !@access_token || !@token_expires_at || Time.now >= @token_expires_at - 60 end # Створення email-розсилки def create_campaign(campaign_data) ensure_valid_token response = self.class.post( "#{API_URL}/smtp/campaigns", body: campaign_data.to_json, headers: auth_headers ) handle_response(response, 'Campaign created') end # Відправка email-розсилки def send_campaign(campaign_id, recipients) ensure_valid_token response = self.class.post( "#{API_URL}/smtp/campaigns/#{campaign_id}/send", body: { emails: recipients, send_date: Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') }.to_json, headers: auth_headers ) handle_response(response, 'Campaign sent') end # Створення та відправка розсилки одним методом def send_newsletter(subject:, body:, from_name:, from_email:, recipients:, template_id: nil) campaign_data = { subject: subject, body: body, from_name: from_name, from_email: from_email } # Додаємо template_id якщо він вказаний campaign_data[:template_id] = template_id if template_id campaign_response = create_campaign(campaign_data) campaign_id = campaign_response['id'] if campaign_id send_campaign(campaign_id, recipients) else raise "Failed to create campaign: #{campaign_response.inspect}" end end # Отримання списку розсилок def get_campaigns(limit: 100, offset: 0) ensure_valid_token response = self.class.get( "#{API_URL}/smtp/campaigns", query: { limit: limit, offset: offset }, headers: auth_headers ) handle_response(response, 'Campaigns retrieved') end # Отримання статистики по розсилці def get_campaign_statistics(campaign_id) ensure_valid_token response = self.class.get( "#{API_URL}/smtp/campaigns/#{campaign_id}/statistics", headers: auth_headers ) handle_response(response, 'Campaign statistics retrieved') end private def auth_headers { 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}", 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' } end def handle_response(response, success_message) if response.success? logger.info("#{success_message} successfully") JSON.parse(response.body) else logger.error("API Error: #{response.body}") raise "API Error: #{response.body}" end end end ``` ### 2. Клас для створення та управління розсилками ```ruby # newsletter_manager.rb require_relative 'sendpulse_client' class NewsletterManager attr_reader :client, :logger def initialize(client_id:, client_secret:, logger: nil) @logger = logger || Logger.new($stdout) @client = SendPulseClient.new( client_id: client_id, client_secret: client_secret, logger: @logger ) end # Створення та відправка простої розсилки def send_simple_newsletter(subject:, content:, from_name:, from_email:, recipients:) logger.info("Sending newsletter: #{subject}") result = client.send_newsletter( subject: subject, body: content, from_name: from_name, from_email: from_email, recipients: recipients ) logger.info("Newsletter sent successfully: #{result.inspect}") result rescue => e logger.error("Failed to send newsletter: #{e.message}") raise end # Створення розсилки з HTML шаблоном def send_html_newsletter(subject:, html_content:, from_name:, from_email:, recipients:) logger.info("Sending HTML newsletter: #{subject}") campaign_data = { subject: subject, body: html_content, from_name: from_name, from_email: from_email, template: { id: nil, name: "Template for #{subject}", body: html_content } } campaign_response = client.create_campaign(campaign_data) if campaign_response && campaign_response['id'] client.send_campaign(campaign_response['id'], recipients) else raise "Failed to create HTML campaign" end rescue => e logger.error("Failed to send HTML newsletter: #{e.message}") raise end # Отримання статистики по всіх розсилках def get_all_statistics(limit: 10) logger.info("Getting statistics for last #{limit} campaigns") campaigns = client.get_campaigns(limit: limit) statistics = campaigns.map do |campaign| campaign_id = campaign['id'] stats = client.get_campaign_statistics(campaign_id) { campaign_id: campaign_id, subject: campaign['subject'], created_at: campaign['created_at'], statistics: stats } end logger.info("Retrieved statistics for #{statistics.size} campaigns") statistics rescue => e logger.error("Failed to get statistics: #{e.message}") raise end end ``` ### 3. Приклад використання ```ruby # example_usage.rb require 'dotenv' require 'logger' require_relative 'newsletter_manager' # Завантаження змінних середовища Dotenv.load # Налаштування логера logger = Logger.new('newsletter.log') logger.level = Logger::INFO # Ініціалізація менеджера manager = NewsletterManager.new( client_id: ENV['SENDPULSE_CLIENT_ID'], client_secret: ENV['SENDPULSE_CLIENT_SECRET'], logger: logger ) # Приклад 1: Проста текстова розсилка begin result = manager.send_simple_newsletter( subject: 'Welcome to our newsletter!', content: 'Hello! Welcome to our newsletter. Stay tuned for updates.', from_name: 'Your Company', from_email: 'newsletter@yourcompany.com', recipients: [ { email: 'user1@example.com', name: 'User One' }, { email: 'user2@example.com', name: 'User Two' } ] ) puts "Newsletter sent: #{result.inspect}" rescue => e puts "Error: #{e.message}" end # Приклад 2: HTML розсилка begin html_content = <<-HTML
