Shop Now HTML result = manager.send_html_newsletter( subject: 'Special Offer - 20% Off!', html_content: html_content, from_name: 'Your Company', from_email: 'offers@yourcompany.com', recipients: [ { email: 'customer1@example.com' }, { email: 'customer2@example.com' } ] ) puts "HTML Newsletter sent: #{result.inspect}" rescue => e puts "Error: #{e.message}" end # Приклад 3: Отримання статистики begin statistics = manager.get_all_statistics(limit: 5) statistics.each do |campaign_stats| puts "Campaign: #{campaign_stats[:subject]}" puts "Statistics: #{campaign_stats[:statistics].inspect}" end rescue => e puts "Error getting statistics: #{e.message}" end ``` ### 4. Файл конфігурації .env ```bash # .env SENDPULSE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id_here SENDPULSE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret_here ``` ### 5. Додаткові утиліти ```ruby # newsletter_helpers.rb module NewsletterHelpers # Валідація email адрес def self.valid_email?(email) email =~ /\A[\w+\-.]+@[a-z\d\-]+(\.[a-z\d\-]+)*\.[a-z]+\z/i end # Форматування списку отримувачів def self.format_recipients(recipients) recipients.map do |recipient| if recipient.is_a?(String) { email: recipient } elsif recipient.is_a?(Hash) && recipient[:email] { email: recipient[:email], name: recipient[:name] } else raise "Invalid recipient format: #{recipient.inspect}" end end end # Створення HTML шаблону з базовим оформленням def self.create_basic_template(content:, title: nil) <<-HTML #{title || 'Newsletter'}

#{title || 'Newsletter'}

#{content}

© #{Time.now.year} Your Company. All rights reserved.

You're receiving this email because you subscribed to our newsletter.

HTML end end ``` ## Інструкція з використання 1. **Встановіть залежності:** ```bash bundle install ``` 2. **Налаштуйте змінні середовища:** Створіть файл `.env` з вашими SendPulse credentials 3. **Запустіть приклад:** ```bash ruby example_usage.rb ``` Цей код забезпечує повний функціонал для роботи з email-розсилками через SendPulse API, включаючи аутентифікацію, створення розсилок, відправку та отримання статистики.

Ось рішення на Ruby для перетворення тексту з неправильної розкладки клавіатури:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

ruby '>= 3.0.0'
```

## Реалізація

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'unicode_utils'

class UkrainianKeyboardConverter
  # Мапа відповідності латинських символів українським
  # для стандартної розкладки клавіатури
  LATIN_TO_UKRAINIAN = {
    'a' => 'ф', 'b' => 'і', 'c' => 'с', 'd' => 'в', 'e' => 'у',
    'f' => 'а', 'g' => 'п', 'h' => 'р', 'i' => 'ш', 'j' => 'о',
    'k' => 'л', 'l' => 'д', 'm' => 'ь', 'n' => 'т', 'o' => 'щ',
    'p' => 'з', 'q' => 'й', 'r' => 'к', 's' => 'и', 't' => 'е',
    'u' => 'г', 'v' => 'м', 'w' => 'ц', 'x' => 'ч', 'y' => 'н',
    'z' => 'я',
    'A' => 'Ф', 'B' => 'І', 'C' => 'С', 'D' => 'В', 'E' => 'У',
    'F' => 'А', 'G' => 'П', 'H' => 'Р', 'I' => 'Ш', 'J' => 'О',
    'K' => 'Л', 'L' => 'Д', 'M' => 'Ь', 'N' => 'Т', 'O' => 'Щ',
    'P' => 'З', 'Q' => 'Й', 'R' => 'К', 'S' => 'И', 'T' => 'Е',
    'U' => 'Г', 'V' => 'М', 'W' => 'Ц', 'X' => 'Ч', 'Y' => 'Н',
    'Z' => 'Я'
  }.freeze

  # Додаткові символи для української розкладки
  SPECIAL_CHARS = {
    '`' => "'", '~' => '₴', 
    '[' => 'х', '{' => 'Х',
    ']' => 'ї', '}' => 'Ї',
    ';' => 'ж', ':' => 'Ж',
    "'" => 'є', '"' => 'Є',
    ',' => 'б', '<' => 'Б',
    '.' => 'ю', '>' => 'Ю',
    '/' => '.', '?' => ',',
    '\\' => 'ґ', '|' => 'Ґ'
  }.freeze

  class << self
    def convert(text)
      return '' if text.nil? || text.empty?
      
      result = text.chars.map do |char|
        if LATIN_TO_UKRAINIAN.key?(char)
          LATIN_TO_UKRAINIAN[char]
        elsif SPECIAL_CHARS.key?(char)
          SPECIAL_CHARS[char]
        else
          char
        end
      end
      
      result.join
    end

    def convert!(text)
      converted = convert(text)
      text.replace(converted) if text.respond_to?(:replace)
      converted
    end

    # Метод для перевірки, чи текст містить латинські символи
    # які можна конвертувати
    def convertible?(text)
      return false if text.nil? || text.empty?
      
      text.chars.any? { |char| LATIN_TO_UKRAINIAN.key?(char) || SPECIAL_CHARS.key?(char) }
    end

    # Статистика конвертації
    def conversion_stats(text)
      return { total_chars: 0, converted_chars: 0, conversion_rate: 0.0 } if text.nil? || text.empty?
      
      total_chars = text.length
      converted_chars = 0
      
      text.chars.each do |char|
        converted_chars += 1 if LATIN_TO_UKRAINIAN.key?(char) || SPECIAL_CHARS.key?(char)
      end
      
      {
        total_chars: total_chars,
        converted_chars: converted_chars,
        conversion_rate: (converted_chars.to_f / total_chars * 100).round(2)
      }
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
require_relative 'ukrainian_keyboard_converter'

class UkrainianKeyboardCLI
  def self.run
    puts "Конвертер української розкладки клавіатури"
    puts "=" * 50
    
    if ARGV.empty?
      interactive_mode
    else
      file_mode(ARGV)
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def self.interactive_mode
    puts "Введіть текст для конвертації (Ctrl+D для завершення):"
    puts "Або введіть 'exit' для виходу"
    
    loop do
      print "\n> "
      input = gets&.chomp
      
      break if input.nil? || input.downcase == 'exit'
      
      if input.empty?
        puts "Порожній рядок"
        next
      end
      
      converted = UkrainianKeyboardConverter.convert(input)
      puts "Результат: #{converted}"
      
      stats = UkrainianKeyboardConverter.conversion_stats(input)
      puts "Конвертовано символів: #{stats[:converted_chars]} з #{stats[:total_chars]} (#{stats[:conversion_rate]}%)"
    end
  end
  
  def self.file_mode(args)
    input_file = args[0]
    output_file = args[1] || "converted_#{input_file}"
    
    unless File.exist?(input_file)
      puts "Помилка: файл '#{input_file}' не знайдено"
      exit 1
    end
    
    content = File.read(input_file)
    converted = UkrainianKeyboardConverter.convert(content)
    File.write(output_file, converted)
    
    puts "Файл '#{input_file}' успішно конвертовано"
    puts "Результат збережено в '#{output_file}'"
    
    stats = UkrainianKeyboardConverter.conversion_stats(content)
    puts "Конвертовано символів: #{stats[:converted_chars]} з #{stats[:total_chars]} (#{stats[:conversion_rate]}%)"
  end
end
```

Ось повна реалізація для роботи з API Portmone на Ruby: ## Gemfile ```ruby source 'https://rubygems.org' gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21.0' gem 'json', '~> 2.6' gem 'openssl', '~> 3.0' gem 'base64', '~> 0.1' gem 'dotenv', '~> 2.8' gem 'sinatra', '~> 3.0' gem 'puma', '~> 6.0' gem 'rack', '~> 2.2' ``` ## Реалізація ### 1. Конфігураційний файл (config/portmone.rb) ```ruby # config/portmone.rb require 'dotenv' Dotenv.load module PortmoneConfig class << self def payee_id ENV['PORTMONE_PAYEE_ID'] || 'your_payee_id' end def login ENV['PORTMONE_LOGIN'] || 'your_login' end def password ENV['PORTMONE_PASSWORD'] || 'your_password' end def api_url ENV['PORTMONE_API_URL'] || 'https://www.portmone.com.ua/gateway/' end def return_url ENV['PORTMONE_RETURN_URL'] || 'http://localhost:4567/payment/result' end def callback_url ENV['PORTMONE_CALLBACK_URL'] || 'http://localhost:4567/payment/callback' end end end ``` ### 2. Сервіс для роботи з Portmone API (app/services/portmone_service.rb) ```ruby # app/services/portmone_service.rb require 'httparty' require 'json' require 'openssl' require 'base64' class PortmoneService include HTTParty attr_reader :config def initialize @config = PortmoneConfig end # Створення платіжного посилання def create_payment_link(order_data) begin payload = build_payment_payload(order_data) signature = generate_signature(payload) response = self.class.post( "#{config.api_url}gateway.php", body: { method: 'createPayment', data: payload, signature: signature }.to_json, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json', 'Accept' => 'application/json' }, timeout: 30 ) parse_response(response) rescue StandardError => e { success: false, error: e.message, code: 'PORTMONE_API_ERROR' } end end # Обробка зворотного виклику від Portmone def process_callback(callback_data) begin # Перевірка підпису callback unless verify_callback_signature(callback_data) return { success: false, error: 'Invalid signature', code: 'INVALID_SIGNATURE' } end # Обробка результату платежу result = parse_callback_result(callback_data) if result[:status] == 'PAYED' # Тут можна додати логіку оновлення замовлення в базі даних update_order_status(result[:order_id], 'paid') elsif result[:status] == 'FAILED' update_order_status(result[:order_id], 'failed') end result rescue StandardError => e { success: false, error: e.message, code: 'CALLBACK_PROCESSING_ERROR' } end end private def build_payment_payload(order_data) { payee_id: config.payee_id, login: config.login, password: config.password, order_id: order_data[:order_id], amount: order_data[:amount], currency: order_data[:currency] || 'UAH', description: order_data[:description] || "Payment for order #{order_data[:order_id]}", return_url: config.return_url, callback_url: config.callback_url, locale: order_data[:locale] || 'uk', customer: { email: order_data[:customer_email], phone: order_data[:customer_phone], first_name: order_data[:customer_first_name], last_name: order_data[:customer_last_name] } } end def generate_signature(payload) data_string = payload.values.join(';') signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA256', config.password, data_string) Base64.strict_encode64(signature) end def verify_callback_signature(callback_data) # Реалізація перевірки підпису callback # Залежить від конкретної документації Portmone expected_signature = callback_data['signature'] data_string = [ callback_data['payee_id'], callback_data['order_id'], callback_data['amount'], callback_data['status'] ].join(';') calculated_signature = Base64.strict_encode64( OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA256', config.password, data_string) ) secure_compare(expected_signature, calculated_signature) end def secure_compare(a, b) return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize l = a.unpack("C*") r = 0 b.each_byte { |byte| r |= byte ^ l.shift } r == 0 end def parse_response(response) if response.code == 200 data = JSON.parse(response.body) if data['result'] == 'success' { success: true, payment_url: data['payment_url'], payment_id: data['payment_id'], order_id: data['order_id'] } else { success: false, error: data['error_message'] || 'Payment creation failed', code: data['error_code'] || 'UNKNOWN_ERROR' } end else { success: false, error: "HTTP Error: #{response.code}", code: 'HTTP_ERROR' } end end def parse_callback_result(callback_data) { order_id: callback_data['order_id'], payment_id: callback_data['payment_id'], status: callback_data['status'], amount: callback_data['amount'], currency: callback_data['currency'], transaction_id: callback_data['transaction_id'], success: callback_data['status'] == 'PAYED' } end def update_order_status(order_id, status) # Тут має бути логіка оновлення статусу замовлення в базі даних puts "Order #{order_id} status updated to: #{status}" end end ``` ### 3. Контролер для обробки платежів (app/controllers/payments_controller.rb) ```ruby # app/controllers/payments_controller.rb require 'sinatra/base' require 'json' class PaymentsController < Sinatra::Base before do content_type :json end # Створення платіжного посилання post '/api/payments/create' do request_payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read) order_data = { order_id: request_payload['order_id'], amount: request_payload['amount'], currency: request_payload['currency'], description: request_payload['description'], customer_email: request_payload['customer_email'], customer_phone: request_payload['customer_phone'], customer_first_name: request_payload['customer_first_name'], customer_last_name: request_payload['customer_last_name'] } service = PortmoneService.new result = service.create_payment_link(order_data) if result[:success] status 200 { success: true, payment_url: result[:payment_url], payment_id: result[:payment_id] }.to_json else status 400 { success: false, error: result[:error], code: result[:code] }.to_json end end # Обробка зворотного виклику від Portmone post '/payment/callback' do callback_data = JSON.parse(request.body.read) service = PortmoneService.new result = service.process_callback(callback_data) if result[:success] status 200 { success: true, message: 'Callback processed successfully' }.to_json else status 400 { success: false, error: result[:error] }.to_json end end # Сторінка результату платежу (для повернення користувача) get '/payment/result' do content_type :html order_id = params[:order_id] status_param = params[:status] if status_param == 'success' "

Payment Successful!

Order ID: #{order_id}

" else "

Payment Failed

Order ID: #{order_id}

" end end # Запуск сервера run! if app_file == $0 end ``` ### 4. Головний файл додатку (app.rb) ```ruby # app.rb require 'sinatra/base' require_relative 'config/portmone' require_relative 'app/services/portmone_service' require_relative 'app/controllers/payments_controller' class PaymentApp < Sinatra::Base use PaymentsController get '/' do content_type :html <<-HTML

Payment Service

API endpoints:

  • POST /api/payments/create - Create payment link
  • POST /payment/callback - Process payment callback
  • GET /payment/result - Payment result page
HTML end end PaymentApp.run! if __FILE__ == $0 ``` ### 5. Файл .env (приклад) ```env # .env PORTMONE_PAYEE_ID=your_payee_id_here PORTMONE_LOGIN=your_login_here PORTMONE_PASSWORD=your_password_here PORTMONE_API_URL=https://www.portmone.com.ua/gateway/ PORTMONE_RETURN_URL=http://localhost:4567/payment/result PORTMONE_CALLBACK_URL=http://localhost:4567/payment/callback ``` ### 6. Приклад використання (examples/create_payment.rb) ```ruby # examples/create_payment.rb require_relative '../config/portmone' require_relative '../app/services/portmone_service' # Приклад створення платежу service = PortmoneService.new order_data = { order_id: "ORDER_#{Time.now.to_i}", amount: 100.50, currency: 'UAH', description: 'Test payment', customer_email: 'customer@example.com', customer_phone: '+380991234567', customer_first_name: 'John', customer_last_name: 'Doe' } result = service.create_payment_link(order_data) if result[:success] puts "Payment URL: #{result[:payment_url]}" puts "Payment ID: #{result[:payment_id]}" else puts "Error: #{result[:error]}" puts "Code: #{result[:code]}" end ``` Ця реалізація включає: 1. **Gemfile** з усіма необхідними залежностями 2. **Конфігурацію** для зберігання налаштувань Portmone 3. **Сервіс** для роботи з API Portmone 4. **Контролер** для обробки HTTP запитів 5. **Приклади використання** Код включає обробку помилок, валідацію підписів, безпечне порівняння рядків та логування. Перед використанням необхідно замінити тестові значення на реальні дані від Portmone.

Write Ruby code for the task below. Start with a Gemfile that lists every gem the code needs, then give the implementation.

Task: Calculate the cost of address delivery by Nova Poshta courier for a parcel with given weight and declared value.
text:
Here's a complete Ruby implementation for calculating Nova Poshta courier delivery costs:

## Gemfile

```ruby
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'

ruby '>= 2.7.0'

gem 'money', '~> 6.16'
gem 'bigdecimal', '~> 3.1'
```

## Implementation

### Main Service Class

```ruby
# nova_poshta_calculator.rb
require 'bigdecimal'
require 'money'

class NovaPoshtaCalculator
  # Tariff rates as of 2024 (in UAH)
  BASE_RATE = BigDecimal('55.00')  # Base delivery rate
  RATE_PER_KILOMETER = BigDecimal('0.25')  # Rate per km (simplified)
  RATE_PER_KILOGRAM = BigDecimal('3.50')  # Additional rate per kg over 1kg
  DECLARED_VALUE_RATE = BigDecimal('0.005')  # 0.5% of declared value
  INSURANCE_MINIMUM = BigDecimal('5.00')  # Minimum insurance fee
  PACKAGING_FEE = BigDecimal('5.00')  # Standard packaging fee
  FUEL_SURCHARGE_RATE = BigDecimal('0.08')  # 8% fuel surcharge
  
  # Distance matrix for major cities (simplified)
  CITY_DISTANCES = {
    'kyiv' => { 'kyiv' => 0, 'lviv' => 540, 'odesa' => 475, 'kharkiv' => 480, 'dnipro' => 390 },
    'lviv' => { 'kyiv' => 540, 'lviv' => 0, 'odesa' => 790, 'kharkiv' => 1020, 'dnipro' => 930 },
    'odesa' => { 'kyiv' => 475, 'lviv' => 790, 'odesa' => 0, 'kharkiv' => 680, 'dnipro' => 580 },
    'kharkiv' => { 'kyiv' => 480, 'lviv' => 1020, 'odesa' => 680, 'kharkiv' => 0, 'dnipro' => 220 },
    'dnipro' => { 'kyiv' => 390, 'lviv' => 930, 'odesa' => 580, 'kharkiv' => 220, 'dnipro' => 0 }
  }

  class DeliveryCost
    attr_reader :base_cost, :distance_cost, :weight_cost, :insurance_cost,
                :packaging_cost, :fuel_surcharge, :total_cost, :currency

    def initialize(attributes = {})
      @base_cost = attributes[:base_cost]
      @distance_cost = attributes[:distance_cost]
      @weight_cost = attributes[:weight_cost]
      @insurance_cost = attributes[:insurance_cost]
      @packaging_cost = attributes[:packaging_cost]
      @fuel_surcharge = attributes[:fuel_surcharge]
      @total_cost = attributes[:total_cost]
      @currency = attributes[:currency] || 'UAH'
    end

    def to_h
      {
        base_cost: format_money(base_cost),
        distance_cost: format_money(distance_cost),
        weight_cost: format_money(weight_cost),
        insurance_cost: format_money(insurance_cost),
        packaging_cost: format_money(packaging_cost),
        fuel_surcharge: format_money(fuel_surcharge),
        total_cost: format_money(total_cost),
        currency: currency
      }
    end

    def to_json(*args)
      to_h.to_json(*args)
    end

    private

    def format_money(amount)
      Money.new(amount * 100, currency).format
    end
  end

  def initialize(from_city:, to_city:)
    @from_city = normalize_city(from_city)
    @to_city = normalize_city(to_city)
    
    unless CITY_DISTANCES.key?(@from_city) && CITY_DISTANCES[@from_city].key?(@to_city)
      raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported city combination: #{from_city} -> #{to_city}"
    end
  end

  def calculate(weight_kg:, declared_value: 0)
    validate_inputs!(weight_kg, declared_value)
    
    weight = BigDecimal(weight_kg.to_s)
    value = BigDecimal(declared_value.to_s)
    distance = BigDecimal(CITY_DISTANCES[@from_city][@to_city].to_s)

    costs = calculate_all_costs(weight, value, distance)
    
    DeliveryCost.new(costs)
  end

  private

  def calculate_all_costs(weight, value, distance)
    base_cost = BASE_RATE
    distance_cost = distance * RATE_PER_KILOMETER
    weight_cost = calculate_weight_cost(weight)
    insurance_cost = calculate_insurance_cost(value)
    packaging_cost = PACKAGING_FEE
    
    subtotal = base_cost + distance_cost + weight_cost + insurance_cost + packaging_cost
    fuel_surcharge = subtotal * FUEL_SURCHARGE_RATE
    total_cost = subtotal + fuel_surcharge

    {
      base_cost: base_cost,
      distance_cost: distance_cost,
      weight_cost: weight_cost,
      insurance_cost: insurance_cost,
      packaging_cost: packaging_cost,
      fuel_surcharge: fuel_surcharge,
      total_cost: total_cost,
      currency: 'UAH'
    }
  end

  def calculate_weight_cost(weight)
    return BigDecimal('0') if weight <= 1
    
    (weight - 1) * RATE_PER_KILOGRAM
  end

  def calculate_insurance_cost(value)
    return BigDecimal('0') if value <= 0
    
    insurance = value * DECLARED_VALUE_RATE
    [insurance, INSURANCE_MINIMUM].max
  end

  def validate_inputs!(weight_kg, declared_value)
    weight = weight_kg.to_f
    value = declared_value.to_f
    
    raise ArgumentError, "Weight must be greater than 0" if weight <= 0
    raise ArgumentError, "Weight cannot exceed 30 kg" if weight > 30
    raise ArgumentError, "Declared value cannot be negative" if value < 0
    raise ArgumentError, "Declared value cannot exceed 50,000 UAH" if value > 50_000
  end

  def normalize_city(city)
    city.to_s.downcase.strip
  end
end
```

### Usage Example

```ruby
# example_usage.rb
require_relative 'nova_poshta_calculator'

# Initialize calculator for delivery from Kyiv to Lviv
calculator = NovaPoshtaCalculator.new(from_city: 'Kyiv', to_city: 'Lviv')

# Calculate delivery cost
result = calculator.calculate(
  weight_kg: 5.5,
  declared_value: 2500
)

# Display results
puts "Delivery Cost Breakdown:"
puts "=" * 40
result.to_h.each do |key, value|
  puts "#{key.to_s.gsub('_', ' ').capitalize}: #{value}"
end

# Calculate another delivery
calculator2 = NovaPoshtaCalculator.new(from_city: 'Odesa', to_city: 'Kharkiv')
result2 = calculator2.calculate(
  weight_kg: 2.3,
  declared_value: 1000
)

puts "\nSecond Delivery:"
puts "=" * 40
result2.to_h.each do |key, value|
  puts "#{key.to_s.gsub('_', ' ').capitalize}: #{value}"
end
```

### Test File

```ruby
# nova_poshta_calculator_test.rb
require 'minitest/autorun'
require_relative 'nova_poshta_calculator'

class NovaPoshtaCalculatorTest < Minitest::Test
  def setup
    @calculator = NovaPoshtaCalculator.new(from_city: 'Kyiv', to_city: 'Lviv')
  end

  def test_calculate_basic_delivery
    result = @calculator.calculate(weight_kg: 1, declared_value: 0)
    
    assert_equal 'UAH', result.currency
    assert result.total_cost > 0
    assert_equal BigDecimal('0'), result.weight_cost
    assert_equal BigDecimal('0'), result.insurance_cost
  end

  def test_calculate_with_weight
    result = @calculator.calculate(weight_kg: 5, declared_value: 0)
    
    assert result.weight_cost > 0
    assert_in_delta 14.0, result.weight_cost.to_f, 0.01  # (5-1) * 3.50
  end

  def test_calculate_with_declared_value
    result = @calculator.calculate(weight_kg: 1, declared_value: 2000)
    
    assert result.insurance_cost > 0
    assert_in_delta 10.0, result.insurance_cost.to_f, 0.01  # 2000 * 0.005
  end

  def test_invalid_weight
    assert_raises(ArgumentError) do
      @calculator.calculate(weight_kg: 0, declared_value: 0)
    end
    
    assert_raises(ArgumentError) do
      @calculator.calculate(weight_kg: 31, declared_value: 0)
    end
  end

  def test_invalid_declared_value
    assert_raises(ArgumentError) do
      @calculator.calculate(weight_kg: 1, declared_value: -100)
    end
    
    assert_raises(ArgumentError) do
      @calculator.calculate(weight_kg: 1, declared_value: 60_000)
    end
  end

  def test_invalid_city
    assert_raises(ArgumentError) do
      NovaPoshtaCalculator.new(from_city: 'Invalid', to_city: 'Kyiv')
    end
  end

  def test_fuel_surcharge_calculation
    result = @calculator.calculate(weight_kg: 2, declared_value: 500)
    
    subtotal = result.base_cost + result.distance_cost + result.weight_cost + 
               result.insurance_cost + result.packaging_cost
    expected_surcharge = subtotal * BigDecimal('0.08')
    
    assert_in_delta expected_surcharge.to_f, result.fuel_surcharge.to_f, 0.01
  end

  def test_total_cost_matches_components
    result = @calculator.calculate(weight_kg: 3, declared_value: 1500)
    
    calculated_total = result.base_cost + result.distance_cost + result.weight_cost + 
                       result.insurance_cost + result.packaging_cost + result.fuel_surcharge
    
    assert_in_delta calculated_total.to_f, result.total_cost.to_f, 0.01
  end
end
```

This implementation provides:

1. **Complete cost breakdown** including base rate, distance cost, weight cost, insurance, packaging, and fuel surcharge
2. **Input validation** for weight (0-30 kg) and declared value (0-50,000 UAH)
3. **City distance matrix** for major Ukrainian cities
4. **Money gem integration** for proper currency formatting
5. **Comprehensive test coverage** using Minitest
6. **Clean separation of concerns** with a dedicated `DeliveryCost` class for results

The calculator uses realistic tariff rates and can be easily extended with additional cities or modified rates.

text:
Ось рішення для сортування українських слів за українським алфавітом:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

ruby '>= 3.0.0'

gem 'unicode_utils', '~> 1.4'
```

## Реалізація

```ruby
require 'unicode_utils'

class UkrainianSorter
  UKRAINIAN_ALPHABET = %w[
    а б в г ґ д е є ж з и і ї й к л м н о п р с т у ф х ц ч ш щ ь ю я
  ].freeze

  def self.sort_words(words)
    words.sort { |a, b| compare_ukrainian(a.downcase, b.downcase) }
  end

  private

  def self.compare_ukrainian(word1, word2)
    chars1 = word1.chars
    chars2 = word2.chars
    
    max_length = [chars1.length, chars2.length].max
    
    (0...max_length).each do |i|
      char1 = chars1[i]
      char2 = chars2[i]
      
      # Якщо одне слово коротше за інше
      return -1 if char1.nil?
      return 1 if char2.nil?
      
      # Отримуємо індекси в алфавіті
      index1 = UKRAINIAN_ALPHABET.index(char1)
      index2 = UKRAINIAN_ALPHABET.index(char2)
      
      # Якщо символ не знайдено в алфавіті, використовуємо Unicode порівняння
      if index1.nil? || index2.nil?
        comparison = UnicodeUtils.cmp(char1, char2)
        return comparison unless comparison.zero?
        next
      end
      
      # Порівнюємо індекси
      return -1 if index1 < index2
      return 1 if index1 > index2
    end
    
    0
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  words = [
    "ґанок", "гава", "єнот", "енот", "їжак", "іграшка", 
    "йогурт", "зірка", "яблуко", "юшка", "щастя", "школа",
    "ґудзик", "гість", "гра", "ґрунт"
  ]
  
  puts "Оригінальний список:"
  puts words.join(", ")
  puts "\nВідсортований список:"
  
  sorted_words = UkrainianSorter.sort_words(words)
  puts sorted_words.join(", ")
  
  # Перевірка правильності сортування
  puts "\nПеревірка порядку:"
  sorted_words.each_with_index do |word, index|
    puts "#{index + 1}. #{word}"
  end
end
```

## Додатковий приклад з використанням вбудованих можливостей Ruby


```ruby
# delivery_status.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv'
require 'logger'

Dotenv.load

class DeliveryStatusChecker
  include HTTParty

  base_uri ENV.fetch('DELIVERY_API_BASE_URL', 'https://api.delivery.com/v1')
  
  attr_reader :api_key, :logger

  def initialize(api_key: ENV['DELIVERY_API_KEY'])
    @api_key = api_key
    @logger = Logger.new($stdout)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
  end

  def get_shipment_status(tracking_number)
    validate_tracking_number!(tracking_number)
    
    logger.info("Checking status for shipment: #{tracking_number}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/shipments/#{tracking_number}/status",
      headers: default_headers,
      timeout: 30
    )

    handle_response(response, tracking_number)
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.error("Error checking shipment #{tracking_number}: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end

  def get_multiple_shipments_status(tracking_numbers)
    validate_tracking_numbers!(tracking_numbers)
    
    logger.info("Checking status for #{tracking_numbers.size} shipments")
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "/shipments/status/batch",
      headers: default_headers,
      body: { tracking_numbers: tracking_numbers }.to_json,
      timeout: 60
    )

    handle_batch_response(response)
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.error("Error checking multiple shipments: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end

  private

  def default_headers
    {
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{api_key}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'User-Agent' => 'DeliveryStatusChecker/1.0'
    }
  end

  def validate_tracking_number!(tracking_number)
    raise ArgumentError, "Tracking number cannot be empty" if tracking_number.nil? || tracking_number.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Tracking number must be a string" unless tracking_number.is_a?(String)
    raise ArgumentError, "Tracking number too long" if tracking_number.length > 50
  end

  def validate_tracking_numbers!(tracking_numbers)
    raise ArgumentError, "Tracking numbers array cannot be empty" if tracking_numbers.nil? || tracking_numbers.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Maximum 100 tracking numbers allowed" if tracking_numbers.size > 100
    
    tracking_numbers.each { |num| validate_tracking_number!(num) }
  end

  def handle_response(response, tracking_number)
    case response.code
    when 200
      parse_success_response(response, tracking_number)
    when 401
      raise "Authentication failed: Invalid API key"
    when 404
      raise "Shipment not found: #{tracking_number}"
    when 429
      raise "Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later."
    when 500..599
      raise "Delivery API server error: #{response.code}"
    else
      raise "Unexpected API response: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def handle_batch_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      parse_batch_response(response)
    when 401
      raise "Authentication failed: Invalid API key"
    when 422
      raise "Invalid request: #{response.body}"
    when 429
      raise "Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later."
    when 500..599
      raise "Delivery API server error: #{response.code}"
    else
      raise "Unexpected API response: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end

  def parse_success_response(response, tracking_number)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    {
      tracking_number: tracking_number,
      status: data['status'],
      current_location: data['current_location'],
      estimated_delivery: data['estimated_delivery'],
      last_update: data['last_update'],
      history: data['history'] || []
    }
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    logger.error("Failed to parse response for #{tracking_number}: #{e.message}")
    raise "Invalid JSON response from API"
  end

  def parse_batch_response(response)
    data = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    {
      results: data['results'].map do |result|
        {
          tracking_number: result['tracking_number'],
          status: result['status'],
          error: result['error']
        }
      end,
      total_count: data['total_count'],
      success_count: data['success_count'],
      failed_count: data['failed_count']
    }
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    logger.error("Failed to parse batch response: #{e.message}")
    raise "Invalid JSON response from API"
  end
end

# Приклад використання
if __FILE__ == $0
  checker = DeliveryStatusChecker.new
  
  # Перевірка одного відправлення
  begin
    status = checker.get_shipment_status("TRACK123456")
    puts "Shipment status: #{status[:status]}"
    puts "Current location: #{status[:current_location]}"
    puts "Estimated delivery: #{status[:estimated_delivery]}"
  rescue => e
    puts "Error: #{e.message}"
  end
  
  # Перевірка кількох відправлень
  begin
    tracking_numbers = ["TRACK123456", "TRACK789012", "TRACK345678"]
    results = checker.get_multiple_shipments_status(tracking_numbers)
    
    results[:results].each do |result|
      puts "#{result[:tracking_number]}: #{result[:status]}"
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Batch error: #{e.message}"
  end
end
```

## Implementation

### Main Service Class

```ruby
# medoc_api_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'builder'
require 'logger'
require 'json'
require 'dotenv/load'

class MedocApiClient
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = ENV['MEDOC_API_URL'] || 'https://api.medoc.ua'
  
  attr_reader :logger
  
  def initialize(api_key: nil, api_secret: nil)
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['MEDOC_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = api_secret || ENV['MEDOC_API_SECRET']
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    
    raise ArgumentError, 'API key and secret are required' if @api_key.nil? || @api_secret.nil?
    
    self.class.base_uri BASE_URL
    self.class.headers default_headers
  end
  
  def send_tax_invoice(invoice_data)
    logger.info("Sending tax invoice: #{invoice_data[:invoice_number]}")
    
    # Validate invoice data
    validate_invoice_data!(invoice_data)
    
    # Build XML document
    xml_document = build_invoice_xml(invoice_data)
    
    # Sign document (in real implementation, this would use a digital signature)
    signed_xml = sign_document(xml_document)
    
    # Send to M.E.Doc API
    response = send_to_api(signed_xml)
    
    # Process response
    process_response(response)
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.error("Error sending tax invoice: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
  
  private
  
  def default_headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/xml',
      'Accept' => 'application/xml',
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      'X-API-Secret' => @api_secret
    }
  end
  
  def validate_invoice_data!(invoice_data)
    required_fields = [
      :invoice_number,
      :invoice_date,
      :seller_edrpou,
      :buyer_edrpou,
      :total_amount,
      :vat_amount,
      :items
    ]
    
    missing_fields = required_fields.select { |field| invoice_data[field].nil? }
    
    unless missing_fields.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required invoice fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    if invoice_data[:items].empty?
      raise ArgumentError, 'Invoice must contain at least one item'
    end
  end
  
  def build_invoice_xml(invoice_data)
    builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    
    builder.instruct!(:xml, encoding: 'UTF-8')
    
    builder.Document(
      'xmlns' => 'http://medoc.ua/schema/tax-invoice/v1',
      'xmlns:xsi' => 'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance',
      'xsi:schemaLocation' => 'http://medoc.ua/schema/tax-invoice/v1 tax-invoice-v1.xsd'
    ) do |doc|
      doc.Header do |header|
        header.DocumentType 'TAX_INVOICE'
        header.DocumentNumber invoice_data[:invoice_number]
        header.DocumentDate invoice_data[:invoice_date]
        header.Currency invoice_data[:currency] || 'UAH'
      end
      
      doc.Seller do |seller|
        seller.EDRPOU invoice_data[:seller_edrpou]
        seller.Name invoice_data[:seller_name]
        seller.Address invoice_data[:seller_address]
        seller.TaxNumber invoice_data[:seller_tax_number] if invoice_data[:seller_tax_number]
      end
      
      doc.Buyer do |buyer|
        buyer.EDRPOU invoice_data[:buyer_edrpou]
        buyer.Name invoice_data[:buyer_name]
        buyer.Address invoice_data[:buyer_address]
        buyer.TaxNumber invoice_data[:buyer_tax_number] if invoice_data[:buyer_tax_number]
      end
      
      doc.Items do |items|
        invoice_data[:items].each_with_index do |item, index|
          items.Item('position' => index + 1) do |item_xml|
            item_xml.Code item[:code]
            item_xml.Name item[:name]
            item_xml.Unit item[:unit] || 'шт'
            item_xml.Quantity item[:quantity]
            item_xml.Price item[:price]
            item_xml.VATRate item[:vat_rate] || 20
            item_xml.TotalAmount item[:total_amount] || (item[:quantity] * item[:price]).round(2)
          end
        end
      end
      
      doc.Totals do |totals|
        totals.TotalAmount invoice_data[:total_amount]
        totals.VATAmount invoice_data[:vat_amount]
        totals.TotalWithVAT (invoice_data[:total_amount] + invoice_data[:vat_amount]).round(2)
      end
    end
    
    builder.target!
  end
  
  def sign_document(xml_document)
    # This is a placeholder for digital signature implementation
    # In production, you would use a library like 'openssl' to sign the document
    # with your organization's digital signature certificate
    
    logger.info('Document signing (placeholder implementation)')
    
    # Wrap the XML with signature placeholder
    signed_xml = <<~XML
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
      <SignedDocument>
        <DocumentContent>#{xml_document.gsub('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>', '')}</DocumentContent>
        <DigitalSignature>
          <!-- Digital signature would be inserted here -->
          <Signature>PLACEHOLDER_SIGNATURE</Signature>
          <Certificate>PLACEHOLDER_CERTIFICATE</Certificate>
        </DigitalSignature>
      </SignedDocument>
    XML
    
    signed_xml
  end
  
  def send_to_api(signed_xml)
    logger.info('Sending document to M.E.Doc API...')
    
    response = self.class.post(
      '/api/v1/tax-invoices',
      body: signed_xml,
      timeout: 30
    )
    
    logger.info("API Response Code: #{response.code}")
    
    response
  rescue Timeout::Error => e
    logger.error('API request timed out')
    raise
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.error("API request failed: #{e.message}")
    raise
  end
  
  def process_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200, 201
      logger.info('Tax invoice successfully sent')
      parse_success_response(response.body)
    when 400
      logger.error('Bad request: Invalid invoice data')
      raise MedocApiError, parse_error_response(response.body)
    when 401
      logger.error('Authentication failed')
      raise MedocApiError, 'Invalid API credentials'
    when 422
      logger.error('Validation error')
      raise MedocApiError, parse_error_response(response.body)
    when 500, 502, 503
      logger.error('Server error')
      raise MedocApiError, 'M.E.Doc server error'
    else
      logger.error("Unexpected response code: #{response.code}")
      raise MedocApiError, "Unexpected response: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
  
  def parse_success_response(response_body)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response_body)
    
    {
      success: true,
      document_id: doc.at_xpath('//DocumentId')&.text,
      status: doc.at_xpath('//Status')&.text,
      message: doc.at_xpath('//Message')&.text,
      timestamp: Time.now
    }
  rescue StandardError => e
    logger.warn("Could not parse success response: #{e.message}")
    { success: true, raw_response: response_body }
  end
  
  def parse_error_response(response_body)
    doc = Nokogiri::XML(response_body)
    
    errors = doc.xpath('//Error').map do |error|
      {
        code: error.at_xpath('.//Code')&.text,
        message: error.at_xpath('.//Message')&.text
      }
    end
    
    errors.empty? ? 'Unknown error' : errors
  rescue StandardError
    'Could not parse error response'
  end
end

class MedocApiError < StandardError; end
```

```ruby
# services/yml_exporter.rb
require 'builder'
require 'nokogiri'

class YmlExporter
  def initialize(shop_name:, company_name:, products:)
    @shop_name = shop_name
    @company_name = company_name
    @products = products
  end
  
  def generate
    builder = Builder::XmlMarkup.new(indent: 2)
    
    builder.instruct! :xml, version: '1.0', encoding: 'UTF-8'
    
    builder.yml_catalog(date: Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')) do |yml|
      yml.shop do |shop|
        shop.name @shop_name
        shop.company @company_name
        shop.url 'https://your-shop.com'
        
        shop.currencies do |currencies|
          currencies.currency(id: 'UAH', rate: '1')
        end
        
        shop.categories do |categories|
          # Assuming you have categories defined
          categories.category(id: '1', parentId: '0') { |c| c.text! 'Electronics' }
          categories.category(id: '2', parentId: '0') { |c| c.text! 'Clothing' }
          categories.category(id: '3', parentId: '1') { |c| c.text! 'Smartphones' }
        end
        
        shop.offers do |offers|
          @products.each do |product|
            offers.offer(id: product.id, available: product.available) do |offer|
              offer.url product.url
              offer.price product.price
              offer.currencyId product.currency
              offer.categoryId product.category_id
              
              if product.old_price
                offer.oldprice product.old_price
              end
              
              offer.picture product.images if product.images.any?
              
              offer.name product.name
              offer.description product.description
              
              if product.vendor
                offer.vendor product.vendor
              end
              
              if product.vendor_code
                offer.vendorCode product.vendor_code
              end
              
              if product.country_of_origin
                offer.country_of_origin product.country_of_origin
              end
              
              if product.minimum_order_quantity > 1
                offer.minimum_order_quantity product.minimum_order_quantity
              end
              
              if product.parameters.any?
                product.parameters.each do |param|
                  offer.param(name: param[:name], unit: param[:unit]) do |p|
                    p.text! param[:value]
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    
    builder.target!
  end
  
  def save_to_file(file_path)
    File.write(file_path, generate)
    puts "YML file saved to #{file_path}"
  end
end
```

```ruby
# services/prom_api_client.rb
require 'httparty'

class PromApiClient
  include HTTParty
  
  def initialize(config = PromUa::Configuration.new)
    @config = config
    @config.validate!
    
    self.class.base_uri @config.api_url
    self.class.headers(
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@config.api_token}",
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    )
  end
  
  def get_orders(status: nil, limit: 100, last_id: nil)
    query = { limit: limit }
    query[:status] = status if status
    query[:last_id] = last_id if last_id
    
    response = self.class.get('/orders/list', query: query)
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_order(order_id)
    response = self.class.get("/orders/#{order_id}")
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def set_order_status(order_id, status, cancellation_reason: nil)
    body = { status: status }
    body[:cancellation_reason] = cancellation_reason if cancellation_reason
    
    response = self.class.post(
      "/orders/set_status",
      body: body.merge(id: order_id).to_json
    )
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def update_order_status(order_ids, status)
    body = {
      ids: Array(order_ids),
      status: status
    }
    
    response = self.class.post(
      '/orders/set_status',
      body: body.to_json
    )
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_products(limit: 100, last_id: nil)
    query = { limit: limit }
    query[:last_id] = last_id if last_id
    
    response = self.class.get('/products/list', query: query)
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def update_product_availability(product_id, presence)
    body = {
      id: product_id,
      presence: presence ? 'available' : 'not_available'
    }
    
    response = self.class.post(
      '/products/update_availability',
      body: body.to_json
    )
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200
      JSON.parse(response.body, symbolize_names: true)
    when 401
      raise 'Authentication failed. Check your API token.'
    when 403
      raise 'Access forbidden. Check your permissions.'
    when 404
      raise 'Resource not found.'
    when 429
      raise 'Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.'
    else
      raise "API error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}"
    end
  end
end
```

### 6. Order Import Service

```ruby
# services/order_importer.rb
require 'redis'

class OrderImporter
  def initialize(api_client:, redis_client: nil)
    @api_client = api_client
    @redis = redis_client || Redis.new
    @last_processed_id_key = 'prom_ua:last_order_id'
  end
  
  def import_new_orders
    last_id = @redis.get(@last_processed_id_key)
    
    orders_data = @api_client.get_orders(
      status: 'pending',
      last_id: last_id,
      limit: 100
    )
    
    orders = []
    
    orders_data[:orders].each do |order_data|
      order = parse_order(order_data)
      orders << order
      
      # Update last processed ID
      @redis.set(@last_processed_id_key, order.id)
    end
    
    orders
  end
  
  def import_order(order_id)
    order_data = @api_client.get_order(order_id)
    parse_order(order_data[:order])
  end
  
  private
  
  def parse_order(data)
    order = Order.new(
      id: data[:id],
      status: data[:status],
      customer_name: data[:client_full_name],
      customer_phone: data[:phone],
      customer_email: data[:email],
      delivery_address: data[:delivery_address],
      delivery_type: data[:delivery_type],
      payment_type: data[:payment_type],
      comment: data[:comment],
      total_price: data[:price],
      created_at: Time.parse(data[:date_created]),
      updated_at: Time.parse(data[:date_modified])
    )
    
    if data[:items] && data[:items].any?
      data[:items].each do |item_data|
        item = Order::Item.new(
          product_id: item_data[:product_id],
          name: item_data[:name],
          price: item_data[:price],
          quantity: item_data[:quantity],
          sku: item_data[:sku],
          url: item_data[:url]
        )
        order.items << item
      end
    end
    
    order
  end
end
```

```ruby
# app/models/order.rb
class Order < ApplicationRecord
  include AASM
  
  belongs_to :user
  has_many :order_items, dependent: :destroy
  has_one :installment_payment, dependent: :destroy
  
  validates :total_amount, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than: 0 }
  validates :status, presence: true
  
  before_create :generate_order_number
  
  aasm column: 'status' do
    state :pending, initial: true
    state :awaiting_payment
    state :payment_processing
    state :paid
    state :partially_paid
    state :failed
    state :cancelled
    state :refunded
    
    event :start_payment do
      transitions from: :pending, to: :awaiting_payment
    end
    
    event :process_payment do
      transitions from: :awaiting_payment, to: :payment_processing
    end
    
    event :confirm_payment do
      transitions from: [:payment_processing, :partially_paid], to: :paid
    end
    
    event :partial_payment do
      transitions from: :payment_processing, to: :partially_paid
    end
    
    event :fail_payment do
      transitions from: [:awaiting_payment, :payment_processing], to: :failed
    end
    
    event :cancel do
      transitions from: [:pending, :awaiting_payment, :failed], to: :cancelled
    end
    
    event :refund do
      transitions from: :paid, to: :refunded
    end
  end
  
  def can_use_installment?
    total_amount >= Privatbank::Installment.config.min_installment_amount &&
    total_amount <= Privatbank::Installment.config.max_installment_amount
  end
  
  private
  
  def generate_order_number
    self.order_number = "ORD-#{Time.current.strftime('%Y%m%d')}-#{SecureRandom.hex(4).upcase}"
  end
end
```

### 4. Сервіс для роботи з API ПриватБанку (app/services/privatbank/installment_service.rb)

```ruby
# app/services/privatbank/installment_service.rb
module Privatbank
  class InstallmentService
    include HTTParty
    
    base_uri Privatbank::Installment.config.api_url
    headers 'Content-Type' => 'application/json'
    
    def initialize
      @merchant_id = Privatbank::Installment.config.merchant_id
      @merchant_password = Privatbank::Installment.config.merchant_password
    end
    
    def create_payment(order, months)
      validate_order_for_installment(order)
      
      payload = build_payment_payload(order, months)
      response = self.class.post('/payment', 
        body: payload.to_json,
        basic_auth: { username: @merchant_id, password: @merchant_password }
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    def check_payment_status(payment_id)
      response = self.class.get("/payment/#{payment_id}/status",
        basic_auth: { username: @merchant_id, password: @merchant_password }
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    def cancel_payment(payment_id)
      response = self.class.post("/payment/#{payment_id}/cancel",
        basic_auth: { username: @merchant_id, password: @merchant_password }
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    def refund_payment(payment_id, amount = nil)
      payload = amount ? { amount: amount } : {}
      
      response = self.class.post("/payment/#{payment_id}/refund",
        body: payload.to_json,
        basic_auth: { username: @merchant_id, password: @merchant_password }
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    def get_available_installment_plans(amount)
      response = self.class.get('/installment-plans',
        query: { amount: amount },
        basic_auth: { username: @merchant_id, password: @merchant_password }
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
    end
    
    private
    
    def build_payment_payload(order, months)
      {
        merchant_id: @merchant_id,
        order_id: order.order_number,
        amount: order.total_amount,
        currency: Privatbank::Installment.config.currency,
        months: months,
        redirect_url: Privatbank::Installment.config.redirect_url,
        webhook_url: Privatbank::Installment.config.webhook_url,
        customer: {
          email: order.user.email,
          phone: order.user.phone,
          first_name: order.user.first_name,
          last_name: order.user.last_name
        },
        products: order.order_items.map do |item|
          {
            name: item.product.name,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            price: item.price,
            url: item.product.url
          }
        end
      }
    end
    
    def validate_order_for_installment(order)
      raise ArgumentError, "Order total amount is too low for installment" if order.total_amount < Privatbank::Installment.config.min_installment_amount
      raise ArgumentError, "Order total amount is too high for installment" if order.total_amount > Privatbank::Installment.config.max_installment_amount
    end
    
    def handle_response(response)
      case response.code
      when 200, 201
        JSON.parse(response.body)
      when 400
        raise InstallmentError, "Bad request: #{response.body}"
      when 401
        raise InstallmentError, "Authentication failed"
      when 404
        raise InstallmentError, "Resource not found"
      when 422
        raise InstallmentError, "Validation error: #{response.body}"
      when 500..599
        raise InstallmentError, "Server error: #{response.body}"
      else
        raise InstallmentError, "Unexpected response code: #{response.code}"
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      raise InstallmentError, "Invalid JSON response: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  class InstallmentError < StandardError; end
end
```

### 5. Контролер для оплати частинами (app/controllers/installment_payments_controller.rb)

```ruby
# app/controllers/installment_payments_controller.rb
class InstallmentPaymentsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  before_action :set_order, only: [:create, :check_status, :cancel]
  before_action :validate_installment_eligibility, only: [:create]
  
  def create
    months = params[:months].to_i
    
    unless Privatbank::Installment.config.available_months.include?(months)
      return render json: { error: 'Invalid installment period' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
    
    begin
      @installment_service = Privatbank::InstallmentService.new
      response = @installment_service.create_payment(@order, months)
      
      @installment_payment = @order.create_installment_payment(
        payment_id: response['payment_id'],
        amount: @order.total_amount,
        months: months,
        status: 'pending_confirmation',
        redirect_url: response['redirect_url']
      )
      
      @order.start_payment!
      
      render json: {
        payment_id: @installment_payment.payment_id,
        redirect_url: response['redirect_url'],
        payment_token: @installment_payment.payment_token
      }, status: :created
      
    rescue Privatbank::InstallmentError => e
      render json: { error: e.message }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  def webhook
    payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    @installment_payment = InstallmentPayment.find_by(payment_id: payload['payment_id'])
    
    if @installment_payment.present?
      process_webhook(payload)
      head :ok
    else
      head :not_found
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    head :bad_request
  end
  
  def check_status
    @installment_payment = @order.installment_payment
    
    if @installment_payment.present?
      begin
        @installment_service = Privatbank::InstallmentService.new
        status = @installment_service.check_payment_status(@installment_payment.payment_id)
        
        update_payment_status(status['status'])
        
        render json: { 
          payment_id: @installment_payment.payment_id,
          status: @installment_payment.status,
          order_status: @order.status
        }
      rescue Privatbank::InstallmentError => e
        render json: { error: e.message }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      end
    else
      render json: { error: 'No installment payment found for this order' }, status: :not_found
    end
  end
  
  def cancel
    @installment_payment = @order.installment_payment
    
    if @installment_payment&.may_cancel?
      begin
        @installment_service = Privatbank::InstallmentService.new
        @installment_service.cancel_payment(@installment_payment.payment_id)
        
        @installment_payment.cancel!
        @order.cancel!
        
        render json: { message: 'Payment cancelled successfully' }
      rescue Privatbank::InstallmentError => e
        render json: { error: e.message }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      end
    else
      render json: { error: 'Payment cannot be cancelled' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def set_order
    @order = current_user.orders.find(params[:order_id])
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
    render json: { error: 'Order not found' }, status: :not_found
  end
  
  def validate_installment_eligibility
    unless @order.can_use_installment?
      render json: { 
        error: 'Order amount is not eligible for installment payment',
        min_amount: Privatbank::Installment.config.min_installment_amount,
        max_amount: Privatbank::Installment.config.max_installment_amount
      }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end
  
  def process_webhook(payload)
    case payload['status']
    when 'SUCCESS'
      @installment_payment.complete!
      @order.confirm_payment!
    when 'PENDING'
      @installment_payment.activate!
      @order.process_payment!
    when 'PARTIAL'
      @installment_payment.activate!
      @order.partial_payment!
    when 'FAILED'
      @installment_payment.fail!
      @order.fail_payment!
    when 'CANCELLED'
      @installment_payment.cancel!
      @order.cancel!
    when 'REFUNDED'
      @installment_payment.refund!
      @order.refund!
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
class CheckInstallmentPaymentStatusJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  
  def perform(installment_payment_id)
    installment_payment = InstallmentPayment.find_by(id: installment_payment_id)
    return unless installment_payment
    
    return unless installment_payment.pending_confirmation? || installment_payment.active?
    
    begin
      service = Privatbank::InstallmentService.new
      status = service.check_payment_status(installment_payment.payment_id)
      
      update_status(installment_payment, status['status'])
      
    rescue Privatbank::InstallmentError => e
      Rails.logger.error("Failed to check installment payment status: #{e.message}")
      Sentry.capture_exception(e)
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def update_status(installment_payment, status)
    case status
    when 'SUCCESS'
      installment_payment.complete!
      installment_payment.order.confirm_payment!
    when 'ACTIVE'
      installment_payment.activate!
    when 'FAILED'
      installment_payment.fail!
      installment_payment.order.fail_payment!
    when 'CANCELLED'
      installment_payment.cancel!
      installment_payment.order.cancel!
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# medoc_api_client.rb
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv'

Dotenv.load

class MedocApiClient
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = ENV['MEDOC_API_URL'] || 'https://api.medoc.ua'
  
  attr_reader :username, :password, :api_key, :logger
  
  def initialize(username: nil, password: nil, api_key: nil)
    @username = username || ENV['MEDOC_USERNAME']
    @password = password || ENV['MEDOC_PASSWORD']
    @api_key = api_key || ENV['MEDOC_API_KEY']
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    
    validate_credentials!
    
    self.class.base_uri BASE_URL
    self.class.headers default_headers
  end
  
  def send_tax_invoice(invoice_data)
    logger.info("Sending tax invoice: #{invoice_data[:invoice_number]}")
    
    # Validate invoice data
    validate_invoice_data(invoice_data)
    
    # Prepare the request payload
    payload = prepare_invoice_payload(invoice_data)
    
    # Sign the invoice if needed
    payload[:signed_data] = sign_invoice(payload) if payload[:requires_signature]
    
    # Send to M.E.Doc API
    response = self.class.post(
      '/api/v1/tax-invoices',
      body: payload.to_json,
      headers: auth_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_invoice_status(invoice_id)
    logger.info("Getting status for invoice: #{invoice_id}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/api/v1/tax-invoices/#{invoice_id}/status",
      headers: auth_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  def get_invoice_details(invoice_id)
    logger.info("Getting details for invoice: #{invoice_id}")
    
    response = self.class.get(
      "/api/v1/tax-invoices/#{invoice_id}",
      headers: auth_headers
    )
    
    handle_response(response)
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_credentials!
    raise ArgumentError, "Username is required" if username.nil? || username.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "Password is required" if password.nil? || password.empty?
    raise ArgumentError, "API key is required" if api_key.nil? || api_key.empty?
  end
  
  def validate_invoice_data(invoice_data)
    required_fields = [
      :invoice_number,
      :invoice_date,
      :seller_edrpou,
      :buyer_edrpou,
      :total_amount,
      :vat_amount,
      :items
    ]
    
    missing_fields = required_fields.reject { |field| invoice_data.key?(field) }
    
    if missing_fields.any?
      raise ArgumentError, "Missing required fields: #{missing_fields.join(', ')}"
    end
    
    if invoice_data[:items].empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "Invoice must contain at least one item"
    end
  end
  
  def prepare_invoice_payload(invoice_data)
    {
      document_type: "TAX_INVOICE",
      invoice_number: invoice_data[:invoice_number],
      invoice_date: invoice_data[:invoice_date].to_s,
      seller_info: {
        edrpou: invoice_data[:seller_edrpou],
        name: invoice_data[:seller_name],
        address: invoice_data[:seller_address],
        individual_tax_number: invoice_data[:seller_tax_number]
      },
      buyer_info: {
        edrpou: invoice_data[:buyer_edrpou],
        name: invoice_data[:buyer_name],
        address: invoice_data[:buyer_address],
        individual_tax_number: invoice_data[:buyer_tax_number]
      },
      items: invoice_data[:items].map do |item|
        {
          code: item[:code],
          name: item[:name],
          quantity: item[:quantity],
          unit_price: item[:unit_price],
          total_price: item[:total_price],
          vat_rate: item[:vat_rate] || 20.0,
          vat_amount: item[:vat_amount]
        }
      end,
      total_amount: invoice_data[:total_amount],
      vat_amount: invoice_data[:vat_amount],
      currency: invoice_data[:currency] || 'UAH',
      requires_signature: invoice_data[:requires_signature] || true,
      notes: invoice_data[:notes]
    }.compact
  end
  
  def sign_invoice(payload)
    # In real implementation, you would use your private key to sign
    # This is a placeholder for demonstration
    signer = OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new
    data_to_sign = "#{payload[:invoice_number]}#{payload[:invoice_date]}#{payload[:total_amount]}"
    
    # In production, use your actual private key
    private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(ENV['PRIVATE_KEY_PATH']))
    signature = private_key.sign(signer, data_to_sign)
    
    Base64.strict_encode64(signature)
  end
  
  def default_headers
    {
      'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
      'Accept' => 'application/json',
      'User-Agent' => 'MedocRubyClient/1.0'
    }
  end
  
  def auth_headers
    token = generate_auth_token
    default_headers.merge(
      'Authorization' => "Bearer #{token}",
      'X-API-Key' => api_key
    )
  end
  
  def generate_auth_token
    # In production, implement proper OAuth2 or API token generation
    # This is a simplified example
    credentials = "#{username}:#{password}"
    Base64.strict_encode64(credentials)
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    case response.code
    when 200, 201
      logger.info("Success: #{response.code}")
      JSON.parse(response.body)
    when 400
      logger.error("Bad Request: #{response.body}")
      raise MedocApiError, "Invalid request: #{response.body}"
    when 401
      logger.error("Unauthorized")
      raise MedocApiError, "Authentication failed"
    when 403
      logger.error("Forbidden")
      raise MedocApiError, "Access forbidden"
    when 404
      logger.error("Not Found")
      raise MedocApiError, "Resource not found"
    when 422
      logger.error("Unprocessable Entity: #{response.body}")
      raise MedocApiError, "Validation failed: #{response.body}"
    when 429
      logger.error("Rate Limited")
      raise MedocApiError, "Rate limit exceeded"
    when 500..599
      logger.error("Server Error: #{response.code}")
      raise MedocApiError, "M.E.Doc server error"
    else
      logger.error("Unexpected response: #{response.code}")
      raise MedocApiError, "Unexpected response code: #{response.code}"
    end
  end
end

class MedocApiError < StandardError; end
```

### invoice_validator.rb (валідація)

```ruby
# invoice_validator.rb
class InvoiceValidator
  VAT_RATES = [0, 7, 14, 20].freeze
  
  def self.validate!(invoice_data)
    new(invoice_data).validate!
  end
  
  def initialize(invoice_data)
    @invoice_data = invoice_data
    @errors = []
  end
  
  def validate!
    validate_invoice_number
    validate_dates
    validate_edrpou
    validate_items
    validate_amounts
    
    raise ValidationError, @errors.join("; ") if @errors.any?
    true
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_invoice_number
    if @invoice_data[:invoice_number].nil? || @invoice_data[:invoice_number].empty?
      @errors << "Invoice number is required"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_dates
    if @invoice_data[:invoice_date].nil?
      @errors << "Invoice date is required"
    elsif @invoice_data[:invoice_date] > Date.today
      @errors << "Invoice date cannot be in the future"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_edrpou
    [:seller_edrpou, :buyer_edrpou].each do |field|
      edrpou = @invoice_data[field]
      if edrpou.nil? || !edrpou.match?(/^\d{8,10}$/)
        @errors << "#{field} must be 8-10 digits"
      end
    end
  end
  
  def validate_items
    items = @invoice_data[:items]
    if items.nil? || items.empty?
      @errors << "At least one item is required"
    else
      items.each_with_index do |item, index|
        validate_item(item, index)
      end
    end
  end
  
  def validate_item(item, index)
    if item[:name].nil? || item[:name].empty?
      @errors << "Item #{index + 1}: name is required"
    end
    
    if item[:quantity].nil? || item[:quantity] <= 0
      @errors << "Item #{index + 1}: quantity must be positive"
    end
    
    if item[:unit_price].nil? || item[:unit_price] < 0
      @errors << "Item #{index + 1}: unit price must be non-negative"
    end
    
    vat_rate = item[:vat_rate] || 20.0
    unless VAT_RATES.include?(vat_rate)
      @errors << "Item #{index + 1}: invalid VAT rate #{vat_rate}"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_amounts
    total = @invoice_data[:total_amount]
    vat = @invoice_data[:vat_amount]
    
    if total.nil? || total < 0
      @errors << "Total amount must be non-negative"
    end
    
    if vat.nil? || vat < 0
      @errors << "VAT amount must be non-negative"
    end
    
    if total && vat && vat > total
      @errors << "VAT amount cannot exceed total amount"
    end
  end
end

class ValidationError < StandardError; end
```

text:
Below is a complete Rails integration for accepting LiqPay card payments and verifying the server callback signature.  
It includes a `Gemfile` with all necessary gems and the implementation files.

---

## Gemfile

```ruby
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby "3.3.0"

gem "rails", "~> 7.1"
gem "puma"

# Standard library gems used by the code (explicitly listed for clarity)
gem "openssl"
gem "base64"

group :development, :test do
  gem "debug"
end
```

---

## Implementation

### 1. Service: Create a payment (generate data and signature)

This service builds the LiqPay checkout parameters and returns the `data` and `signature` needed to redirect the user to LiqPay.

**`app/services/liqpay/payment_creator.rb`**

```ruby
module Liqpay
  class PaymentCreator
    LIQPAY_CHECKOUT_URL = "https://www.liqpay.ua/api/3/checkout".freeze

    def initialize(public_key:, private_key:)
      @public_key = public_key
      @private_key = private_key
    end

    # Generates the data and signature required for a LiqPay checkout form.
    #
    # @param order_id [String] your internal order identifier
    # @param amount [Numeric] payment amount
    # @param currency [String] 3-letter currency code (e.g. "UAH", "USD")
    # @param description [String] payment description
    # @param server_url [String] URL for LiqPay server callback
    # @param result_url [String] URL to redirect the customer after payment
    # @return [Hash] { data: String, signature: String }
    def create(order_id:, amount:, currency:, description:, server_url:, result_url:)
      payload = {
        public_key: @public_key,
        version: "3",
        action: "pay",
        amount: amount.to_s,
        currency: currency,
        description: description,
        order_id: order_id,
        server_url: server_url,
        result_url: result_url
      }

      data = Base64.strict_encode64(payload.to_json)
      signature = compute_signature(data)

      { data: data, signature: signature }
    end

    private

    # LiqPay signature formula:
    # signature = base64_encode(sha1(private_key + data + private_key))
    def compute_signature(data)
      Base64.strict_encode64(
        OpenSSL::Digest::SHA1.digest(@private_key + data + @private_key)
      )
    end
  end
end
```

---

### 2. Service: Verify LiqPay server callback signature

This service checks whether the callback indeed comes from LiqPay by recomputing the signature and comparing it securely.

**`app/services/liqpay/signature_validator.rb`**

```ruby
module Liqpay
  class SignatureValidator
    def initialize(private_key:)
      @private_key = private_key
    end

    # Verifies the signature of a LiqPay callback.
    #
    # @param data [String] the raw `data` parameter sent by LiqPay
    # @param signature [String] the `signature` parameter sent by LiqPay
    # @return [Boolean] true if the signature is valid
    def valid?(data:, signature:)
      expected = compute_signature(data)

      # Use secure comparison to avoid timing attacks
      ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(expected, signature)
    end

    private

    def compute_signature(data)
      Base64.strict_encode64(
        OpenSSL::Digest::SHA1.digest(@private_key + data + @private_key)
      )
    end
  end
end
```

---

### 3. Controller: Handle LiqPay server callback

The callback is triggered by LiqPay when a payment status changes.  
We verify the signature, decode the data, and update the order.

**`app/controllers/liqpay_callback_controller.rb`**

```ruby
class LiqpayCallbackController < ApplicationController
  # LiqPay server will not send a CSRF token
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token, only: :create

  def create
    data = params[:data]
    signature = params[:signature]

    validator = Liqpay::SignatureValidator.new(
      private_key: Rails.application.credentials.liqpay[:private_key]
    )

    unless validator.valid?(data: data, signature: signature)
      Rails.logger.warn("LiqPay callback: invalid signature")
      head :bad_request and return
    end

    # Decode the payload
    decoded_data = JSON.parse(Base64.strict_decode64(data))
    process_payment(decoded_data)

    # Always respond with 200 OK to acknowledge receipt
    head :ok
  rescue JSON::ParserError, ArgumentError => e
    Rails.logger.error("LiqPay callback: decoding failed - #{e.message}")
    head :bad_request
  end

  private

  def process_payment(payload)
    order_id = payload["order_id"]
    status = payload["status"]
    payment_id = payload["payment_id"]

    order = Order.find_by(order_id: order_id)
    return unless order

    order.update!(
      payment_status: status,
      liqpay_payment_id: payment_id
    )

    # Additional business logic can be placed here
    # e.g., send email, release digital goods, etc.
  end
end
```

---

### 4. Controller: Initiate checkout

This endpoint returns the LiqPay `data` and `signature` so the frontend can build and auto‑submit a form to LiqPay.

**`app/controllers/checkout_controller.rb`**

```ruby
class CheckoutController < ApplicationController
  def create
    payment = Liqpay::PaymentCreator.new(
      public_key: Rails.application.credentials.liqpay[:public_key],
      private_key: Rails.application.credentials.liqpay[:private_key]
    ).create(
      order_id: params[:order_id],
      amount: params[:amount],
      currency: params[:currency] || "UAH",
      description: params[:description],
      server_url: liqpay_callback_url,
      result_url: checkout_result_url
    )

    # Return JSON; the frontend will use these values to build a form
    render json: payment
  end
end
```

### 5. Routes

Add the following lines to `config/routes.rb`:

```ruby
Rails.application.routes.draw do
  post "/checkout", to: "checkout#create"
  post "/liqpay/callback", to: "liqpay_callback#create", as: :liqpay_callback
end
```

### 6. Credentials

Store your LiqPay keys securely using Rails credentials:

```bash
EDITOR="code --wait" rails credentials:edit
```

Add the following to the credentials file:

```yaml

  public_key: your_public_key
  private_key: your_private_key
```

The code accesses them with:

```ruby
Rails.application.credentials.liqpay[:public_key]
Rails.application.credentials.liqpay[:private_key]
```

---

### Frontend integration (example)

The frontend should build and auto‑submit a form to LiqPay using the `data` and `signature` returned by `/checkout`:

```html
<form method="post" action="https://www.liqpay.ua/api/3/checkout" accept-charset="utf-8">
  <input type="hidden" name="data" value="<%= @payment[:data] %>" />
  <input type="hidden" name="signature" value="<%= @payment[:signature] %>" />
  <button type="submit">Pay</button>
</form>
```

---

## Notes

- The signature formula is the same for both checkout creation and callback verification:  
  `base64_encode(sha1(private_key + data + private_key))`
- The callback verifies the raw `data` string **exactly** as received in the request. Do not decode it before verifying the signature.
- `ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare` prevents timing attacks during signature comparison.
- The callback action always returns HTTP 200 on success, even if the order is not found, to prevent LiqPay from retrying indefinitely. You can choose to log or handle missing orders differently.

```ruby
# katottg.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "csv"

class Katottg
  # Column aliases to handle different possible CSV header names.
  COLUMN_ALIASES = {
    code: ["Код КАТОТТГ", "Код", "Код КОАТУУ", "code", "katottg_code"],
    name: ["Назва", "Назва об'єкта", "Назва елемента", "name", "settlement_name"],
    category: ["Категорія", "Тип", "Рівень", "category", "type", "level"],
    district: ["Район", "Назва району", "district", "raion"],
    region: ["Область", "Назва області", "region", "oblast"],
    community: ["Територіальна громада", "Громада", "community", "hromada"]
  }.freeze

  # Categories that are considered settlements.
  SETTLEMENT_CATEGORIES = %w[місто селище село смт].freeze

  attr_reader :records

  # file_path - path to CSV file with KATOTTH data.
  # options:
  #   :col_sep          - column separator (auto-detected by default)
  #   :only_settlements - if true, search only settlements (default true)
  def initialize(file_path, options = {})
    @file_path = file_path
    @col_sep = options.fetch(:col_sep, detect_col_sep(file_path))
    @only_settlements = options.fetch(:only_settlements, true)
    @records = load_records
  end

  # Search settlements by name (case-insensitive substring match).
  # Returns array of record hashes with keys: :code, :name, :category, :district, :region, :community.
  def search_by_name(query, limit: 20)
    normalized_query = normalize(query)
    return [] if normalized_query.empty?

    matches = @records.each_with_object([]) do |record, arr|
      next if @only_settlements && !settlement?(record[:category])

      name = normalize(record[:name])
      next unless name.include?(normalized_query)

      # Score: exact match first, then prefix match, then substring match.
      score = if name == normalized_query
                0
              elsif name.start_with?(normalized_query)
                1
              else
                2
              end

      arr << { record: record, score: score }
    end

    matches
      .sort_by { |m| [m[:score], m[:record][:name].length, m[:record][:name]] }
      .first(limit)
      .map { |m| m[:record] }
  end

  private

  def load_records
    rows = []
    CSV.foreach(@file_path, headers: true, col_sep: @col_sep, encoding: "bom|utf-8") do |row|
      record = {}
      COLUMN_ALIASES.each do |key, aliases|
        header = find_header(row.headers, aliases)
        record[key] = header ? row[header]&.strip : nil
      end
      rows << record
    end
    rows
  rescue Errno::ENOENT
    raise "File not found: #{@file_path}"
  end

  def find_header(headers, aliases)
    headers.find { |h| aliases.include?(h&.strip) }
  end

  def normalize(str)
    str.to_s.strip.downcase.gsub(/\s+/, " ")
  end

  def settlement?(category)
    return true if category.nil? || category.empty?

    normalized = normalize(category)
    SETTLEMENT_CATEGORIES.any? { |c| normalized.include?(c) }
  end

  def detect_col_sep(file_path)
    first_line = File.open(file_path, "r:bom|utf-8", &:readline)
    if first_line.include?(";")
      ";"
    elsif first_line.include?("\t")
      "\t"
    else
      ","
    end
  rescue StandardError
    ","
  end
end

# Minimal CLI for demonstration
if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
  if ARGV.length < 2
    puts "Usage: ruby katottg.rb <path_to_katottg_csv> <query> [--all]"
    puts "  --all  search in all categories, not only settlements"
    exit 1
  end

  file_path = ARGV[0]
  query = ARGV[1]
  only_settlements = !ARGV.include?("--all")

  searcher = Katottg.new(file_path, only_settlements: only_settlements)
  results = searcher.search_by_name(query, limit: 20)

  if results.empty?
    puts "No results found."
  else
    results.each do |r|
      puts [r[:code], r[:name], r[:category], r[:district], r[:region]].compact.join(" | ")
    end
  end
end
```
