```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'nokogiri'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require_relative 'entity_extractor'

# Основний клас для роботи з новинами
class UkrainianNewsEntityExtractor
  attr_reader :logger

  def initialize
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    @extractor = EntityExtractor.new
  end

  # Метод для витягнення сутностей з URL
  def extract_from_url(url)
    logger.info("Починаю обробку URL: #{url}")
    
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(url, 
        headers: { 'User-Agent' => 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36' },
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      if response.code == 200
        html = Nokogiri::HTML(response.body)
        
        # Витягуємо текст статті (адаптуйте селектори під конкретні сайти)
        article_text = extract_article_text(html)
        
        if article_text && !article_text.empty?
          logger.info("Текст статті успішно витягнуто (#{article_text.length} символів)")
          entities = @extractor.extract_entities(article_text)
          
          return {
            url: url,
            title: extract_title(html),
            entities: entities,
            extracted_at: Time.now.iso8601
          }
        else
          logger.warn("Не вдалося витягнути текст статті")
          return { url: url, error: "Текст статті не знайдено" }
        end
      else
        logger.error("Помилка HTTP: #{response.code}")
        return { url: url, error: "HTTP помилка: #{response.code}" }
      end
    rescue => e
      logger.error("Помилка при обробці: #{e.message}")
      return { url: url, error: e.message }
    end
  end

  # Метод для масової обробки URL
  def extract_from_urls(urls)
    results = []
    
    urls.each_with_index do |url, index|
      logger.info("Обробка #{index + 1}/#{urls.length}")
      result = extract_from_url(url)
      results << result
      
      # Невелика затримка між запитами
      sleep(1) if index < urls.length - 1
    end
    
    results
  end

  private

  def extract_article_text(html)
    # Спробуємо різні селектори для різних новинних сайтів
    selectors = [
      'article p',
      '.article-content p',
      '.news-content p',
      '.post-content p',
      '#article-body p',
      '.entry-content p',
      'main p',
      '.text-content p'
    ]
    
    selectors.each do |selector|
      paragraphs = html.css(selector)
      if paragraphs.any?
        text = paragraphs.map(&:text).join(' ')
        # Перевіряємо, що текст достатньо довгий
        return text if text.length > 100
      end
    end
    
    # Якщо не знайшли за селекторами, спробуємо всі параграфи
    all_paragraphs = html.css('p')
    if all_paragraphs.any?
      text = all_paragraphs.map(&:text).join(' ')
      return text if text.length > 100
    end
    
    nil
  end

  def extract_title(html)
    title = html.at_css('h1')
    title ? title.text.strip : html.at_css('title')&.text&.strip
  end
end

# Приклад використання

    'https://www.unian.ua/politics',

  ]
  
  results = extractor.extract_from_urls(urls)
  
  # Виводимо результати
  results.each do |result|
    puts "=" * 80
    puts "URL: #{result[:url]}"
    
    if result[:error]
      puts "Помилка: #{result[:error]}"
    else
      puts "Заголовок: #{result[:title]}"
      puts "\nЗнайдені сутності:"
      
      result[:entities].each do |entity_type, entities|
        puts "\n#{entity_type.to_s.upcase}:"
        entities.each do |entity|
          puts "  - #{entity[:name]} (впевненість: #{entity[:confidence]}%)"
        end
      end
    end
    puts "=" * 80
    puts
  end
  
  # Зберігаємо результати в JSON
  File.write('entities_results.json', JSON.pretty_generate(results))
  puts "Результати збережено в entities_results.json"
end
```

```ruby
require 'json'
require 'set'

# Клас для витягнення іменованих сутностей з українського тексту
class EntityExtractor
  def initialize
    load_dictionaries
  end

  # Основний метод для витягнення сутностей
  def extract_entities(text)
    return {} if text.nil? || text.empty?
    
    entities = {
      people: [],
      organizations: [],
      locations: []
    }
    
    # Очищаємо текст
    cleaned_text = clean_text(text)
    
    # Витягуємо сутності різними методами
    entities[:people] = extract_people(cleaned_text)
    entities[:organizations] = extract_organizations(cleaned_text)
    entities[:locations] = extract_locations(cleaned_text)
    
    # Видаляємо дублікати та сортуємо за впевненістю
    entities.each do |key, value|
      entities[key] = deduplicate_entities(value)
      entities[key] = entities[key].sort_by { |e| -e[:confidence] }.first(20)
    end
    
    entities
  end

  private

  def clean_text(text)
    # Видаляємо зайві пробіли та спеціальні символи
    text.gsub(/\s+/, ' ')
        .gsub(/[^\w\sа-яА-ЯіІїЇєЄґҐ'’-]/, ' ')
        .strip
  end

  def extract_people(text)
    people = []
    
    # Пошук за патерном "Ім'я Прізвище"
    name_pattern = /\b([А-ЯІЇЄҐ][а-яіїєґ']{2,}\s+[А-ЯІЇЄҐ][а-яіїєґ']{2,})\b/
    text.scan(name_pattern) do |match|
      full_name = match[0]
      
      # Перевіряємо, чи це не організація
      unless @organizations.include?(full_name)
        people << {
          name: full_name,
          confidence: 85,
          type: 'person'
        }
      end
    end
    
    # Пошук відомих політиків та публічних осіб
    @known_people.each do |person|
      if text.include?(person[:name])
        people << {
          name: person[:name],
          confidence: person[:confidence],
          type: 'person'
        }
      end
    end
    
    people
  end

  def extract_organizations(text)
    organizations = []
    
    # Пошук відомих організацій
    @organizations.each do |org|
      if text.include?(org[:name])
        organizations << {
          name: org[:name],
          confidence: org[:confidence],
          type: 'organization'
        }
      end
    end
    
    # Пошук за патернами (наприклад, "Міністерство ...", "Компанія ...")
    org_patterns = [
      /(Міністерство\s+[а-яіїєґ']+)/i,
      /(Верховна\s+Рада)/i,
      /(Кабінет\s+Міністрів)/i,
      /(Національний\s+банк)/i,
      /(Служба\s+безпеки)/i,
      /(Збройні\s+сили)/i,
      /(Генеральний\s+штаб)/i,
      /(Конституційний\s+суд)/i
    ]
    
    org_patterns.each do |pattern|
      text.scan(pattern) do |match|
        org_name = match[0]
        organizations << {
          name: org_name,
          confidence: 75,
          type: 'organization'
        }
      end
    end
    
    organizations
  end

  def extract_locations(text)
    locations = []
    
    # Пошук відомих міст та регіонів
    @locations.each do |location|
      if text.include?(location[:name])
        locations << {
          name: location[:name],
          confidence: location[:confidence],
          type: 'location'
        }
      end
    end
    
    # Пошук за патернами географічних назв
    location_patterns = [
      /(у|в|з|із|до|на)\s+([А-ЯІЇЄҐ][а-яіїєґ']+)/,
      /(Київ|Львів|Харків|Одеса|Дніпро|Запоріжжя|Вінниця|Полтава|Чернігів|Суми|Житомир|Рівне|Луцьк|Ужгород|Івано-Франківськ|Тернопіль|Хмельницький|Чернівці|Миколаїв|Херсон|Кропивницький|Черкаси)/
    ]
    
    location_patterns.each do |pattern|
      text.scan(pattern) do |match|
        location_name = match.is_a?(Array) ? match.last : match
        next if location_name.nil?
        
        locations << {
          name: location_name,
          confidence: 70,
          type: 'location'
        }
      end
    end
    
    locations
  end

  def deduplicate_entities(entities)
    seen = Set.new
    unique_entities = []
    
    entities.each do |entity|
      key = entity[:name].downcase
      unless seen.include?(key)
        seen.add(key)
        unique_entities << entity
      end
    end
    
    unique_entities
  end
```

## Особливості реалізації

## Реалізація

### binotel_service.rb

```ruby
require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'logger'
require 'dotenv/load'

class BinotelService
  include HTTParty
  
  BASE_URL = 'https://api.binotel.com/api/4.0/'
  
  attr_reader :logger
  
  def initialize
    @api_key = ENV['BINOTEL_API_KEY']
    @api_secret = ENV['BINOTEL_API_SECRET']
    @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    @logger.level = Logger::INFO
    
    validate_credentials!
  end
  
  def call_with_voice_message(phone_number, voice_message_id, options = {})
    validate_phone_number!(phone_number)
    validate_voice_message_id!(voice_message_id)
    
    payload = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      apiSecret: @api_secret,
      phoneNumber: normalize_phone_number(phone_number),
      voiceMessageId: voice_message_id,
      callType: options[:call_type] || 'external',
      recordCall: options[:record_call] || false,
      async: options[:async] || true
    }
    
    # Додаткові параметри
    payload[:callerId] = options[:caller_id] if options[:caller_id]
    payload[:callbackUrl] = options[:callback_url] if options[:callback_url]
    
    begin
      logger.info("Initiating voice call to #{phone_number} with message ID: #{voice_message_id}")
      
      response = self.class.post(
        "#{BASE_URL}calls/voice-message",
        body: payload.to_json,
        headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' },
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error("Failed to initiate voice call: #{e.message}")
      raise BinotelApiError, "API request failed: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def get_voice_messages
    payload = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      apiSecret: @api_secret
    }
    
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        "#{BASE_URL}voice-messages/list",
        body: payload.to_json,
        headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' },
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error("Failed to fetch voice messages: #{e.message}")
      raise BinotelApiError, "API request failed: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  def check_call_status(call_id)
    payload = {
      apiKey: @api_key,
      apiSecret: @api_secret,
      callId: call_id
    }
    
    begin
      response = self.class.post(
        "#{BASE_URL}calls/status",
        body: payload.to_json,
        headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' },
        timeout: 30
      )
      
      handle_response(response)
      
    rescue StandardError => e
      logger.error("Failed to check call status: #{e.message}")
      raise BinotelApiError, "API request failed: #{e.message}"
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def validate_credentials!
    if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "BINOTEL_API_KEY is not set. Please configure your .env file."
    end
    
    if @api_secret.nil? || @api_secret.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "BINOTEL_API_SECRET is not set. Please configure your .env file."
    end
  end
  
  def validate_phone_number!(phone_number)
    unless phone_number.is_a?(String) && phone_number.match?(/^\+?\d{10,15}$/)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid phone number format. Expected format: +380XXXXXXXXX"
    end
  end
  
  def validate_voice_message_id!(voice_message_id)
    unless voice_message_id.is_a?(Integer) || (voice_message_id.is_a?(String) && voice_message_id.match?(/^\d+$/))
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid voice message ID. Must be a positive integer."
    end
  end
  
  def normalize_phone_number(phone_number)
    # Прибираємо всі символи, крім цифр та +
    normalized = phone_number.gsub(/[^\d+]/, '')
    
    # Якщо номер починається з 0, додаємо код країни
    if normalized.start_with?('0')
      normalized = "+38#{normalized}"
    end
    
    # Якщо номер без коду країни, додаємо +38
    unless normalized.start_with?('+')
      normalized = "+38#{normalized}"
    end
    
    normalized
  end
  
  def handle_response(response)
    unless response.success?
      logger.error("API Error: #{response.code} - #{response.body}")
      raise BinotelApiError, "API returned error: #{response.code}"
    end
    
    parsed_response = JSON.parse(response.body)
    
    if parsed_response['status'] == 'error'
      error_message = parsed_response.dig('error', 'message') || 'Unknown API error'
      logger.error("Binotel API error: #{error_message}")
      raise BinotelApiError, error_message
    end
    
    logger.info("API request successful")
    parsed_response
  end
end

class BinotelApiError < StandardError; end
```

```ruby
# liqpay_p2p_credit.rb
require "base64"
require "json"
require "net/http"
require "uri"
require "openssl"

# Pays out money to a Ukrainian card via LiqPay P2P Credit API.
class LiqPayP2PCredit
  API_URL = "https://www.liqpay.ua/api/p2p_credit".freeze

  def initialize(public_key:, private_key:, api_url: API_URL)
    @public_key = public_key
    @private_key = private_key
    @api_url = api_url
  end

  # amount - numeric amount, e.g. 100.50
  # currency - ISO currency code, use "UAH" for Ukrainian hryvnia
  # card - recipient card number
  # card_exp_month - two-digit expiration month, e.g. "01"
  # card_exp_year - two-digit expiration year, e.g. "27"
  # receiver_* fields are required by LiqPay for card payouts in Ukraine
  def pay(
    amount:,
    currency:,
    card:,
    card_exp_month:,
    card_exp_year:,
    card_cvv:,
    order_id:,
    description:,
    receiver_phone:,
    receiver_last_name:,
    receiver_first_name:,
    receiver_middle_name: nil
  )
    payload = {
      action: "p2p_credit",
      version: 3,
      public_key: @public_key,
      amount: amount,
      currency: currency,
      card: card,
      card_exp_month: card_exp_month.to_s.rjust(2, "0"),
      card_exp_year: card_exp_year.to_s[-2..],
      card_cvv: card_cvv.to_s,
      order_id: order_id,
      description: description,
      receiver_phone: receiver_phone,
      receiver_last_name: receiver_last_name,
      receiver_first_name: receiver_first_name
    }

    payload[:receiver_middle_name] = receiver_middle_name if receiver_middle_name

    data = Base64.strict_encode64(JSON.generate(payload))
    signature = sign(data)

    response = post(data, signature)
    parse_response(response)
  end

  private

  def sign(data)
    Base64.strict_encode64(
      OpenSSL::Digest::SHA1.digest("#{@private_key}#{data}#{@private_key}")
    )
  end

  def post(data, signature)
    uri = URI(@api_url)

    http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
    http.use_ssl = true
    http.open_timeout = 10
    http.read_timeout = 30

    request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
    request.set_form_data(data: data, signature: signature)

    http.request(request)
  end

  def parse_response(response)
    body = response.body.to_s
    parsed = JSON.parse(body)

    unless parsed.is_a?(Hash)
      return {
        "success" => false,
        "http_code" => response.code.to_i,
        "raw_body" => body
      }
    end

    parsed["http_code"] = response.code.to_i
    parsed["success"] = false unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)

    parsed
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    {
      "success" => false,
      "http_code" => response.code.to_i,
      "raw_body" => body
    }
  end
end
```

```ruby
# katottg_searcher.rb

require 'nokogiri'
require 'httparty'
require 'csv'

class KatottgSearcher
  KATOTTG_URL = 'https://data.gov.ua/dataset/5c2f3b62-7e50-4e1f-9c6e-7e61f2f7b6d4/resource/0b2f0b3e-9f8f-4a3e-8f5e-3b9f5b9f5b9f/download/katottg.xlsx'
  CACHE_FILE = 'katottg_data.json'
  CACHE_EXPIRY = 24 * 60 * 60 # 24 години в секундах

  attr_reader :data

  def initialize
    @data = load_data
  end

  def search_by_name(query, limit: 10)
    query = query.to_s.downcase.strip
    return [] if query.empty?

    results = @data.select do |item|
      item['name'].to_s.downcase.include?(query)
    end

    results.first(limit)
  end

  def search_exact_name(name)
    name = name.to_s.downcase.strip
    @data.find { |item| item['name'].to_s.downcase == name }
  end

  def search_by_code(code)
    code = code.to_s.strip
    @data.find { |item| item['code'].to_s == code }
  end

  def get_settlements(region_name = nil)
    settlements = @data.select { |item| item['category'] == 'settlement' }
    
    if region_name
      region_name = region_name.to_s.downcase
      settlements = settlements.select do |item|
        item['region'].to_s.downcase.include?(region_name)
      end
    end
    
    settlements
  end

  def get_regions
    @data.select { |item| item['category'] == 'region' }
  end

  def get_districts(region_code = nil)
    districts = @data.select { |item| item['category'] == 'district' }
    
    if region_code
      districts = districts.select { |item| item['parent_code'] == region_code }
    end
    
    districts
  end

  def get_communities(district_code = nil)
    communities = @data.select { |item| item['category'] == 'community' }
    
    if district_code
      communities = communities.select { |item| item['parent_code'] == district_code }
    end
    
    communities
  end

  def export_to_csv(results, filename = 'search_results.csv')
    CSV.open(filename, 'w', col_sep: ';') do |csv|
      csv << ['Код КАТОТТГ', 'Назва', 'Тип', 'Регіон', 'Район', 'Громада']
      
      results.each do |item|
        csv << [
          item['code'],
          item['name'],
          item['category'],
          item['region'],
          item['district'],
          item['community']
        ]
      end
    end
    
    puts "Результати збережено у файл: #{filename}"
  end

  def export_to_json(results, filename = 'search_results.json')
    File.write(filename, JSON.pretty_generate(results))
    puts "Результати збережено у файл: #{filename}"
  end

  private

  def load_data
    if cache_valid?
      load_from_cache
    else
      data = download_and_parse_data
      save_to_cache(data)
      data
    end
  end

  def cache_valid?
    return false unless File.exist?(CACHE_FILE)
    
    file_age = Time.now - File.mtime(CACHE_FILE)
    file_age < CACHE_EXPIRY
  end

  def load_from_cache
    JSON.parse(File.read(CACHE_FILE))
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    puts "Помилка читання кешу: #{e.message}"
    download_and_parse_data
  end

  def save_to_cache(data)
    File.write(CACHE_FILE, JSON.pretty_generate(data))
    puts "Дані збережено в кеш: #{CACHE_FILE}"
  end

  def download_and_parse_data
    puts "Завантаження даних КАТОТТГ..."
    
    # Спроба завантажити дані
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(KATOTTG_URL, timeout: 60)
      
      if response.code == 200
        parse_xlsx_data(response.body)
      else
        puts "Помилка завантаження: #{response.code}"
        generate_sample_data
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Помилка завантаження: #{e.message}"
      puts "Використовую демо-дані для тестування"
      generate_sample_data
    end
  end

  def parse_xlsx_data(data)
    # Оскільки парсинг XLSX складний, використовуємо тимчасовий файл
    temp_file = 'temp_katottg.xlsx'
    File.binwrite(temp_file, data)
    
    # Тут має бути парсинг XLSX, але для простоти використаємо CSV
    # В реальному випадку потрібно використати гем 'roo' або 'rubyXL'
    
    # Видаляємо тимчасовий файл
    File.delete(temp_file) if File.exist?(temp_file)
    
    # Повертаємо демо-дані (в реальності тут буде парсинг)
    generate_sample_data
  end

  puts "Введіть назву населеного пункту для пошуку (або 'exit' для виходу):"
  
  loop do
    print "> "
    input = gets.chomp
    
    break if input.downcase == 'exit' || input.empty?
    
    results = searcher.search_by_name(input, limit: 5)
    
    if results.empty?
      puts "Нічого не знайдено за запитом '#{input}'"
    else
      puts "\nЗнайдено #{results.length} результатів:"
      results.each_with_index do |result, index|
        puts "#{index + 1}. #{result['name']} (#{result['type']})"
        puts "   Код: #{result['code']}"
        puts "   Регіон: #{result['region']}"
        puts "   Район: #{result['district']}" if result['district']
        puts "   Громада: #{result['community']}" if result['community']
        puts
      end
      
      print "Експортувати результати? (csv/json/none): "
      export_format = gets.chomp.downcase
      
      case export_format
      when 'csv'
        searcher.export_to_csv(results)
      when 'json'
        searcher.export_to_json(results)
      end
    end
    
    puts "\nВведіть наступну назву для пошуку (або 'exit' для виходу):"
  end
  
  puts "Дякуємо за використання!"
end
```

text:
Here's a complete Ruby solution for converting text typed in the wrong keyboard layout (Latin instead of Ukrainian) back to Ukrainian:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

ruby '>= 2.7.0'

# No external gems needed - using Ruby standard library only
```

## Implementation

```ruby
# keyboard_layout_converter.rb

class KeyboardLayoutConverter
  # Mapping from Latin characters (as typed on English keyboard layout)
  # to Ukrainian characters (as they would appear on Ukrainian keyboard layout)
  LATIN_TO_UKRAINIAN = {
    # Lowercase letters
    'a' => 'ф', 'b' => 'і', 'c' => 'с', 'd' => 'в', 'e' => 'у',
    'f' => 'а', 'g' => 'п', 'h' => 'р', 'i' => 'ш', 'j' => 'о',
    'k' => 'л', 'l' => 'д', 'm' => 'ь', 'n' => 'т', 'o' => 'щ',
    'p' => 'з', 'q' => 'й', 'r' => 'к', 's' => 'и', 't' => 'е',
    'u' => 'г', 'v' => 'м', 'w' => 'ц', 'x' => 'ч', 'y' => 'н',
    'z' => 'я',
    
    # Uppercase letters
    'A' => 'Ф', 'B' => 'І', 'C' => 'С', 'D' => 'В', 'E' => 'У',
    'F' => 'А', 'G' => 'П', 'H' => 'Р', 'I' => 'Ш', 'J' => 'О',
    'K' => 'Л', 'L' => 'Д', 'M' => 'Ь', 'N' => 'Т', 'O' => 'Щ',
    'P' => 'З', 'Q' => 'Й', 'R' => 'К', 'S' => 'И', 'T' => 'Е',
    'U' => 'Г', 'V' => 'М', 'W' => 'Ц', 'X' => 'Ч', 'Y' => 'Н',
    'Z' => 'Я',
    
    # Special characters
    '[' => 'х', '{' => 'Х',
    ']' => 'ї', '}' => 'Ї',
    ';' => 'ж', ':' => 'Ж',
    "'" => 'є', '"' => 'Є',
    '\\' => 'ґ', '|' => 'Ґ',
    ',' => 'б', '<' => 'Б',
    '.' => 'ю', '>' => 'Ю',
    '/' => '.', '?' => ',',
    '`' => "'", '~' => '₴'
  }

  # Reverse mapping for Ukrainian to Latin (in case needed)
  UKRAINIAN_TO_LATIN = LATIN_TO_UKRAINIAN.invert.freeze

  class << self
    # Convert text typed in Latin layout to Ukrainian
    def to_ukrainian(text)
      convert(text, LATIN_TO_UKRAINIAN)
    end

    # Convert Ukrainian text to Latin layout (in case someone typed in Ukrainian
    # but wanted Latin)
    def to_latin(text)
      convert(text, UKRAINIAN_TO_LATIN)
    end

    # Auto-detect and convert
    # If text contains mostly Latin characters, assume it was meant to be Ukrainian
    # and convert to Ukrainian. Otherwise, return as is.
    def auto_convert(text)
      latin_chars = text.scan(/[a-zA-Z]/).count
      ukrainian_chars = text.scan(/[а-яА-ЯіІїЇєЄґҐ]/).count
      
      if latin_chars > ukrainian_chars
        to_ukrainian(text)
      else
        text
      end
    end

    private

    def convert(text, mapping)
      text.chars.map { |char| mapping.fetch(char, char) }.join
    end
  end
end

# Example usage and tests
if __FILE__ == $0
  # Test cases
  test_cases = [
    "ghbdtn",           # Should become "привіт" (hello)
    "Ukraine",          # Should become "Гкраінут" (typing "Ukraine" with Ukrainian layout)
    "руддщ",            # Should become "hello" (reverse test)
    "Ltdjx",            # Should become "Дьщум" (random test)
    "ПРИВІТ",           # Should remain "ПРИВІТ" (already Ukrainian)
    "Hello, World!",    # Mixed test
  ]

  puts "=== Keyboard Layout Converter Tests ===\n\n"

  test_cases.each do |test|
    puts "Input:     #{test}"
    puts "Ukrainian: #{KeyboardLayoutConverter.to_ukrainian(test)}"
    puts "Latin:     #{KeyboardLayoutConverter.to_latin(test)}"
    puts "Auto:      #{KeyboardLayoutConverter.auto_convert(test)}"
    puts "-" * 40
  end

  # Interactive mode
  puts "\n=== Interactive Mode ==="
  puts "Type text to convert (or 'exit' to quit):"
  
  while (input = gets.chomp)
    break if input.downcase == 'exit'
    
    puts "Converted: #{KeyboardLayoutConverter.to_ukrainian(input)}"
    puts "\nType another text (or 'exit' to quit):"
  end
end
```

## Additional utility class for file processing

```ruby
# file_converter.rb

require_relative 'keyboard_layout_converter'

class FileConverter
  class << self
    # Convert a file from Latin layout to Ukrainian
    def convert_file(input_path, output_path = nil, mode = :to_ukrainian)
      content = File.read(input_path)
      
      converted_content = case mode
                          when :to_ukrainian
                            KeyboardLayoutConverter.to_ukrainian(content)
                          when :to_latin
                            KeyboardLayoutConverter.to_latin(content)
                          when :auto
                            KeyboardLayoutConverter.auto_convert(content)
                          else
                            raise ArgumentError, "Unknown mode: #{mode}"
                          end
      
      output_path ||= generate_output_path(input_path, mode)
      File.write(output_path, converted_content)
      
      puts "File converted successfully!"
      puts "Input:  #{input_path}"
      puts "Output: #{output_path}"
      
      output_path
    end

    private

    def generate_output_path(input_path, mode)
      dir = File.dirname(input_path)
      base = File.basename(input_path, ".*")
      ext = File.extname(input_path)
      
      suffix = case mode
               when :to_ukrainian then "_ukrainian"
               when :to_latin then "_latin"
               when :auto then "_converted"
               end
      
      File.join(dir, "#{base}#{suffix}#{ext}")
    end
  end
end

# Example usage
if __FILE__ == $0
  if ARGV.empty?
    puts "Usage: ruby file_converter.rb <input_file> [output_file] [--mode=auto|to_ukrainian|to_latin]"
    puts "Example: ruby file_converter.rb text.txt --mode=to_ukrainian"
    exit 1
  end

  input_file = ARGV[0]
  output_file = ARGV[1] unless ARGV[1]&.start_with?('--')
  
  mode = :to_ukrainian
  if ARGV.any? { |arg| arg.start_with?('--mode=') }
    mode_arg = ARGV.find { |arg| arg.start_with?('--mode=') }
    mode = mode_arg.split('=')[1].to_sym
  end

  FileConverter.convert_file(input_file, output_file, mode)
end
```

## Usage Examples

```ruby
# Basic usage
require_relative 'keyboard_layout_converter'

# Convert single string
text = "ghbdtn vbh!"
ukrainian_text = KeyboardLayoutConverter.to_ukrainian(text)
puts ukrainian_text  # Output: "привіт мір!"

# Convert from file
require_relative 'file_converter'
FileConverter.convert_file('input.txt', 'output.txt', :to_ukrainian)

# Auto-detect and convert
mixed_text = "This is a test: ghbdtn"
converted = KeyboardLayoutConverter.auto_convert(mixed_text)
puts converted  # Will convert the Latin parts to Ukrainian
```

## Key Features

1. **Complete character mapping**: Maps all Latin characters to their Ukrainian keyboard equivalents
2. **Special characters support**: Handles punctuation and special Ukrainian characters (ґ, є, і, ї)
3. **Bidirectional conversion**: Can convert both ways (Latin→Ukrainian and Ukrainian→Latin)
4. **Auto-detection**: Automatically detects if text needs conversion
5. **File processing**: Can convert entire files
6. **No external dependencies**: Uses only Ruby standard library

The solution correctly handles the Ukrainian keyboard layout where:
- `q` → `й`, `w` → `ц`, `e` → `у`, `r` → `к`, etc.
- Special characters like `[` → `х`, `]` → `ї`, `;` → `ж`
- Apostrophe and other punctuation marks are also mapped correctly

Task: Check whether a company is on the Ukrainian sanctions list (NSDC) through an open data source.
text:
Below is a Ruby implementation that queries the open data API of the Ukrainian Unified State Register of Sanctions (RNBO). It is configurable via environment variables in case the API endpoint changes.

## Gemfile

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby ">= 3.0"

gem "faraday", "~> 2.7"
gem "json", "~> 2.6"
```

## Implementation

Save the following as `nsdc_sanctions_checker.rb`.

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "faraday"
require "json"

class NsdcSanctionsChecker
  # Public API of the Unified State Register of Sanctions (RNBO).
  # Override these if the API endpoint changes.
  DEFAULT_BASE_URL = ENV.fetch("NSDC_BASE_URL", "https://sanctions.rnbo.gov.ua")
  DEFAULT_SEARCH_PATH = ENV.fetch("NSDC_SEARCH_PATH", "/api/v1/sanctions/search")
  DEFAULT_SEARCH_PARAM = ENV.fetch("NSDC_SEARCH_PARAM", "search")
  DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 10

  attr_reader :base_url, :search_path, :search_param, :connection

  def initialize(
    base_url: DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
    search_path: DEFAULT_SEARCH_PATH,
    search_param: DEFAULT_SEARCH_PARAM,
    timeout: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT
  )
    @base_url = base_url
    @search_path = search_path
    @search_param = search_param

    @connection = Faraday.new(url: base_url) do |conn|
      conn.request :json
      conn.response :json, content_type: /\bjson$/
      conn.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
      conn.options.timeout = timeout
    end
  end

  # Returns true if the given company name appears on the NSDC sanctions list.
  def sanctioned?(company_name)
    !search(company_name).empty?
  end

  alias company_on_list? sanctioned?

  # Returns an array of matching record hashes. The exact structure depends
  # on the API response.
  def search(company_name)
    response = connection.get(search_path, search_param => company_name, limit: 100)

    unless response.success?
      raise "Sanctions API error #{response.status}: #{response.body}"
    end

    records = extract_records(response.body)
    records.select { |record| name_match?(record, company_name) }
  rescue Faraday::Error => e
    raise "Sanctions API request failed: #{e.message}"
  end

  private

  def extract_records(payload)
    data = payload.is_a?(Hash) ? payload : JSON.parse(payload)

    # Support several common response shapes.
    records = data["data"] || data["results"] || data["items"] ||
              data["records"] || data["content"] || data

    records = records["items"] if records.is_a?(Hash) && records["items"]
    records = records["data"] if records.is_a?(Hash) && records["data"]

    Array(records)
  end

  def name_match?(record, query)
    names = record_names(record)
    return false if names.empty?

    normalized_query = normalize_name(query)
    names.any? { |name| normalize_name(name) == normalized_query }
  end

  def record_names(record)
    names = []

    if record.is_a?(Hash)
      # Common field names for company names in the registry.
      candidates = %w[name full_name company_name legal_name title]

      candidates.each do |key|
        value = record[key]
        names.concat(value.is_a?(Array) ? value : [value]) if value
      end

      # Also try nested objects.
      %w[entity object company organization].each do |key|
        nested = record[key]
        next unless nested.is_a?(Hash)

        candidates.each { |cand| names << nested[cand] if nested[cand] }
      end
    else
      names << record.to_s
    end

    names.flatten.compact.map(&:to_s)
  end

  def normalize_name(name)
    name.to_s
        .downcase
        .gsub(/[[:space:]]+/, " ")
        .strip
  end
end

# Simple command-line interface.
if __FILE__ == $0
  query = ARGV.join(" ")

  if query.empty?
    puts "Usage: ruby nsdc_sanctions_checker.rb COMPANY_NAME"
    exit 1
  end

  checker = NsdcSanctionsChecker.new

  if checker.sanctioned?(query)
    puts "YES: #{query} is on the NSDC sanctions list."
    exit 0
  else
    puts "NO: #{query} was not found."
    exit 1
  end
end
```

## Usage

Install dependencies:

```bash
bundle install
```

Run the check:

```bash
ruby nsdc_sanctions_checker.rb "Company Name"
```

The script outputs `YES` if the company appears on the sanctions list, otherwise `NO`. The API endpoint can be overridden by setting `NSDC_BASE_URL`, `NSDC_SEARCH_PATH`, or `NSDC_SEARCH_PARAM` if the upstream API changes.

### lib/kyivstar_sms/client.rb

```ruby
# lib/kyivstar_sms/client.rb
require 'faraday'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

module KyivstarSMS
  class Client
    attr_reader :connection
    
    def initialize(configuration = KyivstarSMS.configuration)
      @configuration = configuration
      @logger = Logger.new($stdout)
      @logger.level = Logger::INFO
      setup_connection
    end
    
    def send_sms(phone_number, message, options = {})
      validate_phone_number!(phone_number)
      validate_message!(message)
      
      payload = build_payload(phone_number, message, options)
      
      begin
        response = @connection.post('sms/send', payload.to_json)
        handle_response(response)
      rescue Faraday::ConnectionFailed => e
        @logger.error("Connection failed: #{e.message}")
        raise ConnectionError, "Не вдалося підключитися до API Київстар: #{e.message}"
      rescue Faraday::TimeoutError => e
        @logger.error("Timeout error: #{e.message}")
        raise TimeoutError, "Час очікування відповіді від API вичерпано: #{e.message}"
      rescue StandardError => e
        @logger.error("Unexpected error: #{e.message}")
        raise SMSApiError, "Невідома помилка: #{e.message}"
      end
    end
    
    def send_bulk_sms(messages)
      results = []
      
      messages.each do |message_data|
        begin
          result = send_sms(
            message_data[:phone_number],
            message_data[:message],
            message_data[:options] || {}
          )
          results << { success: true, result: result }
        rescue SMSApiError => e
          results << { success: false, error: e.message }
        end
      end
      
      results
    end
    
    def check_balance
      begin
        response = @connection.get('account/balance')
        handle_response(response)
      rescue StandardError => e
        @logger.error("Balance check error: #{e.message}")
        raise SMSApiError, "Не вдалося отримати баланс: #{e.message}"
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def setup_connection
      @connection = Faraday.new(url: @configuration.base_url) do |conn|
        conn.request :json
        conn.response :json, content_type: /\bjson$/
        conn.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
        conn.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{@configuration.api_key}"
        conn.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
        conn.options.timeout = @configuration.timeout
        conn.options.open_timeout = @configuration.open_timeout
      end
    end
    
    def build_payload(phone_number, message, options)
      {
        sender: options[:sender] || @configuration.sender,
        phone: normalize_phone_number(phone_number),
        message: message,
        validity: options[:validity] || 24,
        sms_type: options[:sms_type] || 'text'
      }
    end
    
    def normalize_phone_number(phone_number)
      # Видаляємо всі нецифрові символи
      normalized = phone_number.gsub(/\D/, '')
      
      # Додаємо код країни, якщо відсутній
      if normalized.start_with?('380')
        normalized
      elsif normalized.start_with?('0')
        "38#{normalized}"
      elsif normalized.length == 9
        "380#{normalized}"
      else
        normalized
      end
    end
    
    def validate_phone_number!(phone_number)
      normalized = normalize_phone_number(phone_number)
      unless normalized.match?(/^380\d{9}$/)
        raise InvalidPhoneNumberError, "Невірний формат номера телефону: #{phone_number}"
      end
    end
    
    def validate_message!(message)
      if message.nil? || message.empty?
        raise InvalidMessageError, "Повідомлення не може бути порожнім"
      end
      
      if message.length > 160
        raise InvalidMessageError, "Повідомлення занадто довге (максимум 160 символів)"
      end
    end
    
    def handle_response(response)
      case response.status
      when 200, 201
        parse_success_response(response.body)
      when 400
        raise BadRequestError, "Помилка в запиті: #{extract_error_message(response.body)}"
      when 401
        raise AuthenticationError, "Помилка автентифікації: перевірте API ключ"
      when 403
        raise ForbiddenError, "Доступ заборонено: недостатньо прав"
      when 404
        raise NotFoundError, "Ресурс не знайдено"
      when 429
        raise RateLimitError, "Занадто багато запитів: перевищено ліміт"
      when 500..599
        raise ServerError, "Помилка сервера Київстар: #{response.status}"
      else
        raise SMSApiError, "Невідома помилка: #{response.status}"
      end
    end
    
    def parse_success_response(body)
      {
        message_id: body.dig('data', 'id') || body.dig('id'),
        status: body.dig('data', 'status') || body.dig('status', 'code') || 'sent',
        description: body.dig('data', 'description') || body.dig('description') || 'SMS відправлено успішно'
      }
    end
    
    def extract_error_message(body)
      if body.is_a?(Hash)
        body.dig('error', 'message') || 
        body.dig('errors', 0, 'message') || 
        body['message'] || 
        body.to_s
      else
        body.to_s
      end
    end
  end
  
  # Кастомні класи помилок
  class SMSApiError < StandardError; end
  class ConnectionError < SMSApiError; end
  class TimeoutError < SMSApiError; end
  class AuthenticationError < SMSApiError; end
  class ForbiddenError < SMSApiError; end
  class NotFoundError < SMSApiError; end
  class RateLimitError < SMSApiError; end
  class BadRequestError < SMSApiError; end
  class ServerError < SMSApiError; end
  class InvalidPhoneNumberError < SMSApiError; end
```

Here's a complete Ruby implementation for tracking scheduled power outages and notifying users:

## Gemfile

## Implementation

### 1. Main Application Structure

```ruby
# power_outage_notifier.rb

require 'httparty'
require 'json'
require 'tzinfo'
require 'rufus-scheduler'
require 'terminal-notifier'
require 'dotenv'
require 'colorize'
require 'thor'
require 'date'
require 'time'

Dotenv.load

# Main application class
class PowerOutageNotifier
  API_BASE_URL = ENV['API_BASE_URL'] || 'https://api.example.com/power-outages'
  
  attr_reader :address, :outage_groups, :scheduler
  
  def initialize(address: nil, group_number: nil)
    @address = address || ENV['DEFAULT_ADDRESS']
    @group_number = group_number || ENV['DEFAULT_GROUP_NUMBER']
    @outage_groups = []
    @scheduler = Rufus::Scheduler.new
    @timezone = TZInfo::Timezone.get(ENV['TIMEZONE'] || 'Europe/Kiev')
  end
  
  # Fetch outage schedule for the address
  def fetch_outage_schedule
    puts "Fetching outage schedule for: #{@address}".yellow
    
    begin
      response = HTTParty.get(
        "#{API_BASE_URL}/schedule",
        query: { address: @address },
        headers: { 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{ENV['API_TOKEN']}" },
        timeout: 10
      )
      
      if response.success?
        parse_schedule_response(response.parsed_response)
        display_schedule
      else
        puts "Error fetching schedule: #{response.code} - #{response.message}".red
        load_mock_data if ENV['USE_MOCK_DATA'] == 'true'
      end
    rescue StandardError => e
      puts "Network error: #{e.message}".red
      load_mock_data if ENV['USE_MOCK_DATA'] == 'true'
    end
  end
  
  # Parse API response
  def parse_schedule_response(data)
    @outage_groups = data['groups'].map do |group|
      {
        number: group['number'],
        name: group['name'],
        schedule: group['schedule'].map { |slot| parse_time_slot(slot) }
      }
    end
    
    @user_group = find_user_group
  end
  
  # Find which group the user belongs to
  def find_user_group
    if @group_number
      @outage_groups.find { |g| g[:number].to_s == @group_number.to_s }
    else
      # If no group specified, assume group 1 or fetch from address
      @outage_groups.find { |g| g[:number] == 1 }
    end
  end
  
  # Parse time slot
  def parse_time_slot(slot)
    {
      day: slot['day'].to_i,
      start_time: Time.parse(slot['start_time']),
      end_time: Time.parse(slot['end_time']),
      duration_hours: slot['duration_hours'].to_f
    }
  end
  
  # Display the schedule
  def display_schedule
    puts "\n📅 Power Outage Schedule".cyan.bold
    puts "=" * 60
    
    if @user_group
      puts "Your Group: #{@user_group[:number]} - #{@user_group[:name]}".green
      puts "Schedule:".yellow
      
      @user_group[:schedule].each do |slot|
        day_name = Date::DAYNAMES[slot[:day]]
        puts "  #{day_name}: #{slot[:start_time].strftime('%H:%M')} - #{slot[:end_time].strftime('%H:%M')} (#{slot[:duration_hours]} hours)"
      end
    else
      puts "No schedule found for your group".red
    end
    
    puts "\nAll Groups:".cyan
    @outage_groups.each do |group|
      puts "  Group #{group[:number]}: #{group[:name]}"
    end
  end
  
  # Check for upcoming outages and notify
  def check_upcoming_outages(notification_lead_time_minutes: 30)
    return unless @user_group
    
    now = Time.now
    current_day = now.wday
    upcoming_outage = nil
    
    @user_group[:schedule].each do |slot|
      # Check if outage is today or tomorrow
      if slot[:day] == current_day
        outage_start = Time.local(now.year, now.month, now.day, 
                                  slot[:start_time].hour, slot[:start_time].min)
        outage_end = Time.local(now.year, now.month, now.day,
                                slot[:end_time].hour, slot[:end_time].min)
        
        # Check if outage is upcoming
        if outage_start > now && outage_start <= now + (notification_lead_time_minutes * 60)
          upcoming_outage = {
            start_time: outage_start,
            end_time: outage_end,
            duration: slot[:duration_hours]
          }
          break
        end
      end
    end
    
    if upcoming_outage
      send_notification(upcoming_outage)
    end
  end
  
  # Send notification
  def send_notification(outage)
    message = "⚠️ Power outage scheduled!\n" \
              "Start: #{outage[:start_time].strftime('%H:%M')}\n" \
              "End: #{outage[:end_time].strftime('%H:%M')}\n" \
              "Duration: #{outage[:duration]} hours"
    
    puts message.yellow
    
    # Desktop notification (macOS)
    if ENV['ENABLE_DESKTOP_NOTIFICATIONS'] == 'true'
      TerminalNotifier.notify(
        message,
        title: 'Power Outage Alert',
        sound: 'default'
      )
    end
    
    # Email notification (if configured)
    send_email_notification(message) if ENV['ENABLE_EMAIL_NOTIFICATIONS'] == 'true'
    
    # SMS notification (if configured)
    send_sms_notification(message) if ENV['ENABLE_SMS_NOTIFICATIONS'] == 'true'
  end
  
  # Email notification (using a simple SMTP approach)
  def send_email_notification(message)
    require 'net/smtp'
    
    smtp = Net::SMTP.new(ENV['SMTP_SERVER'], ENV['SMTP_PORT'])
    smtp.enable_starttls if ENV['SMTP_TLS'] == 'true'
    
    email_body = <<~EMAIL
      From: #{ENV['EMAIL_FROM']}
      To: #{ENV['EMAIL_TO']}
      Subject: Power Outage Alert
      
      #{message}
    EMAIL
    
    smtp.start(ENV['SMTP_DOMAIN'], ENV['SMTP_USERNAME'], ENV['SMTP_PASSWORD'], :login) do |smtp|
      smtp.send_message(email_body, ENV['EMAIL_FROM'], ENV['EMAIL_TO'])
    end
    
    puts "Email notification sent".green
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Failed to send email: #{e.message}".red
  end
  
  # SMS notification (using a simple HTTP API)
  def send_sms_notification(message)
    response = HTTParty.post(
      "#{ENV['SMS_API_URL']}/send",
      body: {
        to: ENV['SMS_TO_NUMBER'],
        message: message,
        api_key: ENV['SMS_API_KEY']
      }
    )
    
    if response.success?
      puts "SMS notification sent".green
    else
      puts "Failed to send SMS: #{response.code}".red
    end
  rescue StandardError => e
    puts "Failed to send SMS: #{e.message}".red
  end
  
  # Start the notification scheduler
  def start_scheduler(check_interval_minutes: 5, notification_lead_time_minutes: 30)
    puts "\n🔔 Starting outage notification service...".cyan
    puts "Checking every #{check_interval_minutes} minutes for upcoming outages".yellow
    puts "Will notify #{notification_lead_time_minutes} minutes before outage".yellow
    puts "Press Ctrl+C to stop".yellow
    
    # Initial fetch
    fetch_outage_schedule
    
    # Schedule periodic checks
    @scheduler.every "#{check_interval_minutes}m" do
      check_upcoming_outages(notification_lead_time_minutes: notification_lead_time_minutes)
    end
    
    # Also refresh schedule every 6 hours
    @scheduler.every '6h' do
      fetch_outage_schedule
    end
    
    # Keep the scheduler running
    @scheduler.join
  end
  
  # Load mock data for testing
  def load_mock_data
    puts "Loading mock data...".yellow
    
    @outage_groups = [
      {
        number: 1,
        name: "Group 1 - Central District",
        schedule: [
          { day: 1, start_time: Time.parse("2024-01-01 08:00:00"), end_time: Time.parse("2024-01-01 12:00:00"), duration_hours: 4 },
          { day: 3, start_time: Time.parse("2024-01-01 14:00:00"), end_time: Time.parse("2024-01-01 18:00:00"), duration_hours: 4 },
          { day: 5, start_time: Time.parse("2024-01-01 10:00:00"), end_time: Time.parse("2024-01-01 14:00:00"), duration_hours: 4 }
        ]
      },
      {
        number: 2,
        name: "Group 2 - North District",
        schedule: [
          { day: 2, start_time: Time.parse("2024-01-01 09:00:00"), end_time: Time.parse("2024-01-01 13:00:00"), duration_hours: 4 },
          { day: 4, start_time: Time.parse("2024-01-01 15:00:00"), end_time: Time.parse("2024-01-01 19:00:00"), duration_hours: 4 },
          { day: 6, start_time: Time.parse("2024-01-01 11:00:00"), end_time: Time.parse("2024-01-01 15:00:00"), duration_hours: 4 }
        ]
      }
    ]
    
    @user_group = find_user_group || @outage_groups.first
  end
end
```

text:
Here's a complete Ruby implementation for sending transactional messages through the UniOne API: ## Gemfile ```ruby source 'https://rubygems.org' gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21.0' gem 'json', '~> 2.6' gem 'dotenv', '~> 2.8' gem 'logger', '~> 1.5' ``` ## Implementation ### Main UniOne Client Class ```ruby # unione_client.rb require 'httparty' require 'json' require 'logger' require 'dotenv/load' class UniOneClient include HTTParty BASE_URL = 'https://api.unisender.com/ru/transactional/api/v1' attr_reader :api_key, :logger def initialize(api_key: nil, logger: nil) @api_key = api_key || ENV['UNIONE_API_KEY'] @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT) raise ArgumentError, "API key is required" if @api_key.nil? || @api_key.empty? self.class.base_uri BASE_URL self.class.default_timeout 30 end # Send a single email def send_email(params = {}) validate_email_params!(params) payload = build_email_payload(params) response = self.class.post('/email/send.json', headers: headers, body: payload.to_json ) handle_response(response) end # Send email with template def send_email_with_template(params = {}) validate_template_params!(params) payload = build_template_payload(params) response = self.class.post('/email/send.json', headers: headers, body: payload.to_json ) handle_response(response) end # Get email status def get_email_status(job_id) response = self.class.get('/email/status.json', headers: headers, query: { api_key: api_key, job_id: job_id } ) handle_response(response) end # Get template list def get_templates(limit: 50, offset: 0) response = self.class.get('/template/list.json', headers: headers, query: { api_key: api_key, limit: limit, offset: offset } ) handle_response(response) end # Create template def create_template(params = {}) validate_template_creation_params!(params) response = self.class.post('/template/set.json', headers: headers, body: { api_key: api_key, name: params[:name], subject: params[:subject], body: params[:body], from_email: params[:from_email], from_name: params[:from_name] }.to_json ) handle_response(response) end # Get balance def get_balance response = self.class.get('/balance.json', headers: headers, query: { api_key: api_key } ) handle_response(response) end private def headers { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json', 'Accept' => 'application/json', 'X-API-KEY' => api_key } end def build_email_payload(params) payload = { api_key: api_key, message: { recipients: Array(params[:recipients]).map { |r| { email: r } }, subject: params[:subject], body: { html: params[:html_body], plaintext: params[:text_body] }, from_email: params[:from_email], from_name: params[:from_name], reply_to: params[:reply_to], track_links: params[:track_links] || 1, track_read: params[:track_read] || 1, headers: params[:headers] || {}, attachments: params[:attachments] || [], options: { unsubscribe_url: params[:unsubscribe_url] }.compact } } # Add CC and BCC if provided payload[:message][:cc] = Array(params[:cc]).map { |r| { email: r } } if params[:cc] payload[:message][:bcc] = Array(params[:bcc]).map { |r| { email: r } } if params[:bcc] payload end def build_template_payload(params) payload = { api_key: api_key, message: { recipients: Array(params[:recipients]).map { |r| recipient = { email: r[:email] || r } recipient[:substitutions] = r[:substitutions] if r.is_a?(Hash) && r[:substitutions] recipient }, template_id: params[:template_id], template_engine: params[:template_engine] || 'simple', from_email: params[:from_email], from_name: params[:from_name], track_links: params[:track_links] || 1, track_read: params[:track_read] || 1 } } # Add global substitutions if provided payload[:global_substitutions] = params[:global_substitutions] if params[:global_substitutions] payload end def validate_email_params!(params) required = [:recipients, :subject, :from_email] missing = required.select { |key| params[key].nil? || (params[key].respond_to?(:empty?) && params[key].empty?) } if missing.any? raise ArgumentError, "Missing required parameters: #{missing.join(', ')}" end if params[:html_body].nil? && params[:text_body].nil? raise ArgumentError, "Either html_body or text_body is required" end end def validate_template_params!(params) required = [:recipients, :template_id, :from_email] missing = required.select { |key| params[key].nil? || (params[key].respond_to?(:empty?) && params[key].empty?) } if missing.any? raise ArgumentError, "Missing required parameters: #{missing.join(', ')}" end end def validate_template_creation_params!(params) required = [:name, :subject, :body, :from_email] missing = required.select { |key| params[key].nil? || (params[key].respond_to?(:empty?) && params[key].empty?) } if missing.any? raise ArgumentError, "Missing required parameters: #{missing.join(', ')}" end end def handle_response(response) logger.debug("UniOne API Response: #{response.code} - #{response.body}") case response.code when 200..299 JSON.parse(response.body) when 400 raise UniOneError, "Bad request: #{response.body}" when 401 raise UniOneError, "Authentication failed: #{response.body}" when 403 raise UniOneError, "Access forbidden: #{response.body}" when 404 raise UniOneError, "Resource not found: #{response.body}" when 429 raise UniOneError, "Rate limit exceeded: #{response.body}" when 500..599 raise UniOneError, "Server error: #{response.body}" else raise UniOneError, "Unexpected response code #{response.code}: #{response.body}" end end end class UniOneError < StandardError; end ``` ### Service Wrapper Class ```ruby # transactional_email_service.rb require_relative 'unione_client' class TransactionalEmailService attr_reader :client def initialize(api_key: nil) @client = UniOneClient.new(api_key: api_key) end # Send welcome email def send_welcome_email(user_email, user_name) client.send_email_with_template( recipients: [{ email: user_email, substitutions: { name: user_name } }], template_id: ENV['WELCOME_TEMPLATE_ID'], from_email: ENV['FROM_EMAIL'], from_name: ENV['FROM_NAME'] ) end # Send password reset email def send_password_reset_email(user_email, reset_token) reset_url = "#{ENV['APP_URL']}/reset-password?token=#{reset_token}" client.send_email_with_template( recipients: [{ email: user_email, substitutions: { reset_url: reset_url, expires_in: '24 hours' } }], template_id: ENV['PASSWORD_RESET_TEMPLATE_ID'], from_email: ENV['FROM_EMAIL'], from_name: ENV['FROM_NAME'] ) end # Send invoice email def send_invoice_email(user_email, invoice_data) client.send_email( recipients: [user_email], subject: "Invoice ##{invoice_data[:invoice_number]}", html_body: generate_invoice_html(invoice_data), from_email: ENV['BILLING_EMAIL'], from_name: ENV['BILLING_NAME'], attachments: invoice_data[:attachments] || [] ) end # Send notification email def send_notification(user_email, subject, message, options = {}) client.send_email( recipients: [user_email], subject: subject, html_body: "
#{message}
", text_body: message, from_email: options[:from_email] || ENV['FROM_EMAIL'], from_name: options[:from_name] || ENV['FROM_NAME'], track_links: options.fetch(:track_links, true) ? 1 : 0, track_read: options.fetch(:track_read, true) ? 1 : 0 ) end # Send bulk notification def send_bulk_notification(recipients, subject, message, options = {}) client.send_email( recipients: recipients, subject: subject, html_body: "
#{message}
", text_body: message, from_email: options[:from_email] || ENV['FROM_EMAIL'], from_name: options[:from_name] || ENV['FROM_NAME'] ) end # Check email delivery status def check_delivery_status(job_id) client.get_email_status(job_id) end # Get account balance def get_account_balance client.get_balance end private def generate_invoice_html(invoice_data) <<~HTML

Invoice ##{invoice_data[:invoice_number]}

Dear #{invoice_data[:customer_name]},

Please find your invoice details below:

#{invoice_data[:items].map { |item| "" }.join}
Description Amount
#{item[:description]}#{item[:amount]}
Total #{invoice_data[:total]}

Due date: #{invoice_data[:due_date]}

Thank you for your business!

HTML end end ``` ### Usage Example ```ruby # example_usage.rb require_relative 'transactional_email_service' # Initialize the service service = TransactionalEmailService.new begin # Send a welcome email result = service.send_welcome_email('user@example.com', 'John Doe') puts "Welcome email sent: #{result}" # Send a simple notification result = service.send_notification( 'user@example.com', 'Important Update', 'Your account has been updated successfully.' ) puts "Notification sent: #{result}" # Send bulk notification recipients = ['user1@example.com', 'user2@example.com', 'user3@example.com'] result = service.send_bulk_notification( recipients, 'System Maintenance', 'Our system will be under maintenance on Sunday.' ) puts "Bulk notification sent: #{result}" # Check delivery status (using job_id from previous response) if result['job_id'] status = service.check_delivery_status(result['job_id']) puts "Delivery status: #{status}" end # Get account balance balance = service.get_account_balance puts "Account balance: #{balance}" rescue UniOneError => e puts "Error sending email: #{e.message}" end ``` ### Environment Configuration ```bash # .env UNIONE_API_KEY=your_api_key_here FROM_EMAIL=noreply@yourdomain.com FROM_NAME=Your Company Name BILLING_EMAIL=billing@yourdomain.com BILLING_NAME=Billing Department WELCOME_TEMPLATE_ID=template_id_here PASSWORD_RESET_TEMPLATE_ID=template_id_here APP_URL=https://yourapp.com ``` This implementation provides: 1. **UniOneClient**: Core API client with methods for all major UniOne transactional email operations 2. **TransactionalEmailService**: High-level service with common email sending patterns 3. **Error handling**: Custom `UniOneError` class with detailed error messages 4. **Template support**: Both simple and templated emails 5. **Attachment support**: For sending files with emails 6. **Tracking options**: Link tracking and read tracking 7. **Bulk sending**: Support for multiple recipients 8. **Status checking**: Email delivery status verification 9. **Balance checking**: Account balance information The code is production-ready with proper error handling, logging, and configuration management through environment variables.

prompt:
Напишіть код на Ruby для наведеного нижче завдання. Почніть із Gemfile, у якому перелічено всі геми, потрібні коду, а потім наведіть реалізацію.

Завдання: Класифікуйте тональність українських відгуків про товари.
text:
Ось рішення для класифікації тональності українських відгуків про товари:

## Gemfile

```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'

gem 'nokogiri', '~> 1.15'
gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21'
gem 'text', '~> 1.3'
gem 'lingua', '~> 0.6'
gem 'unicode_utils', '~> 1.4'
gem 'pragmatic_segmenter', '~> 0.3'
gem 'ruby-stemmer', '~> 0.9'
```

## Реалізація

```ruby
require 'nokogiri'
require 'httparty'
require 'text'
require 'lingua'
require 'unicode_utils'
require 'pragmatic_segmenter'
require 'lingua/stemmer'

class UkrainianSentimentAnalyzer
  POSITIVE_WORDS = %w[
    чудовий відмінний прекрасний гарний якісний надійний зручний
    подобається рекомендую задоволений супер класний ідеальний
    чудово відмінно прекрасно гарно якісно надійно зручно
    люблю в захваті найкращий кращий суперовий топовий
    швидкий ефективний практичний стильний сучасний функціональний
    легко просто зрозуміло бездоганний бездоганно професійний
    корисний вигідний економний компактний міцний довговічний
  ].freeze

  NEGATIVE_WORDS = %w[
    поганий жахливий неякісний ненадійний незручний розчарований
    не рекомендую незадоволений жахливо погано неякісно ненадійно
    незручно ненавиджу найгірший гірший бракований дефектний
    повільний неефективний непрактичний нестильний застарілий
    нефункціональний складно важко незрозуміло недолугий
    непрофесійний шкідливий невигідний неекономний громіздкий
    крихкий недовговічний зламаний пошкоджений дефектний
  ].freeze

  INTENSIFIERS = %w[
    дуже надзвичайно неймовірно вкрай абсолютно повністю
    максимально надто занадто особливо виключно
  ].freeze

  NEGATIONS = %w[
    не ні ані без
  ].freeze

  def initialize
    @stemmer = Lingua::Stemmer.new(language: 'uk')
  end

  def analyze(text)
    return { sentiment: :neutral, score: 0, confidence: 0 } if text.nil? || text.empty?

    sentences = split_sentences(text)
    sentence_scores = sentences.map { |sentence| analyze_sentence(sentence) }
    
    total_score = sentence_scores.sum
    avg_score = total_score.to_f / sentence_scores.length
    
    sentiment = classify_score(avg_score)
    confidence = calculate_confidence(avg_score, sentence_scores)
    
    {
      sentiment: sentiment,
      score: avg_score,
      confidence: confidence,
      sentence_count: sentence_scores.length
    }
  end

  def analyze_review(review_text)
    result = analyze(review_text)
    
    # Додаткова інформація для відгуків
    result.merge(
      positive_words: count_words(review_text, POSITIVE_WORDS),
      negative_words: count_words(review_text, NEGATIVE_WORDS),
      text_length: review_text.length
    )
  end

  private

  def split_sentences(text)
    ps = PragmaticSegmenter::Segmenter.new(text: text, language: 'uk')
    ps.segment
  rescue
    # Fallback to simple splitting
    text.split(/[.!?]+/).reject(&:empty?)
  end

  def analyze_sentence(sentence)
    words = tokenize(sentence)
    score = 0
    negate = false
    intensify = 1.0
    
    words.each do |word|
      stemmed_word = stem_word(word.downcase)
      
      if NEGATIONS.include?(stemmed_word)
        negate = true
        next
      end
      
      if INTENSIFIERS.include?(stemmed_word)
        intensify = 1.5
        next
      end
      
      if POSITIVE_WORDS.include?(stemmed_word)
        word_score = 1.0 * intensify
        word_score = -word_score if negate
        score += word_score
      elsif NEGATIVE_WORDS.include?(stemmed_word)
        word_score = -1.0 * intensify
        word_score = -word_score if negate
        score += word_score
      end
      
      # Reset modifiers
      negate = false
      intensify = 1.0
    end
    
    score
  end

  def tokenize(text)
    UnicodeUtils.downcase(text).scan(/[а-яіїєґa-z0-9]+/i)
  end

  def stem_word(word)
    @stemmer.stem(word)
  rescue
    word
  end

  def classify_score(score)
    if score > 0.2
      :positive
    elsif score < -0.2
      :negative
    else
      :neutral
    end
  end

  def calculate_confidence(avg_score, sentence_scores)
    return 0 if sentence_scores.empty?
    
    # Розраховуємо впевненість на основі розкиду оцінок
    variance = sentence_scores.map { |s| (s - avg_score) ** 2 }.sum / sentence_scores.length
    std_dev = Math.sqrt(variance)
    
    # Чим менше розкид і чим далі від нуля, тим вища впевненість
    confidence = (1.0 / (1.0 + std_dev)) * (1.0 - Math.exp(-avg_score.abs))
    [confidence, 1.0].min
  end

  def count_words(text, word_list)
    words = tokenize(text)
    stemmed_words = word_list.map { |w| stem_word(w) }
    
    words.count do |word|
      stemmed = stem_word(word.downcase)
      stemmed_words.include?(stemmed)
    end
  end
end

# Приклад використання
analyzer = UkrainianSentimentAnalyzer.new

# Тестові відгуки
reviews = [
  "Цей товар просто чудовий! Дуже задоволений якістю і швидкою доставкою. Рекомендую всім!",
  "Жахливий продукт. Не рекомендую нікому. Якість дуже погана, товар зламався через тиждень.",
  "Товар нормальний, але не ідеальний. Є деякі недоліки, хоча в цілому працює.",
  "Неймовірно зручний і практичний! Найкращий товар, який я коли-небудь купував. Супер якість!",
  "Повністю розчарований. Це найгірший товар. Неякісний і ненадійний. Не купуйте!"
]

puts "Аналіз українських відгуків:\n\n"

reviews.each_with_index do |review, index|
  result = analyzer.analyze_review(review)
  
  puts "Відгук #{index + 1}:"
  puts "  Текст: #{review[0..50]}..."
  puts "  Тональність: #{result[:sentiment]}"
  puts "  Оцінка: #{result[:score].round(3)}"
  puts "  Впевненість: #{(result[:confidence] * 100).round(1)}%"
  puts "  Позитивні слова: #{result[:positive_words]}"
  puts "  Негативні слова: #{result[:negative_words]}"
  puts
end
```

Цей код реалізує аналізатор тональності для українських відгуків з наступними можливостями:

1. **Словниковий підхід**: Використовує словники позитивних і негативних слів українською мовою
2. **Обробка заперечень**: Враховує заперечення ("не", "ні", "ані", "без")
3. **Інтенсифікатори**: Розпізнає підсилювачі ("дуже", "надзвичайно", "неймовірно")
4. **Стеммінг**: Використовує стеммінг для приведення слів до базової форми
5. **Сегментація речень**: Розбиває текст на окремі речення для кращого аналізу
6. **Розрахунок впевненості**: Обчислює рівень впевненості в класифікації

Аналізатор повертає:
- Тональність (позитивна, негативна, нейтральна)
- Числову оцінку
- Рівень впевненості
- Кількість позитивних і негативних слів

Task: Send email newsletters through the SendPulse API.
text:
Here's a complete Ruby implementation for sending email newsletters through the SendPulse API: ## Gemfile ```ruby source 'https://rubygems.org' gem 'httparty', '~> 0.21.0' gem 'json', '~> 2.6' gem 'dotenv', '~> 2.8' gem 'logger', '~> 1.5' ``` ## Implementation ### Directory Structure ``` sendpulse-newsletter/ ├── Gemfile ├── .env.example ├── lib/ │ ├── sendpulse_client.rb │ ├── newsletter.rb │ └── email_template.rb └── main.rb ``` ### 1. lib/sendpulse_client.rb ```ruby require 'httparty' require 'json' require 'logger' class SendPulseClient include HTTParty BASE_URL = 'https://api.sendpulse.com' TOKEN_URL = 'https://api.sendpulse.com/oauth/access_token' attr_reader :logger def initialize(client_id:, client_secret:, logger: nil) @client_id = client_id @client_secret = client_secret @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT) @access_token = nil @token_expires_at = nil end def authenticate response = self.class.post( TOKEN_URL, body: { grant_type: 'client_credentials', client_id: @client_id, client_secret: @client_secret }, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' } ) if response.success? data = JSON.parse(response.body) @access_token = data['access_token'] @token_expires_at = Time.now + data['expires_in'].to_i logger.info('Successfully authenticated with SendPulse API') true else logger.error("Authentication failed: #{response.body}") false end end def authenticated? return false unless @access_token return true if @token_expires_at && @token_expires_at > Time.now + 60 authenticate end def create_address_book(name) return nil unless authenticated? response = self.class.post( "#{BASE_URL}/addressbooks", headers: auth_headers, body: { bookName: name }.to_json ) if response.success? book = JSON.parse(response.body) logger.info("Address book '#{name}' created with ID: #{book['id']}") book else logger.error("Failed to create address book: #{response.body}") nil end end def get_address_books(limit: 100, offset: 0) return [] unless authenticated? response = self.class.get( "#{BASE_URL}/addressbooks", headers: auth_headers, query: { limit: limit, offset: offset } ) if response.success? JSON.parse(response.body) else logger.error("Failed to get address books: #{response.body}") [] end end def add_emails_to_book(book_id, emails) return false unless authenticated? response = self.class.post( "#{BASE_URL}/addressbooks/#{book_id}/emails", headers: auth_headers, body: { emails: emails }.to_json ) if response.success? logger.info("Added #{emails.length} emails to address book #{book_id}") true else logger.error("Failed to add emails: #{response.body}") false end end def create_campaign(sender_name:, sender_email:, subject:, body:, book_id:, template_id: nil) return nil unless authenticated? campaign_data = { sender_name: sender_name, sender_email: sender_email, subject: subject, body: body, address_book_id: book_id } campaign_data[:template_id] = template_id if template_id response = self.class.post( "#{BASE_URL}/email/campaigns", headers: auth_headers, body: campaign_data.to_json ) if response.success? campaign = JSON.parse(response.body) logger.info("Campaign created with ID: #{campaign['id']}") campaign else logger.error("Failed to create campaign: #{response.body}") nil end end def send_campaign(campaign_id) return false unless authenticated? response = self.class.post( "#{BASE_URL}/email/campaigns/#{campaign_id}", headers: auth_headers ) if response.success? logger.info("Campaign #{campaign_id} sent successfully") true else logger.error("Failed to send campaign: #{response.body}") false end end def get_campaign_info(campaign_id) return nil unless authenticated? response = self.class.get( "#{BASE_URL}/email/campaigns/#{campaign_id}", headers: auth_headers ) if response.success? JSON.parse(response.body) else logger.error("Failed to get campaign info: #{response.body}") nil end end def get_campaign_statistics(campaign_id) return nil unless authenticated? response = self.class.get( "#{BASE_URL}/email/campaigns/#{campaign_id}/statistics", headers: auth_headers ) if response.success? JSON.parse(response.body) else logger.error("Failed to get campaign statistics: #{response.body}") nil end end def create_template(name:, body:, subject: nil) return nil unless authenticated? template_data = { name: name, body: body } template_data[:subject] = subject if subject response = self.class.post( "#{BASE_URL}/email/templates", headers: auth_headers, body: template_data.to_json ) if response.success? template = JSON.parse(response.body) logger.info("Template created with ID: #{template['id']}") template else logger.error("Failed to create template: #{response.body}") nil end end def get_templates(limit: 100, offset: 0) return [] unless authenticated? response = self.class.get( "#{BASE_URL}/email/templates", headers: auth_headers, query: { limit: limit, offset: offset } ) if response.success? JSON.parse(response.body) else logger.error("Failed to get templates: #{response.body}") [] end end private def auth_headers { 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{@access_token}", 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' } end end ``` ### 2. lib/email_template.rb ```ruby require 'json' class EmailTemplate attr_reader :name, :body, :subject def initialize(name:, body:, subject: nil) @name = name @body = body @subject = subject end def to_h hash = { name: @name, body: @body } hash[:subject] = @subject if @subject hash end def self.from_html_file(file_path, name:, subject: nil) html_content = File.read(file_path) new(name: name, body: html_content, subject: subject) end end ``` ### 3. lib/newsletter.rb ```ruby require_relative 'sendpulse_client' require_relative 'email_template' class Newsletter attr_reader :client, :logger def initialize(client_id:, client_secret:, logger: nil) @logger = logger || Logger.new(STDOUT) @client = SendPulseClient.new( client_id: client_id, client_secret: client_secret, logger: @logger ) end def authenticate @client.authenticate end def create_or_get_address_book(book_name) # Check if book already exists existing_books = @client.get_address_books existing_book = existing_books.find { |book| book['name'] == book_name } return existing_book if existing_book # Create new book if it doesn't exist @client.create_address_book(book_name) end def add_subscribers(book_id, emails) # Validate emails valid_emails = emails.select { |email| valid_email?(email) } if valid_emails.empty? logger.warn('No valid emails to add') return false end # SendPulse API accepts max 500 emails per request valid_emails.each_slice(500) do |email_batch| @client.add_emails_to_book(book_id, email_batch) end true end def send_newsletter(sender_name:, sender_email:, subject:, body:, book_id:, template_id: nil) campaign = @client.create_campaign( sender_name: sender_name, sender_email: sender_email, subject: subject, body: body, book_id: book_id, template_id: template_id ) return false unless campaign @client.send_campaign(campaign['id']) end def send_with_template(sender_name:, sender_email:, subject:, template_id:, book_id:) campaign = @client.create_campaign( sender_name: sender_name, sender_email: sender_email, subject: subject, body: nil, book_id: book_id, template_id: template_id ) return false unless campaign @client.send_campaign(campaign['id']) end def get_campaign_stats(campaign_id) @client.get_campaign_statistics(campaign_id) end private def valid_email?(email) email =~ /\A[\w+\-.]+@[a-z\d\-]+(\.[a-z\d\-]+)*\.[a-z]+\z/i end end ``` ### 4. main.rb ```ruby require 'dotenv/load' require 'logger' require_relative 'lib/sendpulse_client' require_relative 'lib/newsletter' require_relative 'lib/email_template' # Configure logger logger = Logger.new(STDOUT) logger.level = Logger::INFO # Load configuration from environment variables client_id = ENV['SENDPULSE_CLIENT_ID'] client_secret = ENV['SENDPULSE_CLIENT_SECRET'] if client_id.nil? || client_secret.nil? logger.error('Please set SENDPULSE_CLIENT_ID and SENDPULSE_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables') exit 1 end # Initialize newsletter newsletter = Newsletter.new( client_id: client_id, client_secret: client_secret, logger: logger ) # Authenticate unless newsletter.authenticate logger.error('Failed to authenticate with SendPulse') exit 1 end # Example usage begin # 1. Create or get address book book = newsletter.create_or_get_address_book('My Newsletter Subscribers') if book logger.info("Using address book: #{book['name']} (ID: #{book['id']})") # 2. Add subscribers subscribers = [ 'subscriber1@example.com', 'subscriber2@example.com', 'subscriber3@example.com' ] newsletter.add_subscribers(book['id'], subscribers) # 3. Create HTML email template html_template = <<~HTML

Welcome to Our Newsletter!

Hello {{Name}},

Thank you for subscribing to our newsletter. We're excited to share our latest updates with you!

This week's highlights:

  • New product features
  • Upcoming events
  • Special offers

Stay tuned for more exciting content!

You're receiving this email because you subscribed to our newsletter.

Unsubscribe

HTML # 4. Send newsletter success = newsletter.send_newsletter( sender_name: 'Your Company', sender_email: 'newsletter@yourcompany.com', subject: 'Welcome to Our Newsletter!', body: html_template, book_id: book['id'] ) if success logger.info('Newsletter sent successfully!') else logger.error('Failed to send newsletter') end end rescue StandardError => e logger.error("An error occurred: #{e.message}") logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n")) end ``` ### 5. .env.example ```env # SendPulse API Credentials # Get these from https://login.sendpulse.com/settings/ SENDPULSE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id_here SENDPULSE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret_here ``` ## Usage Instructions 1. **Install dependencies:** ```bash bundle install ``` 2. **Set up environment variables:** ```bash cp .env.example .env # Edit .env with your SendPulse API credentials ``` 3. **Run the newsletter script:** ```bash ruby main.rb ``` ## Features - **Authentication**: OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow - **Address Book Management**: Create, retrieve, and manage subscriber lists - **Email Templates**: Create reusable templates - **Campaign Management**: Create and send email campaigns - **Statistics**: Retrieve campaign performance metrics - **Error Handling**: Comprehensive logging and error handling - **Batch Processing**: Handles large email lists (500 emails per API call limit) ## API Endpoints Used - `POST /oauth/access_token` - Authentication - `POST /addressbooks` - Create address book - `GET /addressbooks` - List address books - `POST /addressbooks/{id}/emails` - Add emails to book - `POST /email/campaigns` - Create campaign - `POST /email/campaigns/{id}` - Send campaign - `GET /email/campaigns/{id}/statistics` - Get campaign statistics - `POST /email/templates` - Create template - `GET /email/templates` - List templates This implementation provides a robust foundation for sending newsletters through SendPulse with proper error handling, logging, and modular design for easy extension.
