```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "json"
require "net/http"
require "uri"
require "time"

module Diia
  class Error < StandardError; end
  class ConfigurationError < Error; end
  class AuthenticationError < Error; end
  class InvalidRequestError < Error; end
  class NotFoundError < Error; end
  class TimeoutError < Error; end
  class ServerError < Error; end
  class RateLimitError < ServerError; end

  # Optional helper that obtains a partner access token.
  # Override or replace this if your token source is different.
  class PartnerTokenProvider
    DEFAULT_TOKEN_ENDPOINT = "https://api.diia.gov.ua/api/v1/auth/partner/token"
    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 30

    def initialize(client_id:, client_secret:, token_endpoint: DEFAULT_TOKEN_ENDPOINT, timeout: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)
      @client_id = client_id
      @client_secret = client_secret
      @token_endpoint = token_endpoint
      @timeout = timeout
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @cached_token = nil
      @expires_at = nil
    end

    def call
      @mutex.synchronize do
        return @cached_token if @cached_token && @expires_at && Time.now < @expires_at - 30

        fetch_token
      end
    end

    private

    def fetch_token
      uri = URI(@token_endpoint)
      request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
      request["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
      request["Accept"] = "application/json"
      request.body = JSON.generate(
        "clientId" => @client_id,
        "clientSecret" => @client_secret
      )

      response = http(uri).request(request)
      body = response.body.to_s
      parsed = JSON.parse(body)

      unless response.code.to_i.between?(200, 299)
        raise AuthenticationError, "token endpoint returned #{response.code}: #{body}"
      end

      token = parsed["token"] || parsed["access_token"] || parsed.dig("data", "token")
      expires_in = parsed["expiresIn"] || parsed["expires_in"] ||
                   parsed.dig("data", "expiresIn") || parsed.dig("data", "expires_in") || 300

      if token.to_s.empty?
        raise AuthenticationError, "token endpoint response did not contain a token"
      end

      @cached_token = token
      @expires_at = Time.now + expires_in.to_i
      @cached_token
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      raise AuthenticationError, "invalid token endpoint JSON: #{e.message}"
    end

    def http(uri)
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      http.use_ssl = uri.scheme == "https"
      http.open_timeout = @timeout
      http.read_timeout = @timeout
      http.write_timeout = @timeout if http.respond_to?(:write_timeout=)
      http
    end
  end

  class PushNotificationClient
    DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.diia.gov.ua"
    DEFAULT_PUSH_ENDPOINT = "/api/v1/notifications/push"
    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 30
    MAX_RETRIES = 3
    RETRYABLE_STATUSES = [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].freeze

    attr_reader :base_url, :push_endpoint, :timeout

    def initialize(
      access_token: nil,
      access_token_provider: nil,
      base_url: DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
      push_endpoint: DEFAULT_PUSH_ENDPOINT,
      timeout: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
      logger: nil
    )
      @access_token = access_token
      @access_token_provider = access_token_provider
      @base_url = base_url.chomp("/")
      @push_endpoint = push_endpoint.start_with?("/") ? push_endpoint : "/#{push_endpoint}"
      @timeout = timeout
      @logger = logger
    end

    # Sends a push notification to a Diia user.
    #
    # recipient can be a RNOKPP/ITN string or a hash such as:
    #   { rnokpp: "1234567890" }
    #   { itn: "1234567890" }
    #   { passport: "..." }
    def send_push_notification(recipient:, title:, body:, data: {}, deep_link: nil,
                               notification_id: nil, token: nil)
      payload = build_payload(
        recipient: recipient,
        title: title,
        body: body,
        data: data,
        deep_link: deep_link,
        notification_id: notification_id
      )

      response = perform_request(payload, token: token)
      parse_response(response)
    end

    alias send_push send_push_notification

    private

    def build_payload(recipient:, title:, body:, data:, deep_link:, notification_id:)
      raise ArgumentError, "title cannot be blank" if title.to_s.strip.empty?
      raise ArgumentError, "body cannot be blank" if body.to_s.strip.empty?

      payload = {
        "recipient" => normalize_recipient(recipient),
        "notification" => {
          "title" => title,
          "body" => body
        }
      }

      payload["notification"]["data"] = data unless data.nil? || data.empty?
      payload["notification"]["deepLink"] = deep_link if deep_link && !deep_link.to_s.strip.empty?
      payload["notification"]["notificationId"] = notification_id if notification_id && !notification_id.to_s.strip.empty?

      payload
    end

    def normalize_recipient(recipient)
      case recipient
      when String
        { "rnokpp" => recipient }
      when Hash
        stringified = recipient.each_with_object({}) { |(key, value), hash| hash[key.to_s] = value }
        if stringified["rnokpp"] || stringified["itn"] || stringified["passport"]
          stringified
        else
          raise ArgumentError, "recipient hash must contain one of: rnokpp, itn, passport"
        end
      else
        raise ArgumentError, "recipient must be a String or Hash"
      end
    end

    def perform_request(payload, token:)
      uri = URI("#{base_url}#{push_endpoint}")
      request = build_request(uri, payload, token: token)

      retries = 0
      begin
        response = execute_request(uri, request)
        return response unless retryable_response?(response)

        if retries >= MAX_RETRIES
          raise RateLimitError, "rate limited after #{MAX_RETRIES} retries" if response.code.to_i == 429

          raise ServerError, "server returned retryable error #{response.code} after #{MAX_RETRIES} retries"
        end

        retries += 1
        sleep(retry_after(response) || 2**retries)
        retry
      rescue Error
        raise
      rescue Net::OpenTimeout, Net::ReadTimeout => e
        raise TimeoutError, e.message
      rescue SocketError, EOFError, IOError, SystemCallError => e
        raise Error, "network error: #{e.message}"
      end
    end

    def build_request(uri, payload, token:)
      request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
      request["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
      request["Accept"] = "application/json"
      request["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{token || fetch_access_token}"
      request.body = JSON.generate(payload)
      request
    end

    def execute_request(uri, request)
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      http.use_ssl = uri.scheme == "https"
      http.open_timeout = timeout
      http.read_timeout = timeout
      http.write_timeout = timeout if http.respond_to?(:write_timeout=)

      log_request(uri, request) if @logger
      response = http.request(request)
      log_response(response) if @logger
      response
    end

    def fetch_access_token
      return @access_token if @access_token && !@access_token.empty?
      return @access_token_provider.call if @access_token_provider

      raise ConfigurationError, "access token is missing; pass access_token: or access_token_provider:"
    end

    def parse_response(response)
      body = response.body.to_s
      parsed = body.empty? ? {} : JSON.parse(body)

      case response.code.to_i
      when 200..299
        parsed
      when 401, 403
        raise AuthenticationError, "authentication failed: #{response.code} #{body}"
      when 400, 422
        raise InvalidRequestError, "invalid request: #{response.code} #{body}"
      when 404
        raise NotFoundError, "not found: #{response.code} #{body}"
      else
        raise ServerError, "server error: #{response.code} #{body}"
      end
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      raise Error, "invalid JSON response: #{e.message}"
    end

    def retryable_response?(response)
      RETRYABLE_STATUSES.include?(response.code.to_i)
    end

    def retry_after(response)
      header = response["Retry-After"]
      return nil if header.nil? || header.empty?

      if header.match?(/\A\d+\z/)
        header.to_i
      else
        begin
          Time.httpdate(header) - Time.now
        rescue ArgumentError, TypeError
          nil
        end
      end
    end

    def log_request(uri, request)
      @logger.debug("Diia push request: POST #{uri} #{request.body}")
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.warn("Diia push request logging failed: #{e.message}")
    end

    def log_response(response)
      @logger.debug("Diia push response: #{response.code} #{response.body}")
    rescue StandardError => e
      @logger.warn("Diia push response logging failed: #{e.message}")
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

module UkrainianTransliterator
  IOTATED = %w[є ю я ї й].freeze
  APOSTROPHES = ["'", "’", "ʼ"].freeze
  SOFT_SIGNS = %w[ь Ь].freeze

  BASE = {
    'а' => 'a', 'б' => 'b', 'в' => 'v', 'г' => 'h', 'ґ' => 'g',
    'д' => 'd', 'е' => 'e', 'ж' => 'zh', 'з' => 'z', 'и' => 'y',
    'і' => 'i', 'к' => 'k', 'л' => 'l', 'м' => 'm', 'н' => 'n',
    'о' => 'o', 'п' => 'p', 'р' => 'r', 'с' => 's', 'т' => 't',
    'у' => 'u', 'ф' => 'f', 'х' => 'kh', 'ц' => 'ts',
    'ч' => 'ch', 'ш' => 'sh', 'щ' => 'shch'
  }.freeze

  class << self
    def transliterate(input)
      chars = input.chars
      result = String.new
      index = 0

      at_word_start = true
      after_sign = false

      while index < chars.length
        char = chars[index]

        # The soft sign and apostrophe are not transliterated themselves,
        # but they affect the following iotated vowel or й.
        if SOFT_SIGNS.include?(char) || APOSTROPHES.include?(char)
          after_sign = true
          index += 1
          next
        end

        lower = char.downcase

        # Special combinations to avoid confusion:
        #   зг -> zgh (not zh)
        #   сг -> sgh (not sh)
        if (lower == 'з' || lower == 'с') &&
           chars[index + 1] && chars[index + 1].downcase == 'г'

          replacement = lower == 'з' ? 'zgh' : 'sgh'
          result << apply_case(replacement, char)

          at_word_start = false
          after_sign = false
          index += 2
          next
        end

        if BASE.key?(lower) || IOTATED.include?(lower)
          translit = transliterate_char(lower, at_word_start, after_sign)
          result << apply_case(translit, char)

          at_word_start = false
          after_sign = false
          index += 1
        else
          # Non-Cyrillic character: keep it and reset word context.
          result << char
          at_word_start = true
          after_sign = false
          index += 1
        end
      end

      result
    end

    private

    def transliterate_char(lower, at_word_start, after_sign)
      # ї has a special rule: yi at word start / after apostrophe / soft sign,
      # and i in all other positions.
      return (at_word_start || after_sign) ? 'yi' : 'i' if lower == 'ї'

      iotated_form = at_word_start || after_sign

      case lower
      when 'є' then iotated_form ? 'ye' : 'ie'
      when 'ю' then iotated_form ? 'yu' : 'iu'
      when 'я' then iotated_form ? 'ya' : 'ia'
      when 'й' then iotated_form ? 'y'   : 'i'
      else
        BASE.fetch(lower)
      end
    end

    def apply_case(replacement, original)
      if original == original.upcase && original != original.downcase
        replacement[0].upcase + replacement[1..-1].downcase
      else
        replacement.downcase
      end
    end
  end
end
```
